izzyondroid:eu.darken.bluemusic.name: Bluetooth Volume Manager
izzyondroid:eu.darken.bluemusic.summary: Individual voice & music volume configuration for Bluetooth devices.
izzyondroid:eu.darken.bluemusic.description:
Bluetooth Volume Manager remembers volume levels for each of your Bluetooth devices and reacts when they connect or disconnect.
 Features: * Set music, call, ringtone, and notification volumes per device
* Per-device equalizer with presets and a volume boost
* Auto-send media commands like Play or Next
* Launch apps on connect
* Keep screen awake
* Lock volume levels
* Restore volume after disconnect
 No ads, no tracking. Open-source.
Some extras require a paid upgrade to support development.
 Permissions: * Internet – for optional bug reports
* Bluetooth – to detect device connections
* Audio settings – to change volume
* Boot – to restore settings after reboot
* Wake lock – to keep screen awake or fix Samsung bugs
* System alert window – to auto-launch apps (Android 10 only)

izzyondroid:eu.faircode.netguard.name: NetGuard
izzyondroid:eu.faircode.netguard.summary: A simple way to block access to the internet per application
izzyondroid:eu.faircode.netguard.description:
NetGuard provides simple and advanced ways to block access to the internet - no root required.
 Applications and addresses can individually be allowed or denied access to your Wi-Fi and/or mobile connection.
 Blocking access to the internet can help:
 reduce your data usage
 save your battery
 increase your privacy
 Features: 
 Simple to use
 No root required
 100% open source
 No calling home
 No tracking or analytics
 No advertisements
 Actively developed and supported
 Android 5.1 and later supported
 IPv4/IPv6 TCP/UDP supported
 Tethering supported
 Optionally allow when screen on
 Optionally block when roaming
 Optionally block system applications
 Optionally notify when an application accesses the internet
 Optionally record network usage per application per address
 Material design theme with light and dark theme
 PRO features: 
 Log all outgoing traffic; search and filter access attempts; export PCAP files to analyze traffic
 Allow/block individual addresses per application
 New application notifications; configure NetGuard directly from the notification
 Display network speed graph in a status bar notification
 Select from five additional themes in both light and dark version
 There is no other no-root firewall offering all these features.
 If you have a question or problem, you can send an e-mail to marcel+netguard@faircode.eu 
 If you like to help people less fluent in English, you can help translate NetGuard in your language 
 If you like to test new features, you can participate in the test program 
 All required permissions are described here

fdroid:a2dp.Vol.name: A2DP Volume
fdroid:a2dp.Vol.description:
Automatically adjusts the media volume on connect and resets it on disconnect.
This is done so that stereo streaming audio can work properly. Intended
primarily for car Bluetooth systems. It can read out text messages using Text To
Speech (TTS) services while you are connected. Each paired Bluetooth device or
virtual device (home dock, car dock, power connection, or headset plug) can be
configured to your liking. There is a
 manual on the website.
A secondary feature is the ability to capture location information so you can
find where you left your car. The location can also be automatically captured
when exiting Car Mode on your Android device and read by any app that
understands GPS data.

fdroid:com.aryanyadav.mylexicon.name: MyLexicon
fdroid:com.aryanyadav.mylexicon.summary: Offline-first personal dictionary and vocabulary companion.
fdroid:com.aryanyadav.mylexicon.description:
My Lexicon is a powerful open-source alternative for "Create Dictionary" application . Designed specifically for Android, it serves as an offline-first personal knowledge companion where you can create, organize, and master words, quotes, phrases, idioms, personal notes, tags, favorites, and custom collections.
 The app keeps all your data stored 100% locally on your Android device — offering a privacy-respecting, lightweight solution to building your custom dictionary without relying on any cloud backend.

fdroid:com.baldo.babymonito.name: Baby Monito
fdroid:com.baldo.babymonito.summary: Track your baby's feedings, diapers and weight, privately and offline
fdroid:com.baldo.babymonito.description:
Baby Monito helps you follow your newborn's daily life: feedings, diapers, weight, daily care and medication.
Everything stays on your phone: no internet access, no account, no ads, no tracking.
• Feeding timer that keeps running with the screen off
• Weight curve alongside the WHO growth standards
• Daily care reminder
• Encrypted backup to move to a new phone
• In English and French — help translate it!
Permissions: notifications (reminder and feeding timer), exact alarms (reminder on time) and start at boot (keep the reminder after a restart). The "media playback" service only shows the feeding timer controls on the lock screen: nothing is played or recorded.

fdroid:com.idunnololz.summit.fdroid.name: Summit for Lemmy and PieFed
fdroid:com.idunnololz.summit.fdroid.summary: A fast and easy to use app for Lemmy and PieFed
fdroid:com.idunnololz.summit.fdroid.description:
Summit is an app for Lemmy and PieFed that enables you to explore hundreds of communities with ease.
Summit is optimized for Android and offers a smooth browsing experience.
Features
* An edge-to-edge browsing experience
* Upvote, comment and create content
* Easy to learn gesture navigation
* Seamless multi-account support
* Browse history
* Light/Dark and Material You themes
* Customize how posts look with dozens of unique configurations
* User inboxes
* View user profiles
* Customize web settings
* Swipe gesture actions
* Keyword and advanced filters
* View community and instance stats and descriptions
* Save posts & comments
* Multi-communities (grouping multiple communities together into one feed)
* Moderation & admin actions
* And much more to come!

fdroid:com.l5rcm.companion.name: L5RCM Companion
fdroid:com.l5rcm.companion.summary: Play-at-the-table sheet viewer for L5R 4E characters
fdroid:com.l5rcm.companion.description:
A companion app for L5RCM, the Legend of the Five Rings 4th Edition character
manager. It is a play-at-the-table tool for players, not a character builder:
advancement and editing are out of scope.
It imports a character saved by the desktop L5R Character Manager — either from a
'.l5r' file or by scanning the animated multi-frame QR code the desktop app shows —
downloads the matching community data packs, and renders a read-only character sheet
with every derived value (traits, rings, void, skills, insight, wounds, TN,
initiative, XP) computed on the device.
Network access is used only to download the community data packs from the project's
data-pack repository on GitHub.

fdroid:com.pronaycoding.blankee.name: Blankee
fdroid:com.pronaycoding.blankee.summary: Ambient sound mixer for android inspired by blanket
fdroid:com.pronaycoding.blankee.description:
Blankee – Ambient Sounds for Focus, Relaxation & Sleep
Improve your focus, relax your mind, or fall asleep more easily with Blankee. Mix calming ambient sounds and create your perfect soundscape for work, study, meditation, relaxation, or sleep.
Choose from a variety of natural and relaxing sounds such as rain, ocean waves, fireplace, forest, wind, and more. You can combine multiple sounds, adjust their individual volumes, and create a sound environment that fits your mood.
Relaxing Ambient Sounds
Create your own atmosphere with a selection of ambient sounds, including:
• Rain
• Ocean waves
• Fireplace
• Forest
• Wind
• And more
Mix different sounds together to create your ideal background audio.
😴 Sleep Timer
Use the built-in sleep timer when you're getting ready for bed. Set how long you want the sounds to play and Blankee will automatically stop playback when the timer ends.
🎵 Custom Sounds
Want to use your own sounds? Add audio files from your device and include them in your mixes. Create a completely personalized soundscape using sounds you already love.
🎚️ Individual Volume Controls
Fine-tune every sound independently. Make the rain louder, keep the waves subtle, or balance several sounds exactly the way you like them.
 💾 Save Your Favorite Presets
Found the perfect combination? Save it as a preset and quickly return to your favorite soundscape whenever you need it.
 🌙 Dark & Light Mode
Choose the theme that feels most comfortable for you with full support for both dark and light modes.
🌍 Multilingual
Blankee supports 20 languages, making the app accessible to users around the world.
📱 Designed for Android
Blankee is designed to work beautifully across phones, tablets, and foldable devices with a responsive interface that adapts to different screen sizes.
 🎯 Use Blankee For
• Improving focus while working or studying
• Creating a relaxing environment
• Falling asleep in a noisy environment
• Reading or working
• Meditation and relaxation
• Blocking distracting background noise
• Creating personalized ambient soundscapes
Blankee is open-source software and is licensed under the GPL-3.0 license.
Made with ❤️ for a calmer listening experience.

fdroid:eu.lapotre.prochaintrain.name: Prochain train
fdroid:eu.lapotre.prochaintrain.summary: Real-time departures at the Paris-region stops you follow (French only)
fdroid:eu.lapotre.prochaintrain.description:
Prochain train shows the next departures (train, RER, metro, tram, bus) at the Île-de-France (Paris region) stops of your choice, in real time, using data from Île-de-France Mobilités.
 The app is in French only , as it covers the Paris region only.
 Features 
 My places : for each place you follow, the next departures grouped by line and destination, with the line badge in its official colors, the waiting time ("3 min, then 11 · 19") and the platform when it is announced.
 Add a place : search by station, stop or town name, or list the stops around you.
 Lines and directions : pick the lines to follow and, for each one, a direction. Only the trips that later stop at the chosen station are shown (for example, at Gare du Nord, only the line H trains that stop at Écouen - Ézanville).
 Light on resources 
 No external library, no background service, no tracker: the app weighs less than 100 KB.
 Departures never refresh on their own: once when the app opens, then when you ask. Waiting times are recomputed on screen, without a new request.
 Your location is only requested when you tap "Arrêts autour de moi" (stops around me), never in the background.
 Requirement : a free PRIM API key, to create on https://prim.iledefrance-mobilites.fr. The first screen explains how to get it.
 The data comes from Île-de-France Mobilités (PRIM "Prochains passages" API and open data) and remains subject to their terms of use.

fdroid:eu.veldsoft.vitoshadm.description: It is really simple decision maker toy. It uses random numbers. It is better than flipping a coin, because it has more options. The usage is very simple. fdroid:me.velc.devqs.name: DevQS
fdroid:me.velc.devqs.description:
Tired of banking and other financial apps whining that Developer Options is on? With DevQS , Developer Options can be toggled off then back on from the Quick Settings panel without resetting other settings. Long-clicking on any of the tiles will also open the Developer Options settings screen if the DEV toggle is on.
IMPORTANT:
There is no launcher icon nor activity. The tiles must be manually added to the Quick Settings panel. The app requires the permission WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS which can be granted using ADB.
 adb shell pm grant me.velc.devqs android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS 
Or alternatively, as of 1.2.0, if Sui is installed, allow access to grant the permission.

fdroid:org.grating.styncynotes.name: StyncyNotes
fdroid:org.grating.styncynotes.summary: Sticky Notes app for Android that understands the linuxmint/sticky note file for
fdroid:org.grating.styncynotes.description:
Sticky Notes + SyncThing = StyncyNotes
StyncyNotes is a simple Sticky Note application that supports some basic formatting features like those available in the linux mint "Sticky" application (see https://github.com/linuxmint/sticky).
It stores notes and formatting in a simple local json file that takes the same format as the linuxmint Sticky, so if you happen to run this app on your desktop, you can use SyncThing to keep the two sets of notes in step.

fdroid:org.projectmaxs.transport.xmpp.name: MAXS Transport XMPP
fdroid:org.projectmaxs.transport.xmpp.description:
This is the XMPP Transport for MAXS, which does not install any launcher. You
need "MAXS Main" and preferably some MAXS Modules to make use of it!
MAXS Transport XMPP acts as gateway between MAXS and the Extensible Messaging
and Presence Protocol (XMPP). It enables MAXS to receive commands and send
responses or notifications via XMPP.

fdroid:org.wesnoth.Wesnoth.name: The Battle for Wesnoth
fdroid:org.wesnoth.Wesnoth.summary: A turn-based strategy game with a high fantasy theme
fdroid:org.wesnoth.Wesnoth.description:
(Note: This is an alpha release of the 1.19 in-development branch, and works best on a Tablet with large screen space. Consider reaching out to us or file a bug report if you encounter an issue.)
The Battle for Wesnoth is an open source, turn-based strategy game with a high fantasy theme. It features both singleplayer and online/hotseat multiplayer combat.

fdroid:peterfajdiga.fastdraw.summary: A simple Android launcher with categories
fdroid:peterfajdiga.fastdraw.description:

fdroid:systems.sieber.remotespotlight.name: RemotePointer
fdroid:systems.sieber.remotespotlight.summary: Digital Laser Pointer and Mouse Control for Presentations
fdroid:systems.sieber.remotespotlight.description:
With this app you can control your computer's keyboard and mouse (using a touchpad). Furthermore, you can project a digital laser pointer dot on your screen or projector, which is controlled by the movement of your Android device.
Advantages:
- control your computer from your couch
- when your screen output is being recorded on presentations, the laser pointer can also be recorded
- the digital laser pointer point is better visible in bright rooms
- you can simultaneously flip the slides back and forth on your Android device and control the mouse
- you can use the app as barcode/QR code scanner for your computer
Please download the free software for your PC (Linux, macOS and Windows) from: https://sieber.systems/s/rp
The goal of this project is to provide a complete self-hosted remote control application without dependencies to external servers and without tracking.

fedora-packages:beets/beets.summary: Music library manager and MusicBrainz tagger
fedora-packages:beets/beets.description: The purpose of beets is to get your music collection right once and for all. It catalogs your collection, automatically improving its meta-data as it goes using the MusicBrainz database. Then it provides a bouquet of tools for manipulating and accessing your music. Because beets is designed as a library, it can do almost anything you can imagine for your music collection. Via plugins, beets becomes a panacea: - Fetch or calculate all the meta-data you could possibly need: album art, lyrics, genres, tempos, ReplayGain levels, or acoustic fingerprints. - Get meta-data from MusicBrainz, Discogs, or Beatport. Or guess meta-data using songs' file names or their acoustic fingerprints. - Transcode audio to any format you like. - Check your library for duplicate tracks and albums or for albums that are missing tracks. - Browse your music library graphically through a Web browser and play it in any browser that supports HTML5 Audio.

fedora-packages:javassist/javassist.name: javassist
fedora-packages:javassist/javassist.summary: Java Programming Assistant for Java bytecode manipulation
fedora-packages:javassist/javassist.description: Javassist enables Java programs to define a new class at runtime and to modify a class file when the JVM loads it. Unlike other similar bytecode editors, Javassist provides two levels of API: source level and bytecode level. If the users use the source-level API, they can edit a class file without knowledge of the specifications of the Java bytecode. The whole API is designed with only the vocabulary of the Java language. You can even specify inserted bytecode in the form of source text; Javassist compiles it on the fly. On the other hand, the bytecode-level API allows the users to directly edit a class file as other editors.

It is also a rewrite of the very useful tool JLex which was developed by Elliot Berk at Princeton University. As Vern Paxson states for his C/C++ tool flex: They do not share any code though. JFlex is designed to work together with the LALR parser generator CUP by Scott Hudson, and the Java modification of Berkeley Yacc BYacc/J by Bob Jamison. It can also be used together with other parser generators like ANTLR or as a standalone tool.

firefox-addons:3056015.name: SpotCheck: Accessibility Toolkit
firefox-addons:3056015.summary: Toggle any of the tests to spot check common accessibility issues. Each one links to its related WCAG 2.2 success criteria.
firefox-addons:3056015.description:
A Chrome DevTools collection of tests that allow you to spot-check common accessibility issues directly in the browser. Each one links to its related WCAG 2.2 success criteria.
Available tools:
• Landmark Visualizer
Outlines every ARIA and HTML landmark region and flags ones missing an accessible name or duplicated.
• Link Accessibility Auditor
Checks every link for a real accessible name and flags generic text like “click here”.
• Heading Validator
Walks the heading outline in document order and flags any level that skips ahead.
• List Identifier
Flags empty lists, malformed markup, and list items that aren’t inside a list at all.
• Tab Order Visualizer
Numbers every focusable element in tab order and flags positive tabindex values.
• Text Contrast Checker
Measures text contrast against its effective background and flags anything below WCAG AA minimum.
• Alt Text Checker
Checks every image for alt text and flags the ones missing it or marked incorrectly.
• Input Label Checker
Outlines every input, select, and textarea on the page, then labels each one with how it gets its accessible name.
• Target Size Checker
Run this on any page to measure every clickable target, flag the ones under 24 by 24 CSS pixels, and show which ones clear the 44 by 44 enhanced threshold.
• Table Name Checker
Outlines every semantic table on the page, and shows where its accessible name comes from.
How to open your browser's DevTools
Open DevTools with Keyboard Shortcut
- Windows/Linux: Press F12 or Ctrl + Shift + I
- macOS: Press Cmd + Option + I
Open DevTools from Browser Menu
Browser menu --> More tools --> Developer tools
- Click the browser’s menu icon (⋮ or ☰)
- Select "More tools"
- Choose "Developer tools"
Open DevTools by Inspecting an Element
- Right‑click any part of the webpage to open the menu
- Select "Inspect" or "Inspect element" from the menu
Open DevTools via Command Menu : Chrome / Edge
- Press Ctrl + Shift + P (Windows/Linux) or Cmd + Shift + P (macOS)
- Type “DevTools” or the panel name (e.g., “Elements”, “Console”)
Updates:
- Add the Table Name Checker: 11/11/2026
- Added support for the shadow DOM : 09/17/2026
- Added the ability to access the tools from the Browser Extension Bar : 09/12/2026
- Added the Target Size Checker : 08/21/2026

bluejetty:00135725:ios.description:
Welcome to My Little Blood Cult, a scary, addictive, and horrifying cult quest that redefines the world of fishing. Are you ready for a gacha demonic fishing adventure like no other?
WHAT THE H*LL?
Prepare to lead your devoted cult on a demonic fishing adventure that transcends the ordinary. Your followers, bound by unwavering loyalty, eagerly await your command. Together, you'll embark on an extraordinary quest to capture demons, monsters, and other unearthly creatures. Become the most powerful cult known to man by summoning and building an impressive collection of demonic entities!
DEMONIC FISHING ADVENTURE
Immerse yourself in a realm of witchcraft, spells, and strategy as you navigate the shadowy depths in pursuit of your mission as a demon summoner. Engage in the ultimate demonic fishing adventure, capturing creatures that dwell in the abyss. Summon demons & monsters to complete your eerie collection and unlock the secrets of this spooky realm. Every day is Halloween here.
NOT YOUR GRANDMA’S FISHING SIMULATOR
This is not like all your boring other games. This adventure requires a delicate balance of hunting skill and magical luck. Dive into a captivating fishing game with loots infused with ancient Wicca spells and superstitions. Cast your bait into the abyss, luring and capturing hundreds of demons lurking below. 
Utilize the power of alchemy to transmute your ill-gotten loot into potent bait, summoning and capturing the most terrifying demons in existence.
EXPLORE SCARY DEMONIC WORLDS
Discover the secrets of haunting oddities, scary worlds, and sacred altars as you lay claim to monsters and demons drawn from the legends of mystery. Unveil a world of blood, spells, and evil ghost spirits as you strive to become the ultimate demonic cult leader.
SIT TIBI VENARI PROSPERUM
An ancient Wiccan spell echoes through the ages, beckoning you to seize your fate and conquer the abyss. Sacrifice, Capture, Collect! Showcase your prowess as a deathly slayer and monster hunter, capturing demons and completing your demonic collection. Beware, for sometimes sacrifices of your collections and cultists are required.
DISCLAIMER
Dillo Interactive and MLBC are not actual demonic cults – we’re just from Austin. We don’t care who worships what. Our only desire is for you to love our weird little game and share it with others.

bluejetty:00074095:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00074095:ios.description:
Pin Balls UP – Puzzles and gardening combined!
Are you a puzzle fan who also loves gardening? Ever wondered how you could combine your two favorite hobbies into one major grand adventure? You could always grow a hedge maze, of course, but it would take a while and not all of us have the space. Or sit in your yard doing jigsaw puzzles, but what happens when a nasty rain hits the skies? Well, now there’s finally another option — you can test your logic in tricky physics-based puzzles while also tending a garden of beautiful pot plants as they blossom and grow in this fun and original game.
Give your plants the food they need!
- Slide pins and move sections to guide the little colored nutrient balls down the pipe to your hungry plants. Autogenerated levels means an endless stream of new puzzle challenges and the chance to go on earning rewards and upgrading your garden endlessly.
- Over 30 puzzle-game mechanisms give your logic a real workout. Make sure the balls don’t escape, multiply their number on the way down, and avoid hazards including fire and explosions to ensure your little green friends get the goodness they need.
- Delightful original graphics, fun animations, and beautiful sound design enhance your puzzle-solving entertainment. Plus, extensive personalization options include over 50 different skins for balls and 50 different designs of pins, so you can ensure your puzzles are aesthetically pleasing as well as rewarding.
- Collect two galleries of flowers and nine different plants — sunflower, anthurium, cactus, myosotis, narcissus, pansy, protea, strelitzia, and tulip . Then tend, feed, and combine them to lead them through a unique sequence of growing stages till they finally blossom in a riot of gorgeous blooms.
- Don’t forget the watering! In this game, watering isn’t just an essential gardening exercise, it’s also a way to boost your idle income. And it’s not the only one: there are loads of other ways to get free bonuses including bonus levels with free coins and coin rewards for returning players.
Gardening was never this much fun!
Engage your puzzle-game brain, get your nimble green fingers moving and escape into hours of logic fun. Work with the laws of physics and plot the optimal course for the balls, then let them loose, and watch as they shoot down the pipes with an immensely satisfying clatter.

bluejetty:00131230:ios.description:
Exposed is the party game that finds out who in your group is the most likely to... well, everything.
Each round asks a "Who's most likely to" question about the people playing. Everyone taps a face to vote, then the result is revealed to the whole group. Simple, fast, and made for laughing together.
HOW IT WORKS
- One player creates a game and shares the PIN.
- Friends join from their own phones, in the same room or remotely.
- Vote, reveal, laugh, repeat.
WHAT'S INSIDE
- More than 5,000 questions and challenges, so every game night stays fresh
- Duels: two friends, one question, the group decides
- Yes or No rounds and the Gossip Wheel for quick-fire fun
- Several packs to match the mood, from a quiet evening to a big party
- Light and dark mode
- A recap card at the end of every game
Exposed is a great icebreaker for parties, road trips and catching up with friends.
Some packs require an optional auto-renewing subscription.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://fluff-jump-74e.notion.site/Terms-of-Service-EULA-Privacy-Policy-8285978bc30d465692cfc7503e230ed2

bluejetty:00022326:ios.name: Giang Hồ Ngũ Tuyệt
bluejetty:00022326:ios.summary:
Quyết định phát hành trò chơi điện tử G1 trên mạng số 905/QĐ-BTTTT do Bộ Thông Tin và Truyền Thông cấp ngày 25/06/2021
https://giayphep.abei.gov.vn/g1/75531
Ngũ phái loạn giang hồ - Ngũ hành tương sinh tương khắc – Giang Hồ Ngũ Tuyệt – Côn
bluejetty:00022326:ios.description:
Quyết định phát hành trò chơi điện tử G1 trên mạng số 905/QĐ-BTTTT do Bộ Thông Tin và Truyền Thông cấp ngày 25/06/2021
https://giayphep.abei.gov.vn/g1/75531
Ngũ phái loạn giang hồ - Ngũ hành tương sinh tương khắc – Giang Hồ Ngũ Tuyệt – Công thành chiến với hệ thống hoạt động lien server 24/7 – Thần tướng nhập thân buff sức mạnh tăng hàng triệu lần – Kết hôn sinh Bảo Bảo cha con cùng lâm trận – Săn boss dã ngoại map cày mỏi chân đồ rơi kín màn hình… là một góc nhỏ xíu mà tôi muôn nói với anh em về Giang Hồ Ngũ Tuyệt.
1. Ngũ Phái Loạn Giang Hồ - Ngũ Hành Động Càn Khôn
Gần đây, các NPH thường xuyên cho ra đời những con game 2,3,4 class. Nhưng chỉ đến khi Giang Hồ Ngũ Tuyệt ra mắt thì kỷ nguyên “thượng đẳng” của dòng game MMORPG mới thực sự bắt đầu. Giang Hồ Ngũ Tuyệt sở hữu 05 phái: Võ Đang, Thiếu Lâm, Dương Gia, Thiên Nhẫn, Minh Giáo; tượng trưng cho ngũ hành Kim Mộc Thủy Hỏa Thổ - tương sinh tương khắc nhau trong mọi trận chiến.
2. Chuyển phái tự do – Không lo mất đồ
Nhiều phái là thế, nhưng Giang Hồ Ngũ Tuyệt lại vô cùng tâm lý với anh em game thủ khi đưa vào tính năng: Chuyển Phái Tự Do, đã thế lại còn Không Lo Mất Đồ. Chơi một class chán, rồi sẽ đến khí anh em có nhu cầu đổi phái khác. Thử tưởng tượng đi, ông chơi hệ Hỏa bị thằng hệ Thủy nó khắc chế, ông mạnh mẽ đổi ngay sang một ông hệ Kim để trả thù. Cái cảm giác đấy cứ phải gọi là “Ơ mây zing, gút chóp em ơi!”
3. Công Thành Chiến – PK triệu người không lag
Chơi Võ Lâm, chắc các ông không lạ gì tính năng Công Thành Chiến. Nhưng các ông biết đấy, “dĩ dãng dơ dáy dễ zì zấu ziếm”, Công Thành Chiến ngày xưa thì cứ gọi là “lag-loi-le”. Nhưng với công nghệ chỉ một từ đỉnh của Giang Hồ Ngũ Tuyệt, cứ vào mà bem thôi, PK triệu người cũng không lag. Ngày xưa thì còn đổ tội cho lag mà không chiếm được thành, nhưng ngày nay mà đổ cho lag thì có cái nịt nhé anh em.
4. Săn boss dã ngoại – Đồ rơi kín màn hình
Với một quả map siêu to khổng lồ đến từ vị trí Giang Hồ Ngũ Tuyệt, cùng với hệ thống boss dã ngoại tung tăng khắp mọi nẻo đường, tôi cam kết các ông sẽ nhặt đồ to tay, khỏi cần tập gym luôn. Đồ rơi kín đặc màn hình là có thật đấy các ông ạ. Chỉ sợ các ông không có sức nhặt đồ chứ đồ rơi lúc nào mà chả Đỉnh.
5. Thần tướng nhập thân – Buff triệu lần sức mạnh. 
Đang PK, đuối quá... Làm phát Buff, tăng gấp triệu lần sức mạnh chỉ có thể là tính năng Thần Tướng trong Giang Hồ Ngũ Tuyệt. Với hệ thống thần tướng từ cấp S đến SSS đa dạng và đầy linh hoạt, tôi tin chắc là các ông chỉ có thể mê chữ ê kéo dài. Tôi thật…
6. Kết hôn sinh Bảo Bảo – Cha con cùng lâm trận
Đây rồi, một trong những tính năng khiến tôi mê nhất ở Giang Hồ Ngũ Tuyệt. Kết hôn sinh Bảo Bảo, thằng con mình đẻ ra lại có sức mạnh, cùng mình chinh phạt giang hồ luôn chứ không đơn thuần chỉ chạy theo nhõng nhẽo như những con game phèn chúa khác. Cha truyền con nối, con hơn cha là nhà có phúc… 1001 cái tục ngữ thành ngữ không thể thể hiện nổi sự tuyệt vời của tính năng này các ông ạ.
7. Siêu Phẩm Cày Chay – Săn boss rơi điểm VIP
Ngày xưa cứ phải nạp tiền mới có VIP, thằng nào giàu mới lên VIP. Bây giờ, với Giang Hồ Ngũ Tuyệt, săn boss rơi điểm VIP, cứ nhẹ nhàng mà lên VIP thôi. Hàng xịn mà! Đây mới gọi là Cày Chay đích thực này các ông ơi. Hai chữ Giàu – Nghèo hay Hơn – Thua không chỉ quyết định sau 6h chiều nữa, nó quyết định ở sự nhanh nhạy chăm chỉ của anh em trong Giang Hồ Ngũ Tuyệt đấy!
Quyết định phê duyệt nội dung kịch bản trò chơi điện tử G1 trên mạng số: 905/QĐ-BTTTT do Cục Phát thanh, truyền hình và thông tin điện tử cấp ngày 25/06/2021

bluejetty:00075581:ios.description:
Come play with the New Baby Unicorn!!! Help Mommy, Baby & Friends on a super fun filled adventure filled with magical rainbows, unicorns and makeovers!
How To Play: Use the left-bench tools to help complete the levels for a perfect Rainbow Unicorn makeover! 
Includes levels with super fun activities include makeup, feeding, dress-up time, decorating, caring for the baby unicorn and much much more! Have soo much rainbow unicorn fun!
Level 1: Help Mommy Unicorn at the spa! Wash, clean & dry!
Level 2: Decorate the new baby unicorn room! Play with the mobile, paint the wall different colors & tap the lamp to turn it on and off!
Level 3: Give a makeover, brush hair, do makeup and much more!
Level 4: Play dress up with new outfit, shoes, jewelry and more!
Level 5: Care for mommy unicorn outside!
Level 6: Play with the baby unicorn! Change diapers, give a pacifier to the crying unicorn, play with rattle and much more fun!
Level 7: Get ready for a fun nap-time! Put on outfit, play with toys, clean up & more!
Level 8: Give the baby unicorn a bubble bath!!!
Level 9: Have a fun unicorn party! 
Level 10: Play with 3 magical unicorns - pink, blue and white! Watch them hop around and have fun!
Level 11: Feed the cute pink unicorn yummy snacks, desserts & treats!
*Level 12: Take the baby unicorn for a fun stroller ride outside!
*Level 13: Help the unicorn clean up, brush teeth and much more!
*Level 14: Play in the unicorn room with fun toys, presents, lollipop & more!
*Level 15: Change fun different outfits, add necklaces, hats, glasses and do makeup!!
*Level 16: Care for the unicorn in the crib! Give a bottle, tap to turn off the night-light and watch the magical unicorn dreams!
*Level 17: Clean up & play with the unicorn - Help vacuum the room, decorate and much more!
*Level 18: Mommy unicorn car makeover! Put wings on the unicorn car!!
*Level 19: Help the very cute baby unicorn and play! 
*Level 20: It's a super fun unicorn party with all the unicorn friends & mommy unicorn!!
*Level 21: Create a delicious unicorn cake! Cut open & watch the candy fall out!
*Please note that levels 12-21 need to be unlocked with an in-app purchase.
*Please note that the game is free to play, but you are able to purchase game items, additional levels and remove ads with real money. If you don’t want to use this feature, please disable in-app purchases.

bluejetty:00153998:ios.name: Contacts
bluejetty:00153998:ios.summary: With Contacts on iOS, iPadOS and macOS, you can store and manage your and other’s contact information, birthdays, Contact Posters and more. Easily connect with your contacts with Mail, Messages, Phone, or FaceTime. Or instantly share your C
bluejetty:00153998:ios.description:
With Contacts on iOS, iPadOS and macOS, you can store and manage your and other’s contact information, birthdays, Contact Posters and more. Easily connect with your contacts with Mail, Messages, Phone, or FaceTime. Or instantly share your Contact Poster and your number or email address with someone new through NameDrop on iPhone and Apple Watch.
Manage Your Contacts
Easily add people to your contacts, and sync their contact information across all your devices with iCloud, Microsoft Exchange, Google, and other syncing services. If your contacts choose to, you can automatically get updates to their Contact Poster through Messages, Phone and FaceTime as well.
Get Connected Quickly
When you need a contact’s information, you can search to find who you’re looking for. You can then quickly message, call, FaceTime, email or even Apple Pay them. If you add their social profile to their contact card, you can jump to it with a tap. And if you add their birthday, you’ll also see it in Calendar so you never miss it.
Store Your Personal Information
Create a My Card in Contacts to store your own contact information including your phone numbers, email addresses, physical addresses, and more. You can then use the information in your My Card to use Autofill to instantly complete forms online or in apps across iOS, iPadOS and macOS.
Customize Your Contact Poster
Create a customized poster to represent yourself when you connect with others using Messages, Phone and FaceTime. Choose from various treatments for photos, Memoji and your name, and choose to automatically share it with your contacts or be asked every time before you share.
Share your Contact with NameDrop
Exchange contact information with someone new by simply bringing your iPhone near their iPhone or Apple Watch. Your name and Contact Poster are automatically included every time, and you can select the phone number or email address you want to share from your My Card along with it.
Use Contacts on Apple Watch
Select people from your contacts to use as a complication on your watch face for easy access, and quickly connect with them through Messages, Phone or Mail right from your wrist. You can also create new contacts and customize existing contacts, or exchange contact information with someone new using NameDrop with their iPhone or Apple Watch.

bluejetty:00131431:ios.description:
Turo is a better car rental app for travelers who want to rent a car without the rental counter. Skip the lines, and the "or similar" excuses of traditional rental companies. Turo is reinventing car rental through its marketplace, where you can book the exact car you want from a community of local hosts across the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and France.
Rent a car. Not a rental car.
Whether it’s a rugged 4x4 for a weekend escape, a sleek EV for a city sprint, or a spacious van for the whole family, Turo adapts to your purpose and your preference. With over 16,000 cities covered, the keys to independence are always within reach.
Why Turo?
• Selection: From luxury car rental to everyday drivers, find a vehicle that fits your vibe and budget.
• Confidence: What you see is what you drive. Book the exact make and model. No bait-and-switch.
• Convenience: Skip the rental counter. Many hosts offer car rental delivery to the airport, your hotel, or even your doorstep.
• Flexibility: Plans change. Enjoy flexible cancellation and easy trip extensions right in the app.
• 24/7 Support: We’ve got your back with around-the-clock customer service and roadside assistance.
• Hospitality: Browse real reviews to find trusted hosts who provide a seamless, personalized experience.
Take the wheel of your own business:
• Join the more than 100,000 hosts who have turned their cars into income engines. Turo provides the platform, the guests, and the protection options—you provide the keys.
• Build your fleet: List one car or ten. You’re in total control of your pricing and availability.
• Rest easy: Benefit from third-party liability insurance and physical damage protection options on every trip.
Turo. Rental reinvented.

bluejetty:00128791:ios.name: Airplane Games for Kids
bluejetty:00128791:ios.summary: Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading,
bluejetty:00128791:ios.description:
Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading, and more. Curated by experts, the content fosters curiosity, creativity, and confidence in young learners, assisting them as they grow. 
SKIDOS PASS: ALL IN ONE
With the SKIDOS Pass, children explore a safe and age-appropriate space with 1000+ fun and engaging activities, gaining life skills and receiving positive reinforcement for academic success. Parents can create up to 6 personalized profiles for their kids. and customize each according to age, gameplay preferences, and subjects to learn. Monitoring kids' progress is easy - learning reports in the app or via email give you a simple overview of their growth and challenges.
GAMEPLAY:
SKIDOS Airplane Games for Kids
Get ready for an exciting flight! But first, you need to build your own plane. Learn where to put wings, propellers, windows & wheels to assemble an airplane. Take your plane for an exciting flight & master piloting skills while avoiding obstacles. Celebrate your successful flight & start your adventure with the next plane. 
Features:
- Assemble planes like 3D puzzles
- Pick from 10+ airplanes
- Avoid obstacles & collect stars to complete the flight
LEARNING CURRICULUM
Our curriculum mixes engaging games with learning content, improving your child's learning skills and promoting active play.
MATH: Our math exercises cover a comprehensive list of topics, including number sense, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, geometry, and more. Tasks evolve as your child progresses. Interactive design and animations help support learning - three cute SKIDOS mascots will offer assistance, encouraging kids while they work on the assignments.
TRACING LETTERS & NUMBERS: You can pick tracing letters and numbers for your child to practice. A ladybird will show your little learner how to trace with their finger, while visuals and voiceovers teach new words and counting.
READING: Children will be introduced to the world of phonics, sounds, letters, and reading. Interactive designs and smart prompts help kids make their first confident steps toward reading, while storytelling with songs keeps them engaged and curious about new learning journeys.
EMOTIONAL WELLBEING: Through engaging activities, kids learn to understand and express their emotions and nurture positive attitudes.
EDUCATIONAL VIDEOS: Our video content piques kids' curiosity in a fun and easy way. We've curated just the right mix of entertainment & learning in our video catalogue.
SAFE & AD-FREE
SKIDOS ensures an ad-free online environment, providing kids with a positive and uninterrupted learning experience. Our apps are COPPA & GDPR-compliant.
ABOUT THE SKIDOS PASS SUBSCRIPTION:
- We offer monthly, quarterly, bi-annual and annual auto-renewable subscriptions
- Every subscription starts with a 3-day Free Trial
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account only after a free trial period, wherever applicable
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing cycle
- The user may turn off the subscription auto-renewal in the user's device Account Settings
- Cancellation goes into effect at the end of the current billing cycle
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a SKIDOS pass, where applicable
Privacy Policy: http://skidos.com/privacy-policy
Terms & Conditions: https://skidos.com/terms/
Support: support@skidos.com

Goodbye chaos, hello Family Operating SystemⓇ. Trustworthy keeps your important information organized, protected, and optimized so you can be prepared for all of life’s moments, enjoy peace of mind and celebrate your accomplishments.

Everything in the right place.
Trustworthy is the only app that gives you a single view of your important family information–family IDs, money, property, passwords, insurance, taxes, estate documents, emergency documents, and more. Say goodbye to disorganization and hello to knowing exactly where everything is.

Everyone working together. 
Share your information with the right people at the right time. Trustworthy is the place where modern families collaborate, now and across generations.

Every asset, beautifully organized.
Trustworthy automatically arranges your information into a beautifully organized view that makes it easy to find what you’re looking for. No tagging, classification or thinking required. 

Advanced security for every family.
Level up your family information security with Trustworthy, the online service for families that exceeds industry standards for security and privacy. 

Expert help, whenever you need it.
Get the help you need to get organized–from an Expert. Your Trustworthy Expert can coach you on digital organization, help you find lost documents, and even set up your Family Operating SystemⓇ for you.

Thousands of successful modern families use Trustworthy. Here is what they are saying:

“I cannot even put into words how great it feels to know everything is here for my wife and family! We had so many files (paper) and I just scanned using the mobile app and BOOM done!”
-David G. 

“Using Trustworthy made me appreciate how many different accounts, IDs, and important documents we have as a family. Now they’re all in one place, so wherever we travel, we can look them up instantly.” 
-Korina S.

“I have been searching for something with a clean interface that made accessing my information easy for me, but also easy for my wife and family to understand.” 
-Sunaubh P.

Privacy Policy: https://www.trustworthy.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.trustworthy.com/terms

bluejetty:00069983:ios.description:
Ever felt like you can't complete a goal? Or that you can't break a bad habit?
Sometimes you just need to have patience to achieve your goals, and the aim of this app is to help you with that.
Just create a counter inside the app and start counting! The counter will keep counting upwards, showing you the days since you quit your habit(until you stop it). The app isn't limited to one counter either, you can create up to 3 different types of counters in the app for free.
It can be used for things like quitting soda, fast food, smoking or almost anything else.
There's also a ranking system for how long you've abstained from your bad habit to give you a new-found sense of achievement.
If you use up all of your three counter slots you can send some counters you aren't using anymore to your 'archive' and restore them when you need them again.
If you're looking for a days since counter, this is it. Don't delay things any further, try it today!

Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/kintimer-terms

bluejetty:00146487:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00146487:ios.description:
Attention is the most important skill and resource of the 21st century. Lemio helps you master it!
Make every minute of your life intentional and let Lemio help you reduce your screen time.
More focus, health, productivity, and time.
Less procrastination, stress, depression, and anxiety.
**Finally a screen time app that is effective without being annoying.**
**With Apple's features I used to subconsciously click "one more minute". Lemio solves that with session times!**
**My favorite app to embrace being offline and living in the moment!**
**Lemio holds me accountable to create more than I consume. The instant feedback I get from the app helps me to be more active and motivated.**
**Not only has it helped me to get rid of my phone addiction, it has inspired me to start 3 new daily habits! Thanks Lemio.**
OUR FEATURES Focus on:
- Saving you time
- Being in control of your life
- Starting doing what you've been putting off
We all struggle with our smartphone addiction. Lemio stops you in the moments of unconscious, impulsive and compulsive phone use and transitions you from mindless doomscrolling to useful & healthy habits.
Time limit per session - Each app should be used with intention, but at the same time remain easily accessible. That is why Lemio forces you to choose a session time for each entry. Your brain will learn that this choice has consequences, because Lemio will kick you out of the app when your session time is up.
No more doomscrolling - When your session time ends, we will lock the distracting app again and bring you back to reality in case you got distracted and sucked in.
Neuroscientific Breathing - There is a way to de-stress and calm your brain in a matter of seconds. It's called the physiological sigh, a breathing exercise based on the science of how crying babies calm down. We introduce it every time we detect abusive behavior.
The Attention Masterclass - Attention is both a skill and a mental resource. It allows us to navigate life efficiently, learn, build relationships, and have successful careers. It can be trained, and Lemio teaches you how.
WHY LEMIO IS NEEDED
There are several reasons for this:
Focus and attention span are constantly decreasing: Attention span has dropped from 12 seconds (2000) to 8.25 seconds (2021), below the level of a goldfish. Studies also show that humans need about 20 minutes for deep focus, while the average phone pickup time for GenY and younger is about every 7 minutes.
Phone procrastination is real: Research shows that 32% of screen time during work hours and 57% at home is completely unintentional procrastination.
Smartphone addiction is a disease: Excessive smartphone use has been linked to impaired cognitive function and mental health issues such as stress, depression, and self-harm.
Lemio is on a mission to stop all of this. We increase your productivity, help you overcome phone distractions, and take back control.
At the same time, Lemio is a place for inspiration, motivation, accountability, and social interaction with like-minded people. We want to teach you useful and healthy habits and prove that science and biohacking can be fun! Our mission is complete when Lemio becomes your place for personal development, growth, goal setting and goal achievement.
Our dream is to change the way people think & live. Our vision is that people will only pick up their phones when they have a good reason to do so. At the same time, we want to help people accelerate in life by building know-how, identity and real-life relationships with the phone as an enabler, not a time parasite.
Start today and turn screen time into life time!
Available Subscription Options:
Lemio Premium (Monthly / Annual / Lifetime)
Terms (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.lemioapp.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00073209:ios.name: HeartMath
bluejetty:00073209:ios.summary:
Align your heart, mind, and emotions to help you manage stress, improve focus, and perform at your best.
Enjoy HeartMath’s free intro experience to access your heart’s natural intelligence and see your heart-brain coherence as real-time fe
bluejetty:00073209:ios.description:
Align your heart, mind, and emotions to help you manage stress, improve focus, and perform at your best.
Enjoy HeartMath’s free intro experience to access your heart’s natural intelligence and see your heart-brain coherence as real-time feedback. Then start your 7-day free trial to explore a comprehensive collection of guided sessions, immersive journeys, and coherence practices designed to help you experience greater calm, focus, clearer thinking, and a more balanced you.
**Inner Balance Coherence Plus sensor owners: Use your sensor to unlock a lifetime subscription.**
Built on 30+ years of research on the heart-brain connection and supported by over 500 research studies, HeartMath is used in wellness and resilience programs at organizations including Stanford Healthcare and Kaiser Permanente, as well as in professional sports, the military, law enforcement, leading universities, non-profit organizations, and major corporations. It is used by coaches, trainers, and health professionals for stress education and resilience training.
The HeartMath system is more than stress management: it’s a journey to more heart-centered living. This app puts HeartMath’s practical, research-supported tools right at your fingertips. Make mental and emotional well-being an achievable part of your daily life.
The HeartMath technology is for stress education and resilience training. It is not a medical device. We encourage you to consult a health professional before making any medical decisions.
KEY FEATURES
• Real-time HRV coherence feedback: Use your phone’s camera or upgrade to the Inner Balance Coherence Plus sensor for a more precise signal and a free app subscription.
• Coherence training: Whether you choose the game or the guided mode, watch your heart-rhythm pattern and coherence change in real time.
• Research-Supported: Techniques developed from 30+ years of scientific research to help boost focus, positive feelings, and your ability to manage stress.
• Guided learning: Explore guided meditations, courses, and videos led by HeartMath trainers.
• Progress tracking: View your progress over time with a variety of chart options.
WHAT REGULAR COHERENCE PRACTICE CAN SUPPORT
Heart-brain coherence is a balanced, focused state you create yourself through calm breathing and positive focus. Coherence supports the body’s natural ability to shift from tension to calm, helping you manage everyday stress and build inner balance.
• SUPPORTS STRESS MANAGEMENT & EMOTIONAL BALANCE
• SUPPORTS FOCUS AND MENTAL CLARITY — coherent states are associated with more focus, clarity, and creativity.
• SUPPORTS RESILIENCE — regular practice can help you adapt to and recover from challenging situations more quickly.
• ENHANCES EMOTIONAL WELL-BEING AND SELF-AWARENESS — practice can support a greater sense of inner calm and a more mindful relationship with your emotions.
Subscription terms:
• Subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each year.
• You can cancel your subscription at any time in your account settings.
• You will not be refunded for any unused portion of a subscription.
• Price is subject to change.
• Subscriptions are not available in all countries.
• Full subscription terms: https://my.heartmath.com/terms
If you’d like to purchase an Inner Balance Coherence Plus sensor to unlock complimentary lifetime access to the HeartMath app, please visit the HeartMath website.

bluejetty:00074386:ios.description:
Canary is home security made simple. The Canary app works with our security devices to connect your home to your phone, allowing you to view and protect those that matter most. 
Monitor your home: Watch live or recorded HD videos day or night. Access Canary’s timeline for a living history of your home. Save and bookmark your favorite clips.
Intelligent notifications: When Canary identifies something out of the ordinary, you’ll get a notification with recorded HD video of the event, as well as the option to watch live.
Automatic arming: Canary changes modes when you come and go. No complicated keypads or codes to remember. 
- Away
When all members are away Canary monitors for activity and sends notifications
- Home
When a member is home Canary is customizable. You can set notification and privacy preferences.
- Night
Schedule Canary to monitor for activity while you sleep.
- Privacy
Camera and microphone are completely off.
Emergency Options: Respond to incidents directly from the Canary app. Trigger the 90 decibel siren, or be connected directly to your home’s local emergency responders.
A healthier home: Canary’s HomeHealth Technology™ monitors indoor air quality, temperature, and humidity. It all adds up to a smarter and safer home.
Love your Canary? We read and appreciate every single review. Want to suggest a feature? 
Get in touch!
--
Email: support@canary.is
Facebook: Canary
Twitter: @canary
Instagram: @caughtbycanary
From time to time, the Canary auto-mode switching feature may briefly access your GPS in order to have high confidence in your location. Battery life is very important to us and we do many things to ensure we use it sparingly. Please be aware that continued use of GPS services running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00077222:ios.name: Hero Adventure: Rogue Survivor
bluejetty:00077222:ios.summary: Have you heard the expression "Hell is empty and all the devils are here."? The words of the great classic turned out to be prophetic. For centuries, a brotherhood of immortal heroes held back the passage between the world of the living and
bluejetty:00077222:ios.description:
Have you heard the expression "Hell is empty and all the devils are here."? The words of the great classic turned out to be prophetic. For centuries, a brotherhood of immortal heroes held back the passage between the world of the living and the dead. But dark forces have risen from hell and filled the dungeons of an ancient castle on the outskirts of London. Werewolves. Vampires. Demons. All the dark forces crave a bloody reign throughout the world. All your brothers-in-arms are in custody. You are the only immortal hero who can clear the dark dungeons teeming with evil spirits.
An adventure filled with many challenges, battles and demonic bosses awaits you. The world is on the brink of death. Only you depend on the fate of all mankind, because you are a hereditary hunter of evil. Let the demon hunt begin!
· IMMORTAL HEROES
You have the right to create your own hero! You know yourself like no one else. Choose what's closest to you. You can become a vampire, an arsonist, a master of poisons or electricity. Each hero has a unique mastery and skills. This is what will help you in the fight against evil.
· HUNTER EQUIPMENT
Every hunter should have a good outfit. What will you choose to use: a winchester, a revolver, or a Tesla gun? Or maybe you decide to use a crossbow? It's up to you. You can test your strength in the Arena against other players. You won't be left alone in battle. A gargoyle, a dragon or the spirits of fire, ice and death can come to your aid.
· IDLE MERCENARIES
Abilities, outfits, weapons and assistants need to be improved. To do this, you will need a huge amount of rubies. There's an easy way to earn them. After freeing the imprisoned heroes, you can recruit them. Rubies will accumulate even when you are not playing.
· DUNGEON LIBERATION
You have to go through many quests. Explore every corner of the dungeon, because many dangers can lurk in the dark. You never know in what part of the ancient castle you will meet the next boss. You have to be prepared for that. You can find yourself in battle with both the Soul Eater and the Vampire Lord.
Hero Adventure is a game that will immerse you in the Victorian era and give you the opportunity to become a real hero of the century. The fate of all mankind is in your hands. Use all the possibilities, calculate the moves, destroy the evil spirits and do not let it fill everything around. Keep the balance of light and darkness in the world.
If you have any questions, comments or suggestions, you can always write to us!
Our mail: help@pgstudio.io
See you in the dungeon, hunter!

The new and improved JLab app offers complete customization for all JLab App compatible models. Adjust Noise Control settings, Be Aware, touch controls, safe listening levels, and sound to your personal preference – or use the presets for JLab Signature, Balanced, or Bass Boost. Plus, get software updates for your product right when they’re available.
Active Noise Cancellation Control
With the new JLab App, you'll be able to increase the active noise canceling from off all the way to max ANC, (on your ANC compatible earbuds) while in the earbuds themselves you can only select on or off.
Be Aware Audio
Bring the outside in. Use the JLab App to increase or decrease the amount of outside noise you let in by adjusting your Be Aware settings. (For Be Aware Compatible earbuds only)
EQ Customization
Fine tune your sound by adjusting the equalizer settings. JLab products come set with three default settings - called Custom EQ3 Sound, which features JLab Signature, Balanced and Bass Boost and a 4th option 'Custom'. Use the JLab App to test and set your own equalizer settings by adjusting Bass (200, 280, 400 Hz levels), Mid-Range (550, 770, 1000, 2000 Hz levels) and Treble (4000, 8000, 16000 Hz levels).
Custom Controls
JLab products come with controls in each earbud that control anything from volume, track changes, play/pause and more. If you'd like to switch the settings, you can customize your controls further via the app.
Safe Hearing
All future JLab models will now support Safe Hearing. Switch between the default output, 95 dB, or 85 dB for a safe listening experience.

BLEND is a powerful employee scheduling and team management app.

Blend's smart algorithm will help you create the most optimal schedules in minutes. It allows managers to auto-create weekly rotas by allocating shifts to the right employees. Scheduling employees has never been so easy! 
Every time the schedule is updated each employee receives a push notification. Employees use the app to submit day-off requests and to view their next shift.
A smart employee scheduling software can save you many hours every week, and create a better work environment for your team. It is also super easy to use by both managers and employees. 
Why managers love it:
- Manage everything on the go, shift, chat, tasks, announcements 
- Cost-effective rota in minutes not hours
- Personalised shift information to each employee via push notification
- The app will suggest shift replacements and alert staff on scheduling updates 
- Quickly approve employee off duty and vacation requests

bluejetty:00162482:ios.summary: De gratis NRC-app biedt het laatste nieuws, achtergronden, interviews en natuurlijk de digitale versie van de papieren krant. Bovendien vind je er podcasts, columns en puzzels. En vind je er de mogelijkheid om jouw eigen nieuwsbundel samen
bluejetty:00162482:ios.description:
De gratis NRC-app biedt het laatste nieuws, achtergronden, interviews en natuurlijk de digitale versie van de papieren krant. Bovendien vind je er podcasts, columns en puzzels. En vind je er de mogelijkheid om jouw eigen nieuwsbundel samen te stellen en altijd op de hoogte te zijn van jouw onderwerpen.
In het tabblad ‘nieuws’ kom je te weten wat er speelt: het belangrijkste nieuws staat altijd bovenaan. Iets gelezen dat je wilt delen? Dit kan gemakkelijk via de deelknop. Ben je graag direct op de hoogte bij urgent nieuws? Stel notificaties in.
Een artikel dat je later wilt lezen, sla je op in jouw persoonlijke leeslijst. Dit kan zowel vanuit de digitale krant als vanuit het tabblad ‘nieuws’. Jouw leeslijst wordt gesynchroniseerd op alle apparaten waar je bent ingelogd.
Je kunt onderwerpen volgen bij NRC om een persoonlijk nieuwsoverzicht te creëren. Er worden onderaan elk artikel passende onderwerpen voorgesteld om te volgen. Bijvoorbeeld: Amerikaanse politiek of kunstmatige intelligentie. Ook andere nieuwsthema’s, columnisten en rubrieken vind je terug in de app. Volg je een aantal onderwerpen, dan ontstaat in de ‘Mijn Nieuws’-sectie een persoonlijke bundel met verhalen. Je kan ook notificaties instellen voor jouw onderwerpen.
Luister je liever naar artikelen? Al onze artikelen zijn in de app te beluisteren. Onze journalistiek wordt ingesproken door stemmen die gebaseerd zijn op het stemgeluid van twee van onze redacteuren.
Luister je liever een podcast? NRC biedt eigen podcasts aan over verschillende actuele onderwerpen, maar ook series over cultuur, misdaad of geschiedenis. Of luister naar een van de tips van onze podcastredactie.
Dagelijks om 23:00 uur staat de nieuwste krant klaar in de app. Na het downloaden van de krant kan je offline blijven lezen. Als niet-abonnee kan je losse kranten kopen in de app. Abonnees van NRC kunnen de digitale krant onbeperkt lezen.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

We don't know since when, a large group of monsters attacking human beings suddenly appeared in the world.
Fortunately, in times of crisis, humans find that they can be sealed with a magic capsule and can once again summon the monsters in the capsule to fight for themselves.
These people who summon and command monsters are called Summoner.
Summoning a sufficient number of monsters to attack is the key to victory. At the same time, we should also be careful that monsters that are left alone are easily killed by the enemy.
When necessary, some special monsters can also evolve into more powerful combat forces!
Game features:
1. Summon dozens of small monsters of different shapes, and some rare monsters can still evolve.
2. Watch the fierce scene of the monsters fighting.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1. Our VIP subscription is divided into one week, one month and one year by time. The prices are $7.99, $14.99 and $59.99 respectively.

The subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period, and the renewal fee will be determined.

Subscriptions can be managed by the user, and automatic renewal can be turned off by going to the user's "Account Settings" after purchase.
Any unused portion of the free trial period (if provided) will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription for the publication (if applicable).
You can turn off the automatic renewal of your subscription at any time through iTunes. After the current trial/subscription period expires, you will be unsubscribed. The current active subscription period cannot be cancelled. When your subscription expires, you will no longer be able to use the elements included in the "Subscription" option.

bluejetty:00115311:ios.description:
Podiums is where your taste comes to life. Rate, rank, and review movies, TV shows, music, movies, podcasts, and artists—all in one place. Unlike other niche-specific rating apps, Podiums gives you a complete view of what your friends are into and helps you discover your next favorite.
A Smarter Way to Rate
 No more stressing over what rating number feels right. With Podiums, you rank what you like, playing a mini game where you choose which was better between two pieces of content, and we turn it into an accurate score. It’s easy, fun, and pressure-free to share your real opinions.
Connect Through Taste
See what your friends are actually into, follow people with great recommendations, and discover new media through real profiles—not faceless algorithms. 
Everything in One Authentic Profile
Movies, music, shows, and podcasts—your full taste lives in one profile, so anyone can instantly get your vibe. Podiums is built on authentic taste and real interests, no fake posts, bots, or photoshop to be found.
Personalized Discovery
Organize your content with tags, connect Spotify for tailor-made music suggestions, and browse a massive library of hundreds of thousands of titles ready to rate and review.
Podiums makes it simple to show what you love, discover media that matches your vibe, and connect authentically with friends.

bluejetty:00157259:ios.summary: Leave the waiting rooms behind. Log into UW Health Care Anywhere to get easy, quick access to a primary care provider, whenever you and your family need non-emergency care. From the comfort of your home or work – even in the palm of your ha
bluejetty:00157259:ios.description:
Leave the waiting rooms behind. Log into UW Health Care Anywhere to get easy, quick access to a primary care provider, whenever you and your family need non-emergency care. From the comfort of your home or work – even in the palm of your hand – UW Health Care Anywhere is available 24/7, providing video doctor visits using your smartphone, tablet or computer equipped with a web camera.
The process is fast and easy. Download the UW Health Care Anywhere mobile app and set up an account – you’ll be one step ahead when you need to see a doctor.
Feel better, faster. With UW Health Care Anywhere, you may see a health care provider within minutes for conditions including:
· Bronchitis
· Cough
· Cold
· Flu
· Fever
· Sinus infection
· Respiratory infection
· Sore throat
· Urinary tract infection
· Vomiting
· Diarrhea
· Pinkeye
· Sprains and strains
· Headache
Depending on the issue, the health care provider can provide a diagnosis, suggest follow-up care and prescribe medication, when appropriate. Providers are available to see you for a video visit 24 hours a day, every day of the year. Not all illnesses can be addressed via UW Health Care Anywhere – if necessary, you may be directed to go to the Emergency Department to receive care in person.
If you are an Apple Health user you will have the option to share important health information with your provider during your video visit. Sharing Apple Health data is optional but allows the provider to see heart rate, weight, and other health information to help them make a more accurate diagnosis.

B
bluejetty:00041170:ios.description:
iUFlow app is a Bladder Diary on your mobile. Download to track and monitor toilet trips.
Bladder Diary. iUFlow is a fully automated voiding / bladder and stool diary.
It is FREE and UNLIMITED toilet diary (pee log, runpee and stool log).
Best for Bladder tracking.
Urine tracker enables the recording of intake and output (urine) to track bladder activities, as well as recording bowel movement - poo - using a Bristol chart (to track normal, constipation, diarrhea etc) for a perfect digestive tracker and poo journal.
Keep track of your bladder and bowel movements easily on your mobile, then easily share the diary with your doctor. A complete urine log or a bathroom log is a basic source of data for treatment.
You can use the Bladder Diary App as a comfortable water/urine reminder during the time of completing your electronic bladder diary. It's better than a water tracker. Finally, an easy way to remember to drink more water!
The app further allows the automation of the urine measurement (flow rate uroflow) by using the iUFlow device which is an optional item.
The iUFlow Uroflowmeter is currently available for orders in US and AUS.
A detailed bladder diary may be important and useful for health issues related to kidneys, sleep behaviors, the cardiovascular system, prostate enlargement, urinary incontinence, and Lower Urinary Tract symptoms (LUTS).
The app can be used freely!

bluejetty:00034090:ios.description:
Get ready for a super fun matching time in Match Mansion!
If you love stuff sorting, 3d items and house makeover, then the triple match 3d game of Match Mansion is gonna rock your world!
In this puzzle game, you'll sort tiles of fruits, drinks, toys and candy objects and explore the fun of triple matching in 3d cupboards, unlocking more of your favorite objects, just like in most matching games. 
Match 3d items, crack fun puzzles, unlock new areas, decorate your Mansion and get extra boosters to keep the happy match going. Match Mansion is bursting with vivid colors, vibrant sounds, and charming animations across its 3d puzzle levels.
Playing is easy – just tap the same 3d tiles to board for triple matching. Be the Master of 3d puzzles, but remember, time's ticking in this match 3d game! Each level has a timer, so you gotta think quick and move even quicker to win!
Match Mansion is chill yet addictive, with a snazzy look that'll keep you hooked. Earn coins to renovate the mansion bit by bit and uncover its secrets. It's totally captivating!
Easy to play but hard to master, Match Mansion offers a range of powerful boosters to breeze through tricky bits, unlocking sweet treats like fruits, candy, cake, and more!
Need a break from stress? Match Mansion is your answer! Whether you're a newbie or a pro, Match Mansion's got your back.
So if you're into match 3d games, don't wait! Try out Match Mansion for FREE now! Take a break, solve puzzles, and enjoy some chill sorting fun!
Let's go on a Match Mansion adventure today!

DEX Screener is a powerful and easy-to-use platform that allows traders and investors to track and analyze real-time data from multiple decentralized exchanges and chains. With DEX Screener, users can easily monitor the price, trading volume, and on-chain trades of various tokens, and use that data to make informed decisions about their investments.
Some key features of DEX Screener include:
- Real-time charts and trades
- Unlimited watchlists
- Unlimited price alerts

- Support for 60+ chains, hundreds of DEXes and hundreds of thousands of pairs
With millions of users, DEX Screener is a trusted and widely used platform among crypto traders and investors. Whether you're a seasoned trader or just getting started in the world of crypto, DEX Screener is an invaluable resource for anyone looking to make the most of their investments.

bluejetty:00177822:ios.name: iTransfer Pro
bluejetty:00177822:ios.summary: iTransfer Pro is the Pro Version of iTransfer, the No. 1 App for file transfer on iPhone/iPad. Besides all the features available on iTransfer, the Pro Version has more features, which are essential to business and professional users, inclu
bluejetty:00177822:ios.description:
iTransfer Pro is the Pro Version of iTransfer, the No. 1 App for file transfer on iPhone/iPad. Besides all the features available on iTransfer, the Pro Version has more features, which are essential to business and professional users, including Dropbox, Box, OneDrive, and GoogleDrive access. 
Supported features include: 
1. Download files from your iCloud Drive. Save local files to iCloud Drive.
2. Upload/download files to/from FTP/SFTP/FTPS servers, DropBox, Box, OneDrive, and GoogleDrive. 
3. Support both user name/password and Private Key authentication for SFTP. Support both PPK and PEM keys. Support importing keys from/exporting keys to iCloud Drive under iTransfer/keys folder.
4. Email files. 
5. Manage files, including adding a folder, searching, renaming, moving or deleting files. 
6. View supported files, including: PDF, DOC, EXCEL, PPT, image files, TXT, etc.
7. Open files using other Apps through “Open in”. 
8. Play photo slideshows. 
9. Playback music and videos. 
10. Support launching with a password. 
11. Print documents.
12. Share photos on Facebook, Twitter and Weibo. 
With its simple interfaces, iTransfer Pro provides the easiest way to transfer files on iPhone and iPad. 
If you have any questions, please visit: http://www.comcsoft.com/Portfolio/our_apps/iTransfer/iTransfer_overview.php.

bluejetty:00014046:ios.summary:
Eight is a free-to-use business card scanning app that lets you connect with valuable new contacts. Our advanced scanning technology ensures that each business card is captured with precision.
Eight accurately digitizes business card infor
bluejetty:00014046:ios.description:
Eight is a free-to-use business card scanning app that lets you connect with valuable new contacts. Our advanced scanning technology ensures that each business card is captured with precision.
Eight accurately digitizes business card information in multiple languages, scanning every detail. Manage your professional network easily from your smartphone, and create digital business cards to share your contact information with anyone via QR code or link.
//Main features//
**Unlimited FREE digitization**
AI-powered business card scanning trusted by 3.7+ million users. It scan and digitizes all the information on the front in multiple languages, , ensuring nothing is missed.
**Quickly find the contact info you need**
Search by name, company name, department, or position, and use full-text search of memos and grouping by tags, to quickly find the information you need after scanning biz cards.
**Stay up to date with your professional network**
When you connect with someone via Eight, you’ll be notified when they change their biz card because of a career move such as a promotion or job change. You can also message your contacts via Eight and build your relationships, , keeping scanned information current.
**Automatic profile creation**
Simply snap a photo of a biz card and our proprietary digitization rapidly and accurately creates a digital profile.
**Digital card sharing **
Eight users can just open the app, hold their phones together, and exchange digital cards immediately. If the other person doesn’t use Eight, share a QR code or URL that links to your Virtual Card and scanned information.
//More benefits//
* Always free
* Use the web version of Eight on your PC
* Unlimited cloud storage capacity and duration for all scanned cards
*1-touch digital card exchange
//Eight is for those seeking…//
- A free business card scanning and management app to keep track of contacts and companies
- An easy way to swap digital contacts whether or not you’re carrying a paper business card
- A tool to search for and keep track of contact and customer information after scanning
- An easy way to manage your paper business cards with scanning
- Info on career movements and changes among your professional network
- A way to quickly create an online digital business profile with your skills and work history
- A more feature-rich and accurate business card canning app
//Eight Premium puts you a step ahead//
Almost all of Eight’s functions are free. But add on Eight Premium and you’ll take it up a notch. 
-Digitize both sides of a business card using enhanced scanning to create a complete digital card
-Batch download business card data to create cutomer lists from scanned cards
-Integrate with phone book apps, all for a small monthly fee
**Eight Premium pricing and terms**
* 600 yen/month or 6,000 yen/year (auto-renewed, paid in local currency)
* Billed to your Apple ID.
*The subscription will auto-renew unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of your subscription period. You’ll be billed within 24 hours before the period expires.
* Manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in your Account Settings in the iTunes Store.
* Canceling your Eight subscription does not cancel auto-renewal.
* You cannot cancel within the Eight Premium usage period.
* Terms of Use – https://8card.net/en/kiyaku
* Personal Information Protection Policy – https://8card.net/en/privacy
** Frequently Asked Questions **
-How do you securely manage business card information?
We encrypt scanned business card information to ensure its safety.
I-s it easy to scan business cards?
Yes, simply hold the business card in front of the camera, and it can be easily digitized into a digital format.
Got a new feature you want to see added or feedback for the Eight team? We hear you! Email us at support@8card.net

bluejetty:00044082:ios.name: Moshi Play: Games for Kids
bluejetty:00044082:ios.summary:
Ad-free and kid safe. Award-winning, fun, educational games designed for babies and toddlers aged 2-8 set in the BAFTA-award winning world of Moshi Monsters.
Learn as you play with 100s of activities including math matching, pet dress up,
bluejetty:00044082:ios.description:
Ad-free and kid safe. Award-winning, fun, educational games designed for babies and toddlers aged 2-8 set in the BAFTA-award winning world of Moshi Monsters.
Learn as you play with 100s of activities including math matching, pet dress up, colouring, drawing, puzzles, role play shopping games, bubble pop, memory, matching, hide & seek, ice cream & more. Feel rewarded as you learn by collecting stickers you can use in your sticker book, a sandbox creative experiencing where you can use your stickers interactively to create fun scenes.
Help your child learn and play with a wide variety of educational games and creative activities designed for preschoolers and young kids:
- Creative Play: Colouring and drawing, including ABC coloring to support early phonics and literacy.
- Math Games: Build numeracy skills through fun addition and subtraction activities.
- Puzzles & Problem-Solving: Solve jigsaws, practice memory skills, and strengthen pattern recognition.
- Calming Activities: Relax with simple, soothing games like Bubble Pop.
- Role Play Shopping Games: Fulfill silly ice cream orders or grocery shopping lists, and enjoy imaginative play.
- Dress Up Game: Style your favorite Moshi characters with customizable outfits, hats, colors, and accessories.
As kids explore, they earn collectible stickers to decorate their very own sticker book—making learning feel rewarding and fun.
With Moshi, every activity is designed to support early learning, creativity, confidence, and focus in a safe, ad-free environment.
EXPLORE
Discover the magical world of Moshi, where you can journey through vibrant locations filled with your favorite characters. From exploring the colorful Rainbow Realm, the lush Gombala Gombala Jungle and the many wonders of Moshi Picchu, to diving into Potion Ocean or stepping into the rhythm of Music Island, Moshi Play offers a world full of enchanting adventures. Plus, collect stickers and stamps each day that can be used to decorate your own Moshi-themed sticker book. The more you play, the more themed sticker packs you can earn and add to each page of your sticker book.
PLAY & LEARN
Play healthy, educational games designed especially for kids that aid pre-school development.
With hours of engaging activities, games and puzzles: whether you’re learning ABCs and painting with colors and patterns in Coloring, Free Drawing independently, fulfilling Ice Scream orders, Dressing Up your favorite Moshlings, finding the missing moshlings in Hide & Seek, or pairing your favorite characters in memory - there’s always something fun to explore.
SAFE & KID FRIENDLY
Moshi Play was purpose-built for early learners to align with developmental needs of young kids, with safe, healthy, fun and educational games in a parent-trusted environment that’s 100% ad-free and kid-safe.
ABOUT MOSHI
Moshi is the BAFTA award winning brand behind Moshi Monsters and Moshi Kids, set in the beloved world of Moshi.
At Moshi, we aim to empower and entertain the next generation with uniquely engaging, beloved digital products safe for their development.
GET IN TOUCH
We always welcome questions, suggestions and comments via our Customer Support team or through our socials.
Get in touch: : play@moshikids.com
Follow @playmoshikids on IG, TikTok & Facebook.
LEGALS
Terms & Conditions: https://www.moshikids.com/terms-conditions/
Privacy Policy: https://www.moshikids.com/privacy-policy/
