bluejetty:00146001:ios.description:
MyBody is a personalized meal & tracking app as well as your personal weight loss assistant. Our meal planner and carb counter will help you organize your meals and find healthy recipes suitable for anyone wanting to get healthier and fit.
Manage and monitor your weight easily - track your health progress!
Our program offers flexible customization while staying within the recommended amounts of carbs, protein, sugar, and other essential metrics.
Our team of qualified nutritionists created these meal plans and diet recipes to help you improve your health and lose weight.
We believe that every person deserves to live the best life possible. Therefore, we ensured that you would enjoy this diet without being forced to eat the foods you don’t like.
Our fitness professionals also prepared a list of exercises you can do without any equipment. Boost your chances of achieving desired results anywhere and anytime with a weight loss program. Work out at home!
We work to cater to your successful transition into a healthier lifestyle and guide you along the way with 24/7 support. Try it out today and get ready for positive, life-changing results!
MYBODY FEATURES
A PERSONALIZED MEAL PLANNER
Get a customizable meal plan created to fit your body’s needs: your total calorie intake, recommended amount of carbs, sugar, cholesterol, and other vital metrics.
SHOPPING LIST FOR YOUR CONVENIENCE
Find all your meal plan ingredients faster and easier with a categorized weekly shopping list.
AT-HOME WORKOUTS FOR YOUR WELL-BEING
Complete simple yet effective challenges, or opt-out for a personal workout plan that’s entirely based on your preferences. Work out at home and improve your health with our weight loss program!
YOUR HEALTH PROGRESS TRACKER
Easily monitor & track your calories and macros, weight, workouts, and water intake - all in one place! Track your steps and calories burned. Sync heart rate and step data from your Apple Health app.
SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
MyBody offers paid and auto-renewing subscription options in order to access the general functionality of the app. Workout subscriptions are excluded from the general subscription and are available as a separate subscription-based purchase.
Pricing for the subscriptions may vary based on region, and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence. The subscription will automatically renew unless canceled in advance.
Download our tracker & log app and start monitoring and improving your health. Find healthy recipes and organize your diet with our meal planner and carb counter. Start your weight loss journey!
---

bluejetty:00145756:ios.description:
Wolow is a wake on LAN app that allows you to remotely start up a computer by sending a "magic packet" request.
Simply add a device configuration inside the app, select the device you would like to start up and then press the power button and as long as your configuration is correct you can watch your computer startup.

bluejetty:00068017:ios.description:
Welcome to Mancala, the classic African board game that's been enjoyed for centuries! Play against the computer, challenge your friends offline or online, and meet new players from around the world. With Mancala, you can enjoy endless hours of entertainment and sharpen your strategic skills.
The game's main features include:
Online Multiplayer: 
Connect with players from all over the globe and compete against them in real-time matches. Find opponents of similar skill level and challenge them to a game. Play against anyone, anytime!
Offline Multiplayer:
 Don't have an internet connection? No problem! Play against your friends or family in the same device with our "pass and play" mode. Show off your Mancala skills and see who's the best player.
Computer Opponents: 
Test your abilities against our AI-powered computer opponents. Choose from four difficulty levels, ranging from beginner to expert. Improve your strategy and tactics with each game.
Chat and Make Friends: 
Chat with your opponents in real-time and make new friends from all over the world. Share your experiences, tactics, and tips with other players. Who knows? You may even find a lifelong friend through Mancala.
Leaderboards:
Compete for the top spot on the leaderboards and become the best Mancala player in the world. Track your progress and see how you rank against other players.
Detailed Statistics: Keep track of your performance with our detailed statistics. Analyze your wins and losses, your average scores, and your overall progress. Learn from your mistakes and improve your game.
Whether you're a seasoned Mancala player or a beginner, this app is perfect for you. Download Mancala now and start playing!

bluejetty:00043766:ios.name: Voxist: Visual Voicemail
bluejetty:00043766:ios.summary: Voxist is an intelligent voicemail that replaces your carrier’s inefficient voicemail. Delight callers with customized greetings and save time by reading transcribed voicemail messages. Access messages on your phone or via email, so you nev
bluejetty:00043766:ios.description:
Voxist is an intelligent voicemail that replaces your carrier’s inefficient voicemail. Delight callers with customized greetings and save time by reading transcribed voicemail messages. Access messages on your phone or via email, so you never miss out.
Voxist is a free voicemail app that’s really simple to navigate, so you can manage all of your business and personal voicemail efficiently. In a meeting? On the train or in a car? With a client? Read your voicemail instead of listening to it!
- FEATURES - 
*VISUAL VOICEMAIL*
Get all your voicemail in one screen, and in one click, listen to that important one.
*VOICEMAIL TO TEXT*
Read your voicemails in more than 70 different languages with our reliable, high-quality voicemail transcription service.
*PERSONALIZED GREETINGS*
Delight your clients & friends with voicemail greetings created by you just for them. Discourage unwanted spam from leaving a message, with a greeting that lets them know they are not welcome.
Record your greetings or write them. Our patented technology can even automatically greet your caller by name!
*VOICEMAIL TO EMAIL*
Receive audio and voicemail transcriptions in your email so you can access from anywhere and easily share voicemail with others. Add as many email accounts as you like! 
*UNLIMITED STORAGE CAPACITY
No storage limits. Voxist continuously captures all your voicemails, ensuring your callers will never ever hear “this voicemail is full”!
*MESSAGES SAVED FOREVER
Don’t stress about voicemails disappearing unless you choose to delete them. Many plans delete them after a certain amount of time, but Voxist saves them forever.
*NEW VOICEMAIL NOTIFICATIONS
Receive mobile and email notifications when you receive a new voicemail so no important messages go unnoticed.
*NO ADS
Always enjoy an ad-free experience, whether you’re a paid or free subscriber!
Users have described us as a visual voicemail on steroids - especially practical for business voicemail, people who handle a large volume of calls, and those who would like to address callers differently and uniquely.
Our offers:
- Voxist Free
• unlimited visual Voicemail for 1 number;
• 10 transcriptions per month;
• Voicemail transcript & audio via email;
• connect 1 email account;
• 1 personalized greeting;
• transcriptions in 1 language.
- Voxist Premium: $4.99 per month
• unlimited visual Voicemail for up to 2 numbers;
• 30 transcriptions per month;
• Voicemail transcript & audio via email;
• connect up to 5 email accounts;
• 5 personalized greetings;
• transcriptions in 2 languages.
- Voxist Pro: $9.99 per month
• unlimited visual Voicemail for up to 5 numbers;
• 100 transcriptions per month;
• Voicemail transcript & audio via email;
• connect an unlimited number of email accounts;
• unlimited personalized greetings;
• transcriptions in hundreds of languages!
Your payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. 
Your subscription will automatically renew each month unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at the same price. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
- NOTES - 
• Compatible with most operators on monthly plans!
• Voicemail service available in France, United States (except Sprint) & on Bell in Canada.
• To use Voxist, you must forward missed calls to Voxist with carrier-specific forwarding codes.
• If Voxist doesn't fit your needs, deactivate forwarding BEFORE you delete the app, otherwise, your voicemail will NOT be re-routed back to your carrier.
We hope you’ll give Voxist a try.
Check us out to learn more: https://www.voxist.com
Terms of Service & Privacy Policy: https://www.iubenda.com/terms-and-conditions/14003797

bluejetty:00061210:ios.description:
The next-generation READING APP that makes reading AWESOME with features to keep you engaged and motivated. Pick a book in our choice of 1 million, start reading any book for free, connect with other readers and share notes, highlights, and conversation - and become a better reader. 
Build your bookshelf in seconds : Create a free reader profile, organize your books, create lists. 
Browse our ebookstore : 1 million ebooks in all categories. Best sellers, fiction, non fiction, young adult, business, education etc... with great discounts and free classics. 
Start any book for free! One touch and you’re into any book for free. Read up to 10% of the content before deciding to pursue and purchase the book. Also, upload an import your own epubs from Dropbox, your desktop of anywhere else!
Read anywhere, anytime, online and offline. Glose stores your current reads so you can read them offline, in the bus, subway, in the depths of a mysterious forest or a far away galaxy.
Join the Community : see what other people are reading, recommending, highlighting, and annotating. 
Read with your friends! Create reading groups to read with your friends and share highlights and annotations. Shared annotations in the margins of the text make reading more engaging and exciting. Post a note and see what other readers think. 
Start an online book club! Create a group, pick a name and image, invite people and choose books : you’ve got your online book club read to go - around the world!
Make reading beautiful : create beautiful quote cards from the books you read. Choose a sentence that inspires you, choose a background photo, and share the quote card on social media. 
More about Glose : 
Reading for better learning : our unique features makes your reading more conducive to text analysis, memorization, and study. Glose is used in leading schools and universities to power distribution of reading material and discussion around text. 
Our bookstore features the works of Malcolm Gladwell, Walter Isaacson, Stephen King, John Green, Paulo Coelho, James Patterson, E.L. James, Suzanne Collins, Danielle Steel, David Baldacci, Janet Evanovich, Nora Roberts, Dan Brown, Dean Koontz, John Grisham, George R.R Martin, and many more !  
• Read popular FREE ebooks by classic authors : Moby Dick, Alice in Wonderland, Sherlock Holmes, The Art of War, by Sun Tzu, The Marvelous Land of Oz, Tales from Shakespeare, Romeo & Juliet, Pride & Prejudice and more.  
On Glose, reading becomes social. You can highlight your favorite quotes with one touch, archive them, share them on social networks, and annotate them. So join our community of readers who read, share, and discuss the books they love! 
Glose provides the most powerful reading experience online. 
• Customise your reading settings to personalise your experience  : fonts, spacing, page structure, background color (might mode and more).
• Always pick up your reading at the right page thanks to automatic synchronisation of your Reading activity on all devices.  
• Make new friends through books 
So what are you waiting for ? Don’t miss the inspiring conversations happening every day in Glose, and Download our app !
Connect with us on Facebook (https://www.facebook.com/GloseApp) 
Follow Glose on Twitter (https://twitter.com/Glose)

bluejetty:00064058:ios.description:
Welcome to Season Match! 
Encounter great characters, enjoy a plot full of unexpected twists, and restore the magical kingdoms after the attack of the evil Witch Crow by clearing gorgeous match-3 levels! In our game, you can find out the whole history of the Magic Kingdom, make new friends and enjoy a fascinating story.
They are waiting for you here:
- Restore the magic kingdoms after the evil Witch Crow attacked the castle.
- Boss battles.
- Unexpected plot twists and exciting "three-in-a-row" levels.
Find all the lost magic amulets to boost your magic abilities. Some of them you will get for passing difficult levels. Upgrade your magic power! Only you can stop the evil witch and save the Snow Queen! In each Kingdom, you can improve the magic fountain and flowerbeds. They will give you additional bonuses!
You are sure to be fascinated by the unique story that distinguishes the Season Match from other games in the genre of "three-in-a-row" or "crystals". This game will bring you a lot of fun and you’ll definitely love it!!
Game features:
- Exciting game events every season to challenge even the most experienced players!
- Play Season Match with your Facebook friends. Conquer them all!
- Synchronized game progress across all your devices
- Play even without an Internet connection!
- Runs smoothly even on slower devices
- More than one and a half thousand levels and 40 beautiful locations, more coming soon!
Season Match: The Puzzle Adventure is a completely free game. You can beat all of the levels without any additional purchases. Or, you can buy extra lives, moves, and bonuses to pull off the most impressive wins!

bluejetty:00028379:ios.description:
This app converts a date between Julian Day of Year and Gregorian. For example, September 11, 2022 converts to 2022-254 and 2022-254 converts to September 11, 2022.
This app will convert both directions.
Julian Date for this app refers to the day-of-year number (more properly, the ordinal date) in the Gregorian calendar, often used in mainframe computer systems, the military, and the food industry. (Note: this app does not used the term Julian Date to refer to the astronomy definition which is calculated from 4713 BC)
Features a simple clean interface with pickers for the dates.
The app also features a monthly view allowing a quick view of both Gregorian and Julian days for the entire month.
Widgets are available for both the Home Screen and the Lock Screen to display the current day of year.
A Watch app is available that includes a date converter and complications to display the current day of year.
Note: The app's icon does not change to reflect the current day.
Privacy Policy: https://julianator.brightdaydigital.com/privacy
Terms of Service: https://julianator.brightdaydigital.com/terms

bluejetty:00187840:ios.name: Digistore24
bluejetty:00187840:ios.summary: Digistore24 vendors and affiliates can use this app to keep track of their online business from anywhere at any time: The Digistore24 app offers full control over transactions, e-tickets, voucher codes, products and the marketplace, no matt
bluejetty:00187840:ios.description:
Digistore24 vendors and affiliates can use this app to keep track of their online business from anywhere at any time: The Digistore24 app offers full control over transactions, e-tickets, voucher codes, products and the marketplace, no matter where you are.
1. Keep track of all incoming payments
All of your incoming payments are clearly displayed in the app - broken down by days, months, quarters and years. The currency can be switched between EUR, USD and CHF. Ka-ching! Notifications of new incoming payments are sent directly via push notification. 
2. Manage transactions from anywhere
Do you have an urgent question about a transaction that just can’t wait until you’re in the office? It can be answered superfast: All transactions can be conveniently viewed in the app and filtered by order ID, product ID, product name, customer email, first and last name, payment method or currency. 
3. Switch effortlessly between accounts
It’s super easy to view all of your accounts in one place. In the app, you can switch between different accounts and the vendor or affiliate view with a single click. 
4. Monitor your analytics anytime 
Always be able to act: The integrated dashboards provide the perfect overview of all relevant key figures at all times. Depending on the account selected, they adapt automatically and always provide the latest data.
5. Ticketing made easy
Ticket scanning has never been easier: Digistore24 e-tickets can be scanned and recorded directly with the app. This means that every step can be taken care of with just one piece of software! Creating and selling tickets in the web application plus validation and admission control is easy using the app. 
6. Manage discount codes on the go
Want to run a spontaneous discount campaign? This can be implemented quickly, as all discounts can be created, edited, copied, deleted or searched for directly in the app.
7. Manage marketplace listings anytime
Stay on top of everything: Create or edit your product marketplace listings on the go, and as an affiliate, find the right products for your affiliate marketing while on the move.
Digistore24 is a European automation and affiliate marketing platform for digital products, seminars and software. All Digistore24 users use the app free of charge and are always well-informed about the online company.

bluejetty:00014424:ios.summary:
Welcome to Mentor℠ by eDriving, a comprehensive digital driver risk management system.
Mentor identifies and remediates risky driver behavior with the FICO® Safe Driving Score, a predictive scoring system, to highlight risks, suggest dyna
bluejetty:00014424:ios.description:
Welcome to Mentor℠ by eDriving, a comprehensive digital driver risk management system.
Mentor identifies and remediates risky driver behavior with the FICO® Safe Driving Score, a predictive scoring system, to highlight risks, suggest dynamic training modules, and support a safe community space. Mentor highlights drivers’ strengths and areas where they may need to improve. Mentor will also use driving patterns to recommend Playlist modules and responsive notifications to reinforce safe-driving behaviors. 
Drivers can easily view risky behaviors that contribute to their overall driving safety. Mentor also recognizes safe, eco-friendly driving and encourages community building as a part of its Crash-Free Culture® — all from a privacy-first, data-secure platform and supported with unsurpassed professional services. 
Mentor’s key benefits to drivers and their managers include: 
• Easy-to-use, highly secure smartphone / tablet environment. 
• Validated and predictive scoring of driver risk with FICO Safe Driving Score. 
• Responsive, interactive, multimedia Playlist using micro-training (less than 5 minutes long), short quizzes, and responsive notifications. 
• Highest levels of privacy protection and data security. 
• In-app manager coaching toolkit to support high-risk drivers. 
• Collaborative environment for drivers and managers to share best practices informally. 
Mentor is NOT a driver surveillance or tracking tool or a phone tracker or blocker. Instead, Mentor is designed to help drivers to reduce their risk on the road and for managers to support and sustain a focused mission objective across their teams – to return drivers home safely at the end of each day! 
Safe driving.

bluejetty:00030498:ios.name: Bible Stories For Kids!
bluejetty:00030498:ios.summary:
Faith comes through hearing so let the little ears hear the Good News of Jesus Christ with our read-aloud Bible Stories For Kids app! 
The Bible Stories For Kids App allows your child to hear engaging, biblical stories that encourage real-
bluejetty:00030498:ios.description:
Faith comes through hearing so let the little ears hear the Good News of Jesus Christ with our read-aloud Bible Stories For Kids app! 
The Bible Stories For Kids App allows your child to hear engaging, biblical stories that encourage real-life application! Meanwhile, you are provided with confidence-boosting resources that seek to promote parent and child interaction as well as heart-changing conversations that we believe will foster your child's faith (and yours too!). Download and start your kids’ journey to faith by hearing the most important Bible stories come to life in ways that unlock their creativity and imagination.
WHAT TO EXPECT:
- A screen-free tool to assist parents in living out Deuteronomy 6:7 in regards to the Lord’s commands… “impress them on your child, talk about them when you sit at home and when you walk along the road, when you lie down and when you get up.”
- Biblically sound, fully illustrated, and age-appropriate stories for children 3-10 years of age.
- All stories are under 10 minutes long
- Gentle music and soothing narrated voices
- Each audio begins with the associated scripture being read in a child’s voice, and is then followed by the story being narrated in great detail to help your child better understand the principles of the story.
EACH STORY IS ACCOMPANIED WITH: 
- Printable color-along sheets 
- Word search
- Discussion questions to continue the conversation and solidify your child's comprehension of God’s word!
ADDITIONAL FEATURES INCLUDE:
- Weekly memory verses
- Customizable playlists
- New content added regularly 
- Prayer & mediations 
- Offline listening
SAMPLE STORY & PREVIEWS
https://biblestoriesforkids.app/#sample-story
WAYS TO USE:
- We are excited to support parents by providing them a resource that can be used in a variety of places
- Sunday School 
- Before bed
- In the car
- During Meal Time 
- Homeschool
- For the parent to further understand God’s word 
WHAT PARENTS ARE SAYING ABOUT BIBLE STORIES FOR KIDS:
“My seven year old now always asks to listen to the Bible Stories app as we’re getting in the car. It’s so fun to have her listen to the stories that open up her imagination to learn more about God. The ability to have an engaging way to get our kids into Scripture without the need of them holding the phone is a game changer!” -Julie
"I might’ve cried the first time I opened and started exploring this app! All I could imagine is sitting with our little boy (and children to come) listening to all the stories from scripture while they color along .. what a DREAM!!! Children are sponges & it is our duty as parents to saturate them in the Truth of God’s Word.. this app helps us do just that! And in a way that is creative & FUN! So thankful The Lord laid this idea on their hearts so that we all can benefit from their obedience!" -Tori
 “I love everything about this app. The concept of by kids for kids and the way these bible stories are delivered easily make it my favorite Bible app for kids (and we have used a ton of other ones). I have 6 kids (ages 1-11) and all of them found this app very engaging at their own level. I would highly recommend this app for all parents who want to raise godly children who love His Word.” -Reggie 
"The Bible Stories for Kids App is an absolute dream every parent and childcare worker has been waiting for!! It presents the Gospel in a creative, understandable, and purposeful way to kids of all ages. This app is so well produced that I find myself loving it being played in the background for my daughters. Your kids will delight in the Bible Stories for Kids App as it takes their imagination for a ride!" - Rachel
A paid subscription is required for this app: 
Monthly Membership is $5.99 
Yearly Membership is $59.99
Privacy Policy: https://biblestoriesforkids.app/privacy-policy/
End User License Agreement https://biblestoriesforkids.app/eula
Terms & Conditions https://biblestoriesforkids.app/terms-conditions

WHAT KIDS C
bluejetty:00062401:ios.description:
***** 5/5 stars EducationalAppStore.com *****
LetraKid is an educational game addressed to children (4-8 years old) that can help them to learn pre-cursive and print block handwriting correctly, while having fun when doing so!
WHAT KIDS CAN LEARN FROM THIS GAME
• Recognize letter shapes and perfect alphabet pronunciation
• The correct letter formation: start, checkpoints, strokes direction, order etc. Difficulty Levels 1 and 2 with assisted writing are designed to focus on the letter formation.
• Develop fine motor skills for handwriting activity. Difficulty Levels 3 to 5 with freehand writing activities will focus on this improvement to help maximize confidence and form when writing.
• Playing with a stylus pen will also help to improve standard pencil grasp. Any stylus compatible with the device will work.
MAIN FEATURES
• 16 languages with full support for interface, human native voices for letter/numbers pronunciation and full official alphabets. (ENGLISH, ESPAÑOL, FRANÇAIS, DEUTSCH, ITALIANO, PORTUGUÊS, NEDERLANDS, SVENSKA, NORSK, DANSK, SUOMI, ROMÂNĂ, JĘZYK POLSKI, TÜRKÇE, BAHASA INDONESIA and BAHASA MELAYU)
• 3 popular letter formation rules that will provide flexibility for picking the right stroke order and direction for the child. Vital for improving grasp on key terms and rulings within handwriting.
• Makes use of the 10 most popular fonts in classes all over the world for learning pre cursive and print block handwriting: ZB style, HWT style, DN style, German(Hamburg) style, Euro Latino, NSW, Victoria, KIWI etc.
• Full support for both Left and Right handwriting rules.
• 5 difficulty levels with AUTO and LOCK settings, ranging from assisted writing for beginners, up to real freehand writing with minimal support and strict evaluation.
• 4 set of glyphs: ABC (full alphabet for upper case letters), abc (full alphabet for lower case letters), 123 (numbers from 0 to 9) and a special set of signs for funny exercises.
• 5 progression levels, color coded for each glyph that allows parents and teachers an instant evaluation of the progression and most exercised letters at the alphabet level.
• 16 funny sticker rewards that will unlock after progression milestones are reached. Also, their drawing rules after each completed progression at Alphabet/glyph list level.
• 3 profile slots with 50 funny avatars and name customization that will save independently the settings and the progression.
• Full support for both Landscape and Portrait orientations.
Download now this free version and you can check yourself these features on a limited list of letters and numbers.
GREAT IN THE CLASSROOM!
With a unique and real-time feedback feature as well as complex tracing evaluation algorithms, LetraKid is not just another tracing app.
This is a new approach, focused on creating a fun game by utilizing handwriting mechanics itself. This avoids using distracting random rewards or secondary game mechanics that can break and confuse the learning process, optimizing learning progress and educational appeal to children.
The real time feedback will give both audio and graphic clues about the quality of the tracing and will adjust with difficulty level.
Our tracing evaluation algorithms allow for an accurate and fun reward, using a 5 star rating for each exercise. This engages and motivates the kids to progress and to strive for more.
DESIGNED for KIDS
• No ads or irritating pop-ups.
• No collection of personal data
• Game settings are by default behind a parental gate. This can be disabled, but ensures a child to work with a certain font, formation rule, difficulty level and various other features for total specification to their needs.
• External links are protected by a permanent parental gate.
Got any ideas for improving LetraKid? Then please send us your feedback and requests.

bluejetty:00016169:ios.description:
#Celebrating over 10 million downloads!#
There’s a new chef in town!
And it’s you! But that will be just one of your many roles!
A budding but faltering restaurant business was left in your care, and it will take all you’ve got to really get it off the ground and make it work. Become a cook, a chef, a manager, an organizer, a provider! 
Yes, it’s up to you to start from scratch, run your own restaurant and raise it from rags to riches! It will be quite an adventure!
GROW YOUR OWN INGREDIENTS!
They say there’s no food like homemade food, and you certainly live by that motto! Keep your foodstuffs fresh by growing them yourself! Buy a plot of land outside your restaurant, plant a crop, harvest it and serve the produce while it’s the tastiest and most delicious!
UNLOCK HUNDREDS OF RECIPES!
From salads, soups, sushi and sandwiches to a plethora of succulent dishes from the grill, vide variety of pizza and plenty more! Did we mention cakes, crepes, donuts, pies and ice cream as well? And don’t even get us started on the different types of coffee! 
PREPARE A TON OF MEALS!
You’ve got the recipe and the ingredients and your oven or a different appliance is ready to rock’n’roll? Well, what are you waiting for? It’s time to cook, make, prepare and serve your delectable dishes to your eager customers! Expand your menu and keep them coming back for more!
OPEN UP CRAFT STORES!
This is not your usual restaurant sim where everything is just waiting for you! You’re involved in every part of manufacturing and production process! Open up dairy stands, bakeries, candy or pasta stores and many more! Have everything ready at the drop of a dime!
FORM, FUNCTION AND FLAVOR!
Outfit and decorate everything as you see fit! From tiles and wallpapers, doors and counters, appliances, stoves, ovens or salad bars to fun and versatile decorations and accessories, personalize the inside and outside of your restaurant down to the tiniest detail!
RECRUIT THE RIGHT PEOPLE!
The better you get at running your restaurant, and the bigger your business becomes, the more people you’ll have to employ. Get more chefs, waiters and managers to help you out! Your new employees will also bestow you with awesome benefits and added bonuses!
ENGAGE IN DELIGHTFUL QUESTS! 
Ah, there’s always something to do in and around your restaurant! A friendly and charming crew of characters will keep you busy with their tasks and requests, but they’ll also guide you along your way, and give you direction through the challenges they have for you!
CONNECT, SHARE AND SOCIALISE!
Let your friends know what fun you have in Chef Town! Connect with them via Facebook, invite them in, visit their restaurants and explore the community filled with companions both old and new! 
So, dive in Chef Town! Experience the joys and challenges of running your own restaurant – and plenty more! There’s a whole town of adventure waiting for you! And yes – this town IS big enough for all of you!
Welcome to Chef Town!
Notice: Some displayed items may require in-app purchases. You can disable in-app purchases in device settings.

Welcome to EarlyBird, a family-focused investment platform that lets you invest in your child’s future, collect financial gifts from loved ones, and capture precious memories all in one place. Join thousands of parents who trust EarlyBird to build generational wealth for their children.
**1. INVEST IN THEIR FUTURE**
- Simple Yet Powerful: Start investing in minutes with our professionally managed portfolios designed specifically for children’s long-term growth.
- Collective Investing: Enable family and friends to contribute financially to your child’s future through gifts, celebrations, and milestones.
- Smart Money Management: Track contributions, monitor growth, and watch your child’s investments compound over time.
**2. UNLOCK THE POWER OF FAMILY GIFTING**
- Modern Gift Registry: Replace traditional gifts with meaningful financial contributions that grow over time.
- Celebration-Based Investing: Turn birthdays, holidays, and special moments into opportunities for lasting financial impact.
- Extended Family Network: Family and friends can actively contribute to each child’s financial future.
**3. BUILD A TIME CAPSULE FOR YOUR CHILD**
- Secure and Private: Safeguard your child’s journey in a private digital vault, creating a unique time capsule they will cherish when older.
- More Than Photos: Every picture tells a story. EarlyBird captures not just the images but the heartwarming context and stories behind them, turning fleeting moments into enduring memories.
- Weekly Engagement: Celebrate all of your child’s most precious milestones with smart prompts.
**TRUSTED BY LEADING FINANCIAL PARTNERS**
- Featured on CNBC, Bloomberg, and Forbes, Techcrunch
- Partnership with Blackrock
- SEC-registered investment advisor
- SIPC-protected accounts
**WHAT PARENTS ARE SAYING**
“The combination of investing and memories is genius. My entire family contributes regularly.” 
- Sarah T.
“Started when my daughter was born - amazed to see both her memories and investments growing.” 
- David K.
“EarlyBird has redefined the way we preserve memories. It’s not just an app; it’s a legacy for our child.” 
- Jane D.
“I trust EarlyBird more than just a place to invest. It’s an example of what it means to be a good parent, and I just happen to invest here.”
- James C.
**KEY FEATURES**
- Commission-free custodial investment accounts
- Professionally managed portfolios
- Family & friend gifting platform
- Automated investment options
- Milestone-based contributions
- Digital memory keeping
- Family collaboration tools
- Secure & private environment
Join thousands families building generational wealth with EarlyBird. Start investing in your child’s future today.
EarlyBird is a subscription-based app with both a monthly and annual pricing option. Subscriptions are handled through Revenue Cat. Subscriptions either renew on a monthly or annual basis depending on the type a user chooses.
Note: Investment products are SIPC insured, may lose value, and are not bank guaranteed. EarlyBird is an SEC Registered Investment Advisor.
Privacy Policy, Terms of Use, and Disclosures are available at: https://www.getearlybird.io/legal

bluejetty:00120998:ios.name: Callbreak Card Game : Offline
bluejetty:00120998:ios.summary: Callbreak is popular card game played in South Asian countries like Nepal and India. Call Break is a relatively long-run game played with 52 cards deck between 4 players with 13 cards (thirteen patti) each. Its rules are pretty easy to lear
bluejetty:00120998:ios.description:
Callbreak is popular card game played in South Asian countries like Nepal and India. Call Break is a relatively long-run game played with 52 cards deck between 4 players with 13 cards (thirteen patti) each. Its rules are pretty easy to learn. You can select different card themes and enjoy the game.
The basics
Four players play individually with a pack of 52 cards. There are 5 game rounds in this game, and scorekeeping is done separately for the 5 rounds. In each round, 13 deals are played. In every deal, each player throws one card, so four cards make a deal. Thirteen tricks make a Round. Five rounds make a game of Callbreak.
The gameplay
All of the 52 cards are distributed equally in the counterclockwise direction among four players. Each player gets 13 cards (thirteen patti) each. After the cards are distributed, each player should declare their bid (Call) for the round. The Call means the number of deals that the player insists on winning in that particular round. The Call is made based on the cards in the hands of individual players. Every player must declare their Call between 1 to 8. For every round, you must look at the cards carefully, make a bid for the number of deals you think you can win.
The objective of the game is to break the call/bid made by another player. 
After bidding, the dealing starts. The player on the right-hand side of the person who distributed the card throws his card for the first deal. Then the three players throw one card each one by one. The person who throws the next card must try to beat the thrown cards on that deal. Whoever throws the biggest card wins the deal. Subsequently, the winner of each deal throws the first card for the next deal. In every deal, each player must throw the same suit card as the first thrower as well as they must throw a card such that they beat all the previously thrown cards on that deal. If the player does not have the card from the same suite, they must throw a trump/spades card. If someone has already thrown a trump card, the player must throw a higher value of trump card if they have.
After 13 deals are played for the round, scorekeeping is done. The player who has won the highest number of deals after 5 rounds will be the winner.
The power of cards is ranked from high to low as A-K-Q-J-10-9-8-7-6-5-4-3-2. In the CallBreak game, spades are predefined trump, and players can't declare any other suit as trump.
Features of this Callbreak game:
- The game works offline. You don't need an internet connection to play this free game.
- The interface is simple, and the game rules are easy to understand.
- You can set your own preferences & apply custom settings for sound, game speed, gameplay mode, and more.
- Select from different game themes and card designs.
- Play with simulated bots in single-player mode.
- Multiplayer-like gameplay with bots with avatar and turn-based gameplay.
CallBreak is also called Lakdi or Lakadi in India.We hope you enjoy playing Callbreak.

bluejetty:00044822:ios.summary: Welcome to Resideo Connect. Formerly the First Alert app, Resideo Connect introduces a refreshed look and feel while continuing to deliver the same trusted experience. No action is required, and your devices, settings, and account informati
bluejetty:00044822:ios.description:
Welcome to Resideo Connect. Formerly the First Alert app, Resideo Connect introduces a refreshed look and feel while continuing to deliver the same trusted experience. No action is required, and your devices, settings, and account information remain unchanged. 
Resideo Connect is the official app for compatible Honeywell Home, First Alert, and Resideo products – all part of the Resideo family of brands.
Take greater control of your home's comfort, safety, security, and water leak detection with the Resideo Connect app.
Whether you're home or away, this whole-home solution helps you monitor and manage the devices that keep your home running, all from one easy-to-use app. Designed for the way homes really work, the Resideo Connect app is compatible across select Resideo, Honeywell Home and First Alert branded products. Plus, integrate with smart home partners to manage additional devices throughout your home. Stay connected to the devices your home depends on with the Resideo Connect app, so everything works better together.
• Connected Home Control: Manage security cameras, video doorbells, smart smoke & carbon monoxide alarms, select smart thermostats, water leak detection, and more from one intuitive app.
• Clear Alerts, Faster Action: Receive timely notifications for water leaks, motion events, smoke or CO incidents, security activity, and other important events so you can respond with confidence.
• Trusted Solutions, Connected Together: Bring together trusted products and smart home integrations to simplify everyday home management and stay connected from anywhere.
Key Features
• Comfort Control: Manage select Honeywell Home smart thermostats, adjust settings remotely, create schedules, and enroll in eligible energy-saving programs designed to help reduce utility costs.
• Smart Smoke & Carbon Monoxide Detection: Stay connected to your home's fire and CO safety devices wherever you are. Receive alerts, check device status, and seamlessly integrate compatible Google Nest Protect Alarms* to expand your connected safety ecosystem.
• Smart Video Awareness: Stay informed with First Alert Video Doorbells and Outdoor Cameras featuring intelligent event detection for people, pets, vehicles, and packages, with clear notifications and video access when it matters most.
• Water Leak Detection & Response: Help detect leaks early with the First Alert WiFi Water Leak and Freeze Detector. Pair with a professionally installed Water Shutoff Device for added control when water is detected.
• Security & Smart Home Integrations: Manage compatible security devices, smart locks, and garage door openers, including select Schlage, Kwikset, and Genie products, from one convenient app. Integrate with leading smart home platforms for even greater control and convenience.
Less complexity. More control.
Resideo Connect helps homeowners stay connected to the devices that support comfort, safety, security, and awareness throughout the home.
Expand your home’s protection with our whole home offering. Learn more about our family of connected smart products at firstalert.com/pages/resideo-connect-app
New to our brands and the Resideo Connect app? Download the app and get started with guided device setup, streamlined onboarding, and easy device management.

bluejetty:00157282:ios.description:
Submarine Quest: Merge & Explore – Dive Into the Unknown
Embark on an underwater adventure like never before. In Submarine Quest: Merge & Explore, you will dive into the mysterious depths of the ocean, discover fascinating deep-sea creatures, and upgrade your submarine to explore even further. The deeper you go, the more secrets you will uncover.
Match, Merge, and Progress
At its core, Submarine Quest offers a satisfying Fish Merge experience designed to feel intuitive and rewarding. Match and merge fish, artifacts, and underwater objects to unlock new content and expand your journey.
Explore the Deep and Discover Rare Species
From the sunlit zone to the midnight depths, encounter a variety of unique marine life. Each zone is filled with rare species waiting to be discovered.
Upgrade and Customize Your Submarine
Enhance your submarine with powerful upgrades to dive deeper into the abyss. Customize your sub’s appearance and unlock new parts to improve your exploration.
Uncover Hidden Mysteries and Rare Deep-Sea Artifacts
Strange artifacts, ancient secrets, and mysterious deep-sea creatures await. Can you uncover the truth hidden beneath the waves?
Key Features
 • Explore the ocean’s depths and discover unique sea creatures
 • Upgrade and customize your submarine for deeper dives
 • Complete buy orders to trade and earn valuable rewards
 • Uncover hidden mysteries and rare deep-sea artifacts
 • Customize the look of your explorer with different outfits
 • Stunning underwater visuals
Prepare for an unforgettable deep-sea adventure. Start your journey beneath the waves now.
Indonesia Games Rating System (IGRS): 3+

bluejetty:00139754:ios.name: Low FODMAP Diet for IBS & SIBO
bluejetty:00139754:ios.summary: Experiencing challenges related to IBS (Irritable Bowel Syndrome), SIBO, or digestive concerns like bloating, gas, or food intolerances? The FODMAP Diet app is designed to support individuals following a Low FODMAP diet by providing structu
bluejetty:00139754:ios.description:
Experiencing challenges related to IBS (Irritable Bowel Syndrome), SIBO, or digestive concerns like bloating, gas, or food intolerances? The FODMAP Diet app is designed to support individuals following a Low FODMAP diet by providing structured, accessible information on food content and composition.
Developed with reference to the Monash University Low FODMAP framework, the app is a reliable resource for exploring food choices that may align with your dietary needs and sensitivities.
---
Key Features:
- 800+ Food & Ingredient Listings
Access a comprehensive database of fruits, vegetables, grains, proteins, and other foods, categorized to support individuals managing IBS, SIBO, or suspected FODMAP intolerances.
- Clear FODMAP Ratings
Foods are organized into high, moderate, or low FODMAP levels, offering guidance to help users make informed dietary decisions.
- Fast & Accurate Food Search
Quickly find foods by name to identify items that contain fructose, lactose, and other FODMAP elements.
- Symptom-Oriented Food Exploration
Use the app to explore food options that may help reduce exposure to common dietary triggers associated with digestive discomfort.
- Used by a Broad Community
Trusted by thousands of users as a reference for navigating the complexities of Low FODMAP eating and improving dietary awareness.
---
Whether you’re beginning a Low FODMAP diet or refining your existing routine, the FODMAP Diet app provides practical tools to support your food tracking and planning process.
---
Disclaimer: This app is intended for informational purposes only and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional before making changes to your diet.

bluejetty:00040472:ios.summary:
SnipNotes captures your thoughts instantly across all your Apple devices.
• Apple Watch & Siri – Dictate notes from your wrist or with voice commands
• Home Screen Widgets – View and create notes without opening the app
• Clipboard Capture
bluejetty:00040472:ios.description:
SnipNotes captures your thoughts instantly across all your Apple devices.
• Apple Watch & Siri – Dictate notes from your wrist or with voice commands
• Home Screen Widgets – View and create notes without opening the app
• Clipboard Capture – Save copied text as a new note in one tap, or enable automatic capture in Settings to save copied text while SnipNotes is active and in the foreground
** Create Notes Your Way **
• Dictate notes using Siri, in-app voice input, or directly on Apple Watch
• Create voice recordings; on iOS 26 or later, you can transcribe them and, when available, generate summaries
• Enrich notes with images, PDFs, videos, and file attachments
• Draw and sketch with your finger or Apple Pencil on iPhone and iPad
• Pull content from any app via drag-and-drop or the share sheet
• Save your current location to remember where you parked
** Access Notes Instantly **
• View and edit notes from home screen and lock screen widgets
• Ask Siri to open, read, or display your notes
• Manage notes directly from your Apple Watch
• Full offline access – your notes are always available
** Work Smarter with Actions **
• Automate workflows by connecting SnipNotes to Shortcuts
• Tap detected addresses to view on a map, or phone numbers to call
• Create calendar events, open links, or share content with quick actions
• Swipe notes to copy, export, or share instantly
** Stay Organized and Secure **
• Organize with inbox, archive, and nested categories
• Use colorful tags to organize notes and filter across categories
• Search across all notes – even from the home screen or via Siri
• Set reminders that sync across iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch
• Protect sensitive notes with passcode or Face ID/Touch ID
** Make It Yours **
• Format with checkboxes, lists, colors, and highlighting
• Choose from hundreds of icons to identify notes at a glance
• Pick from ten color themes to match your style
SnipNotes is your ad-free note-taking app. Enjoy the core features at no cost, with premium options like voice recordings, iCloud synchronization, file attachments, and drawing capabilities available for a one-time purchase or subscription. Your notes sync securely to your private iCloud account.
Discover more about SnipNotes at www.snipnotes.de. Encounter an issue or have a question? Reach out to me directly at support@snipnotes.de, or connect on X/Twitter via @SnipNotesApp. Your feedback is valuable, and I'm dedicated to providing a personalized response to every message.
Subscription Management: You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal through your App Store Account Settings after purchase.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00017657:ios.description:
Bitso is your financial platform designed for you to take control of your investments. With it, you can access more than 150 cryptocurrencies like bitcoin (BTC) and over 5,000 stocks and ETFs, generate returns on your assets, and make transfers in dollars. We are trusted by more than 9 million users globally and 1,900 business clients. With Bitso, it’s time to discover what your money is capable of.
Cryptocurrencies: Your gateway to smarter investing
Explore, buy, sell, and manage more than 150 cryptocurrencies on our secure, easy-to-use exchange. Whether you’re looking for the pioneer bitcoin (BTC), the innovative ether (ETH), or want to diversify with stablecoins and viral memecoins like Dogecoin and Shiba Inu, Bitso offers the essential tools for any crypto investor. Our platform makes your crypto investments straightforward and accessible.
◉ Limitless diversification: Get access to a wide market that includes everything from the most traditional assets like bitcoin (BTC) to cryptocurrencies linked to artificial intelligence (AI) that are shaping the future of technology.
◉ Regulatory security: Your cryptocurrencies are protected under a robust regulatory framework. Bitso holds a DLT provider license from the Gibraltar Financial Services Commission, which guarantees the secure custody and management of your digital assets and gives you peace of mind with all your crypto investments.
Stocks: Expand your portfolio of investments - Only in Mexico
Don't limit your investments to just cryptocurrencies. From the same Bitso app, you can access over 5,000 stocks and ETFs from US markets. This powerful feature allows you to build a stronger, more diversified investment portfolio, combining the agility of digital assets with the stability of traditional market investments.
Download the app and sign up for the waiting list to access the product before anyone else.
Yields: Make your money work for you
With Bitso Yields, your digital assets can generate passive weekly earnings. Simply activate this function and watch your cryptocurrencies grow, stress-free and with no hidden fees. This powerful feature helps maximize the returns on your long-term investments. You maintain full control, with the freedom to withdraw your funds whenever you wish, optimizing the potential of all your investments.
Transfers: Your reliable tool for international payments - Only in Mexico and Argentina
Open a virtual USD account and send money to the United States quickly and affordably, from just $2.99 USD. Your transfers are made using Digital Dollars (USDC), a type of stablecoin pegged to the US dollar. Our fast and secure transfers make cross-border payments easy and accessible. Plus, you can grow your Digital Dollar USDC with up to a 4% annual yield. Product available only for Mexico and Argentina customers.
Why is Bitso a safe option for your investments?
Security is the core pillar of the Bitso platform. We hold a DLT provider license from Gibraltar and have a proof of solvency system that gives you full visibility into the availability of your funds. We are committed to protecting your investments and your data, which is why we offer:
◉ Two-factor authentication (2FA) for a more secure login.
◉ Session and device management to control your account.
◉ Secure access via PIN or Face ID.
◉ Real-time notifications for login sessions.
Start investing in 3 simple steps
1. Download the Bitso app to begin your investing journey.
2. Register your email, create a strong password, and upload your official ID.
3. That's it! You can now start to buy, sell, and invest in cryptocurrencies.
App features for smarter investing
◉ Deposit and withdraw funds from your bank in local currency 24/7.
◉ Monitor the real-time price of each cryptocurrency to make the best decisions for your investments.
◉ Receive passive weekly yields on your cryptocurrencies.
◉ Buy bitcoin (BTC), Ether (ETH), and over 150 digital assets.

bluejetty:00027372:ios.description:
Maps 3D PRO – Explore the outdoors in beautiful 3D
Plan, discover, and navigate your next outdoor adventure with maps that reveal the landscape as it really is. Unlike traditional flat maps, Maps 3D PRO lets you explore mountains, valleys, trails, and terrain in immersive 3D, making it easier to understand the landscape before you head out.
Whether you're hiking, cycling, trail running, skiing, or simply exploring new places, Maps 3D PRO helps you plan smarter, stay oriented, and—even far from mobile coverage—calculate entirely new routes offline.
Professional outdoor maps in 3D
Maps 3D PRO combines detailed topographic maps with realistic 3D terrain to give you a better understanding of the world around you.
– Beautiful 3D terrain visualization
– Detailed outdoor and topographic maps
– Smooth map navigation and intuitive controls
– Search for towns, streets, mountain peaks, lakes, and more
– Worldwide map coverage
Plan your adventures
Everything you need to prepare for your next trip.
– Create and edit routes directly on the map
– View elevation profiles before you go
– Measure distance and elevation gain
– Record your GPS tracks with precise elevation data
– Review and analyze completed tours
Explore offline
Go beyond offline maps. Maps 3D PRO doesn't just let you view maps without a connection—it also lets you calculate entirely new routes offline. Even in remote mountains, forests, or national parks, you can continue planning your adventure without mobile coverage.
– Worldwide offline maps
– Full offline route calculation
– GPS recording with precise elevation data
– Offline map search
– Reliable navigation anywhere
– Save battery by using pre-downloaded maps
Import and share
Take your adventures with you wherever you go.
– Import GPX tracks from many sources
– Export recorded routes
– Share your adventures with friends and family
Trusted by millions of outdoor enthusiasts
For more than a decade, Maps 3D PRO has helped more than 2.5 million outdoor enthusiasts explore the world in realistic 3D. Whether you're planning your next hiking trip, cycling tour, or weekend adventure, Maps 3D PRO gives you the tools to explore with confidence.
Why Maps 3D PRO?
– Realistic 3D terrain for a better understanding of the landscape
– Worldwide offline maps for reliable adventures anywhere
– Unique offline route calculation—even without mobile coverage
– Powerful route planning and GPS recording
– GPX import and export
– Fast, intuitive, and built specifically for outdoor adventures
Award-winning app
– Featured by Apple with a main banner in the US App Store Navigation category
– 3rd Place – Best App Ever Awards (148Apps), Best Outdoor App
– Reached #1 in the Navigation category in more than 75 countries
For over a decade, Maps 3D PRO has been one of the world's leading 3D outdoor navigation apps, trusted by millions of hikers, cyclists, runners, skiers, and outdoor enthusiasts.
Notes
– Continued use of GPS running in the background can reduce battery life.
– Download maps before your trip to use all offline features.
Thank you for using Maps 3D PRO. We are continuously improving the app and always appreciate your feedback.

bluejetty:00185299:ios.description:
Kidlatta is an all-in-one behavior chart, turn-taking tool, reward and money tracker that goes everywhere you do. No magnets, no clips, no wall required. A fun, simple, and visual way to manage kid activities!
Whether you're a parent managing morning routines, a caregiver on the go, or a teacher running a classroom, Kidlatta gives you everything you need to encourage good behavior, track progress, and make it fun for kids.
"Helps us avoid meltdowns while traveling and in stores. Seamlessly integrates with our refrigerator chart so kids always know where they stand." — App Store review
---
**BEHAVIOR CHART & CLIP CHART**
Kidlatta mirrors the clip chart your kids may already know, but you don't need to stick to the standard positive and negative. A free progress chart version is available, or you can upgrade to Kidlatta Platinum create your own text and colors. Simple enough that kids understand it right away, powerful enough to replace the chart on your wall.
"I love that my son's chart mirrors the one he uses at school!" — App Store review
**REWARD LIST**
Build a custom reward list so kids know exactly what they're working toward. Clipping up can be its own reward, or tie milestones to something special. You decide what motivates the kids.
TURN TAKING WHEEL & TURN ORDER TRACKER
No more arguments about who goes first. Kidlatta's turn taking wheel spins randomly to pick fairly, or cycles through everyone to keep things organized across multiple activities. Whether it's games, chores, reading aloud, or classroom jobs, everyone knows who's next. Platinum subscribers can lock the wheel to guarantee everyone gets a turn before anyone repeats.
**VIRTUAL KIDS BANK**
Teach kids the value of good behavior and money management with a built-in allowance tracker and virtual bank. Earn, save, and spend, all tracked in the app.
---
"My kiddo really responds to positive encouragement and celebrates his good decisions. This app allows us to do just that and my son loves to move himself up the scale when he's recognized for good behavior." — App Store review
"I've been able to cut down on yelling and nagging and countless behavior strategies I tried to implement but couldn't be consistent with. I highly recommend this to any parent." — App Store review
---
**FREE TO USE**
Kidlatta is free to download and use with up to 4 kids. Upgrade to Kidlatta Platinum (monthly or yearly subscription) to unlock:
- Customizable chart labels and colors
- Guaranteed turn wheel that ensures everyone gets a turn before repeating
- Unlimited kids
---
Works on iPhone and iPad. Take it to school, use it at home, bring it on the road. Kidlatta is always in your pocket when you need it most.

bluejetty:00035768:ios.description:
Open the app. A bout is already live, and everyone watching is scoring it in real time.
Welcome to Internet Fight League.
It started as Kayyo, built to train fighters. This is where that training was always headed.
IFL is live combat sports for the internet age. Real fighters. Real bouts. And a crowd that doesn't just watch. It decides who wins.
WATCH
Bouts from around the world, streaming live 24/7. The hottest fights float to the top of your Feed. Boxing, MMA, Muay Thai, BJJ, wrestling, all of it.
JUDGE
You're the judge. Score every round, vote live, and watch the fan verdict swing with every exchange. On IFL, the crowd crowns the winner.
DISCOVER
The world is your arena. Open the map and see real fighters near you. Filter by style, weight, and division. Find your next opponent down the street, then challenge them.
RANK
Win bouts. Take territory. Climb. One leaderboard ranks every fighter across every discipline. A W is a W. Pound for pound, by weight class, in your city or worldwide. There's a number next to your name. Make it smaller.
COMPETE
This is what the training was for. Match with an opponent, lock in the rules and the gear, coordinate the meetup, and go live with one tap. Fight. Get judged. Move up.
WHAT MAKES IFL DIFFERENT
• The crowd decides. Fans score and vote every live bout.
• Real opponents near you, not seeded bots.
• One leaderboard, every discipline. A W is a W.
• Live POV broadcasting, straight from your phone.
• Geared up, never bare knuckle. Gloves and a mouthguard on every striking bout, shin guards for newcomers.
• 18+, ranked, and built for people who actually compete.
Privacy comes standard. Your map location stays approximate until you choose to match. Bout details stay between you and your opponent.
You trained in private. Now find out in public.
Kayyo built the fighter. IFL is the arena. Step in.

Introducing AI Music Generator, the future of music creation in your hands. Unleash your creativity with limitless possibilities, a platform designed to make music generation as easy as tapping a button. Our state-of-the-art AI music generator, inspired by breakthroughs in machine learning and music theory, offers a versatile tool that instantly composes original music for any mood, moment, or video.

AI Music Maker delivers a unique piece each time, ready for your usage and enjoyment.

Explore Genres: Delve into a vast library of genres, spanning from Classical to K-pop, Jazz to Heavy Metal, Country to EDM, and everything in between. Discover new soundscapes and allow your creativity to soar.
AI Composition: Our advanced AI uses complex algorithms to compose original music, providing an unlimited supply of fresh, unique, and high-quality tunes. All you need is an idea; AI Music Generator takes care of the rest.
Customize Your Track: Modify your creation to match the tone, mood, and length of your video or project.
Direct Video Integration: Add your newly crafted soundtrack directly to your videos, saving time and effort. Our in-app video editor ensures seamless integration of audio and visual elements. Adjust original and music volume to fit your project.

bluejetty:00074833:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00074833:ios.description:
Car Key App allows you to control your car anytime, anywhere, and helps to make sure that your vehicle is safe before traveling. 
You can lock or unlock your car, check tire pressure, oil levels and fuel level, or even your battery charge, right from your iPhone, iPad or Apple Watch. If you forget where you parked your car, Car Key Connect can help you find it. It's an easy way to stay connected to your car and make sure everything is running smoothly.
Car Key App offers a variety of impressive features that enable car owners to conveniently monitor the status of their car directly from their iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch, allowing them to address any issues as soon as they arise promptly. 
Features of Car Key Sync: Car Play Connect App
* Car status on one screen - Check fuel level, battery level, engine oil life, tire pressure, mileage, charging status and more.
* Lock & unlock car - Remotely lock or unlock your car from iPhone, Apple Watch, or iPad.
* Find car's location - Our app will show where you last parked your car and give you directions.
* Navigations & maps - Find important places like fuel stations, charging stations, and nearby garages.
* Digitally share car access - It's super easy and safe to share a car with your friends and family members. 
* Managing your car from Apple Watch - Car Play Connect and lock or unlock your car, check fuel level, battery level, and tire pressure. 
With our AI technology, we confirm that you are in safe hands. It supports popular car brands, such as Audi, BMW, Ford, Cadillac, Chevrolet, Chrysler, Dodge, Ford, GMC, Jaguar, Jeep, Land Rover, Lexus, Lincoln, Mercedes-Benz, MINI, Nissan, RAM, Toyota, Volkswagen, Volvo, Acura, Buick, Hyundai, BMW, Rivian, and Tesla.
Features like Car Tracking, Car Lock and Unlock, Car EV Battery, Car EV Charging, Car Fuel Tank, Car's Tire Pressure, Car's Engine Oil Life, etc are also available in our Car Key Sync: Car Play Connect App.
Security Features
Our backend partner Smartcar's API is encrypted with bank-grade SSL/TLS 1.2 and compliant with the OAuth2 authorization protocol. That means everything is safe, so you can be rest assured while using our Car Play Digital Key Car Connect App.
Notice:
We are not associated with any car companies like GMC, Ford, Toyota, Audi, Jeep, BMW, Tesla, Chrysler, Land Rover, Volkswagen, Acura/Honda, Dodge, Cadillac, Lexus, MINI, RAM, Jaguar, Chevrolet, Mercedes-Benz, Lincoln, Volvo, Buick, etc. Logos and Trademarks of vehicles belong to their respective owners and brands, and it's used for information purposes only, and it does not indicate endorsement or affiliation with us.
Terms & Conditions:
We currently offer the following auto-renewing subscription options for the pro version of Car Connect App that allows users to add unlimited cars.
- $19.99/month, auto-renewable
- $79.99/year, auto-renewable
We also offer one more auto-renewing subscription plan, which allows you to add up to two cars in the CarPlay App.
- $9.99/month, auto-renewable
- $39.99/year, auto-renewable
If a free trial is available, your iTunes Account will be charged within 24 hours of the trial period's end or after you confirm your purchase. The price of the Car Key Remote: Car Play Connect App's subscription plan may vary based on your location.
Your subscription will automatically renew unless you turn off auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Canceling auto-renewal will not affect your current subscription period. You can cancel auto-renewal anytime, but this will not affect the currently active subscription.
Your iTunes Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours of the current period's end and will indicate the renewal cost. If a free trial was provided and you later purchase a subscription, any unused portion of the trial period will be forfeited.Links:
Privacy Policy- https://www.techstic.org/privacy-policy-car-app
Terms of Use (EULA)- https://www.techstic.org/terms-of-use-car-app

bluejetty:00063468:ios.description:
The party game where everyone's talking at once. Hold the phone to your forehead, your friends shout clues, and you guess the word before time runs out. Every category and unlimited rounds, no purchase required.
HOW TO PLAY
• Pick a category and hold the phone to your forehead
• Your friends give clues without saying the word
• Tilt down when you get it, tilt up to skip
• Guess as many as you can before the timer ends
UNLIMITED, NO PURCHASE REQUIRED
• Every category, with new ones added all the time
• Unlimited rounds, as many players as you like
• Video replays of every round, ready to share
HUNDREDS OF CATEGORIES
Movies, animals, music, celebrities, food, sports, cartoons, TV shows and many more.
MAKE YOUR OWN
• Describe any idea and get a ready-to-play category in seconds: "things you do on a road trip", "our office", "90s cartoons"
• Write your own deck word by word, and edit any deck
WATCH THE REPLAY
The front camera films each round, with the words on screen. Watch your friends' best moments again and share the video with anyone.
Perfect for parties, family game night, road trips, sleepovers and holidays.
GUESS WORD PRO (OPTIONAL)
Everything above needs no purchase. You can create 5 categories from a description without buying anything; Guess Word Pro lets you create as many as you like. Choose a monthly subscription, which may start with a free trial, or a one-time Lifetime purchase.
The monthly subscription renews automatically. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends. It renews each month unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.
Privacy Policy: https://float.support/guess-word/privacy
Terms of Use: https://float.support/guess-word/terms

On the iiCE Fitness app, you can view your account, check out our schedule, and book your classes!

bluejetty:00120792:ios.description:
Welcome to 12+, Keshet12's new streaming app, with all of Israel's most popular shows and stars. Download 12+ to your TV, smartphone, and tablet and enjoy the most advanced and convenient way to watch Keshet12's live broadcast and VOD back catalogue, with decades of excellent seasons and series as well exclusive behind-the-scenes and additional content.
On 12+ you'll find Israel's foremost television series, including news programs, Married at First Sight, Rising Star, Ninja Israel, Lehiyot Ita, Master Chef, Ofira & Berkovic, The Cops, Sabri Maranan, Tzomet Miller, and many more. 
The app was developed and designed exclusively by Mako's technological team and stands at the forefront of global streaming; it is designed for all Keshet12 viewers interested in an accessible interface for high-quality free streaming. 
The app allows for a revolutionary viewing experience on mobile, tablets, and smart televisions, and offers Keshet12's and N12 News' entire content catalogue. 
Download the app today to enjoy Israel's favorite shows, plus.
So what's the plus side of the 12+ experience?
• Live broadcasting – Israel's television, brought to you with the advanced, quick, innovative viewing interface you deserve!
• Advanced Catch-Up and Start-Over features – Coming in late? Don't worry – we're here for you, with easy-to-use features to upgrade your viewing experience!
• Wide-ranging VOD service – We've curated, edited, and improved the viewing quality of hundreds of hours of Keshet12 content from throughout the years. Come watch your favorite shows and the greatest stars of today and yesterday.
• Exclusive content – We've created short vignettes, behind-the-scenes content, bloopers, and loads of supplementary content for your favorite Keshet12 properties.
12+ subscription is included in MakoTV packages. Subscription is renewed until cancelled by user. Cancellation of subscription in middle of payment cycle does not grant a partial refund in relation to time left until end of cycle; Keshet12 contents can be viewed until the end of the final month paid for in the subscription. Subscriptions paid for via app store can be cancelled at any moment in personal account settings.

Privacy policy: https://www.mako.co.il/help-terms-of-use/Article-d37908dd1674c11006.htm

We are here with all the answers you may need.

The RBC Mobile* app takes mobile banking to the next level. Everyday banking is always convenient, but our app helps make managing your money even easier. Our fresh and intuitive design gives you easy access to everything you'd expect from a banking app: account balances, money transfers, bill payments, cheque deposits, ATM locations and more. But we didn't stop there. We made it easier to find each feature with improved navigation. Our Action Button and Manage Menu take the most important tools and put them right at your fingertips. The best part? These menus are tailored to each page.
Exclusive to the RBC Mobile app, NOMI plays a big part of the app experience. NOMI Insights help you manage your day-to-day finances with personalized tips and spend trends. NOMI Find & Save helps make saving easy by taking a look at your spending habits to find a little extra money and saves it for you – so you don't have to.
We know you'll love everything the RBC Mobile app offers, and we want you to feel safe and secure using it. Starting at sign in, we've given you access to the latest in biometric identification technology, like Touch ID or Face ID, so you can securely access the app without having to remember your password. If you misplace your credit card, use the app to temporarily lock your card.

bluejetty:00153220:ios.description:
Color Blast 3D: The Ultimate Color-Matching Puzzle Adventure!
Get ready for a vibrant explosion of fun! Color Blast 3D is the addictive color-matching puzzle game that will have you tapping, aiming, and blasting your way through countless levels of delightful challenges.
Dive into a world of dazzling colors and satisfying block-crushing action. With intuitive controls and mind-bending puzzles, Color Blast 3D offers the perfect blend of casual relaxation and strategic thinking. Whether you’re looking for a quick brain teaser or an engaging way to unwind, this game is your next obsession!
Why You’ll Love Color Blast 3D:
- Explosive Color Matching: Line up your shots and tap to blast through clusters of same-colored 3D cubes. Watch them burst in a symphony of satisfying visual effects!
- Addictively Simple, Amazingly Deep: Easy to learn with just a tap, but surprisingly challenging to master. Every shot counts as you navigate tricky formations and unique obstacles.
- Brain-Boosting Fun: Sharpen your mind with clever level designs that test your strategy, timing, and color coordination skills. Perfect for a quick mental workout!
- Stunning 3D Visuals: Immerse yourself in a world of bright, cheerful graphics and dynamic cube physics that make every blast a delight.
- Unleash Powerful Boosters: Supercharge your progress with exciting boosters that help you clear challenging levels and achieve spectacular combos.
- Play Anytime, Anywhere: No Wi-Fi? No problem! Enjoy endless fun and addictive gameplay offline, wherever your adventures take you.
How to Master the Blast:
1. Aim Smart: Target the colorful cube clusters you need to clear.
2. Tap & Blast: Launch your shot to match and destroy the cubes.
3. Create Chain Reactions: Clear blocks from the bottom to make more cubes fall, triggering satisfying cascades.
4. Clear the Board: Strategically blast all the target cubes to conquer each level.
5. Think Ahead: Plan your moves to overcome difficult layouts and unlock bonus points.
Are you ready to become a master of the blast?
Join millions of players who are already hooked on the most satisfying color-matching experience. Download Color Blast 3D now and start your colorful journey to block-busting glory!

bluejetty:00033341:ios.description:
GoArmy Edge Football is a FREE game-changing app created by the U.S. Army, that allows coaches to draw their plays on a digital whiteboard. Get mental reps from the first person perspective or any position on the field with real-time 3D graphics. GoArmy Edge Football comes pre-loaded with many example plays and drills for concepts such as formation recognition and RPO reads. GoArmy Edge Football gives coaches the ability to organize their formations and plays into virtual flashcard drills to teach and test their players.
GoArmy Edge Football features :
- Draw your plays and see them in full 3D.
- Collaborate and share plays and drills with your coaches and players.
- Customize jerseys and uniforms for added realism.
- High fidelity 3D graphics and animations captured from real players.
- See plays in virtual reality, using Google Cardboard on compatible devices.
Any coach, any player at any level can benefit from GoArmy Edge Football.
For best experience, use iPad 4 and above or iPhone 6 and above.

bluejetty:00022584:ios.description:
Image to PDF Converter — the fastest way to turn photos and JPG, PNG, or HEIC files into professional PDFs.
It's like carrying your entire office in your pocket — preserving research materials, organizing important files, and managing documents efficiently wherever you go.
With Image to PDF Converter, you can:
► Convert image to PDF in seconds
Import images from your device or iCloud, or scan paper files with your camera and convert them into PDFs — notes, receipts, invoices, forms, business cards, certificates, whiteboards, ID cards, etc., all supported.
►Resize images
Resize, crop, doodle, and rotate the images as you like. Optimize images for better PDF output.
►Edit PDFs
Add your e-signature anytime. Highlight or annotate with different colors, manage pages, insert text, and compress PDFs with different compression levels for easier sharing and optimized storage.
►Auto sorting
Automatically sort images and PDF files by name, size, created date, modified date, etc. Of course, you can sort manually if you want. 
►Set password
You can set passwords to protect your PDF files, and encrypt confidential files to be shared to prevent others from peeking at them. 
►Work offline
No need to send data to the cloud, easily convert your images to PDF offline.
►Share converted PDF files
Easily send and share converted PDF files via social media, Email, quick share, etc.
►Quick search
Try the quick search function, and you will find it’s easy to find your target files. Just enter the keywords and the results will be displayed automatically.
This app requires permission to access your Camera and Photo Library for PDF conversion.
We will keep working hard to optimize the app and improve the user experience. Please feel free to contact us at imgtopdfios@gmail.com if you have any suggestions.

- Get unlimited access to all features: 
① USD $9.99/month
② USD $29.99/year with 3-day trial
- The payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
- The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Subscription may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to Account Settings after purchase.
- The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication.

bluejetty:00157360:ios.name: MONOPOLY Match
bluejetty:00157360:ios.summary: Step into a world where match-3 puzzles meet the timeless fun of MONOPOLY! MONOPOLY MATCH offers a unique blend of puzzle-solving and board game excitement that will keep you coming back for more. Solve puzzles, roll the dice, and collect p
bluejetty:00157360:ios.description:
Step into a world where match-3 puzzles meet the timeless fun of MONOPOLY! MONOPOLY MATCH offers a unique blend of puzzle-solving and board game excitement that will keep you coming back for more. Solve puzzles, roll the dice, and collect properties as you journey through iconic cities and create the ultimate property empire! Puzzle Your Way to Board Game Glory!
Match ‘n’ Roll
• Match Your Way to Success: Solve fun and challenging Match 3 puzzles to earn dice rolls. The better you do, the more you can explore!
• Roll the Dice: Use your dice rolls to move around the board, collecting properties, earning cash, and building houses and hotels.
• Unlock New Boards: Once you’ve collected every property on the board, a new board filled with fresh challenges and rewards will unlock.
A New Spin on a Classic 
Experience the excitement of MONOPOLY like never before with match 3 gameplay powering your progress!
Addictive Puzzle Challenges 
With hundreds of match 3 levels, you’ll face everything from easy fun to brain-teasing obstacles.
Build Your Empire
Collect iconic properties like Boardwalk and Park Place to unlock new boards!
Iconic MONOPOLY Charm
Enjoy all the classic MONOPOLY elements you love, from Community Chest cards to Jail spaces.
Powerful Boosters
Use helpful tools to clear tricky puzzles, earn extra dice rolls, and speed up your journey.
Wheel & Deal
Cut a deal with wealthy players or spin the wheel for epic rewards.
Free to Play
The game is free to play and offers optional in-game purchases. An internet connection is required to play.
Whether you’re a puzzle enthusiast or a fan of the classic MONOPOLY board game, MONOPOLY MATCH has something for everyone. Solve puzzles, strategize your moves, and watch your empire grow with each board you unlock. Perfect for quick gaming sessions or hours of strategic fun!
It’s time to combine your puzzle-solving skills with your love of MONOPOLY. Roll the dice, collect properties, and see if you have what it takes to dominate every board and become the ultimate tycoon!
