bluejetty:00065316:ios.description:
Payments shouldn’t disrupt the joy of simple pleasures. Whether you’re on the go or on the couch, SnapScan allows you to make quick and easy payments. After installing the app, simply load your bank card and add a secure PIN or enable biometric authentication. It’s as simple as that. 
Pay nice: 
- Shop in-store and online
- Pay for parking at various locations
- Send money to friends 
- Buy prepaid electricity, airtime and data
- Settle bills (via invoices and in the app)
- Donate to charities, and set up recurring monthly donations
Manage your account: 
- Load up to three cards to use for payments
- Add a nickname for each card so you always know which card you’re using
- Top up your SnapScan Wallet and make payments using the funds you loaded
- Authenticate your payments with a 4-digit PIN or biometrics
- Verify your account to withdraw money from your Wallet to your linked bank account, or send money in your Wallet to a friend
What you need:
A valid credit or eCommerce-enabled debit card (SnapScan works with all South African banks and most international credit cards).
A South African cellphone number
Need help?
Our team is here for you at help@snapscan.co.za
For additional information or to sign up as a merchant, visit our website: www.snapscan.co.za
Powered by Standard Bank

listings.description:
See every episode’s rating at a glance. Series Graph turns public ratings into color-coded episode rating graphs and season charts, so you know which TV shows are worth starting, which seasons are the best, and which episodes to skip before you press play.

Track what you watch, rate episodes with decimal precision, build rating charts, ranked lists and tier lists, and share them with a community of TV and anime fans.

WHY SERIES GRAPH
Most TV trackers give you one score for an entire series. Series Graph is an episode tracker and episode guide in one: every episode rating, every season, in a single visual chart. Spot the dip in season 4, find the best episodes of a 200-episode anime, see the worst episodes to skip, decide what to watch next, and compare two shows side by side.

DISCOVER NEW TV SHOWS
Trending, popular and Top 250 TV series. Episode and season rating graphs and charts. Public ratings, plus MyAnimeList scores for anime episodes. Compare shows head-to-head. Movie franchises and collections with timeline view. Where to watch, with streaming availability by region. Hidden gems, related shows and TV show recommendations.

TRACK YOUR SHOWS
Watchlist with statuses, badges and progress bars. Episode tracker for every series you’re watching. Rate episodes, seasons and series with decimal ratings and slider input. Episode reviews and tags. Custom rating colors, buckets and chart fonts. Custom season structures for cour-split anime.

CREATE RANKINGS AND CHARTS
Custom rating charts built from your own episode ratings. Ranked lists of shows, seasons and episodes. Tier lists for episodes, seasons and characters. Fictional charts where you invent your own series with episodes and storylines. Character rankings, villain rankings and favorite characters. Share any chart, list or tier list as an image.

JOIN THE COMMUNITY
Follow TV fans, anime fans and creators. Comment on episodes with spoiler protection. Browse community charts, lists and tier lists. Customizable public profile. Reply notifications.

SERIES GRAPH PLUS
Unlimited charts, no ads, custom profile, advanced stats and more. Earn Graph Coins by watching a short video and trade them for Plus, no card needed. Or gift Plus to someone you follow.

PERFECT FOR
TV show tracker, episode tracker, anime tracker, series tracker, watchlist app, episode ratings, rating graphs, season rankings, tier lists, best episodes, binge guide, what to watch, TV show recommendations and TV fan communities.

bluejetty:00044476:ios.description:
A Safe And Family-Friendly Entertainment Solution
Have you ever watched a great movie, but wished they hadn’t used quite so much crude language? Have you ever tried to watch a movie or tv show with your kids but suddenly things go in an unexpected direction, and you can’t fast forward or turn it off fast enough? Have you worried about how increased profanity, violence, and sexual content in entertainment today are impacting your child’s mental health and could increase aggressive behavior? Well, keep reading to discover what we believe is just the right solution for you.
A Clean Version Of Netflix, Prime, And Many More.
Start streaming through Enjoy to mute the crude and abusive language automatically and skip adult content* so you can enjoy cringe-free movie time with your family again. If someone asks, “How can I get a clean version of Netflix?” You’ve got the perfect answer.
Revolutionize Your Movie-Watching Experience
Enjoy Movies Your Way is like a super smart remote control for major streaming platforms like Netflix, Prime Video, Hulu, HBO, Disney+, and YouTube. Simply connect your existing streaming accounts and start filtering! You can stream any movie through the Enjoy app with language filters auto-generated from subtitles.
Violence and nudity filters are also available for a growing library of thousands of fully tagged shows. In addition to language, violence, and sexual content, Enjoy can also filter drugs, alcohol, and a dozen other potentially triggering themes (like bullying, suicide, disturbing images, etc.). It can mute the sound, skip sections entirely, and black out or blur the video.
Wait, Is This Legal?
What about copyright law? Enjoy does not modify the original videos in any way, but instead plays them selectively, which US copyright law allows (ref. Family Movie Act 2005). Therefore, Enjoy does not infringe upon media copyrights and is perfectly legal. Content providers collect their subscription, rental, or purchase fees directly and without interference. Enjoy users are simply exercising their right to see or not to see specific content according to personal preference. Considering the necessity of our service with increasingly inappropriate content in today’s entertainment, we offer it free with all filtering features enabled.
Movie Filtering For Everyone
Our competitors only offer paid plans, but we believe filtering should be available for everyone for free or at a minimal cost. With the free plan, there will be a 1-minute intermission for every 15 minutes of viewing time. Use that intermission to grab a snack or answer texts! Do you think you might use Enjoy infrequently? Then the free plan might be just right for you. Or, remove the intermission breaks and support what Enjoy is doing by subscribing to the paid plan for only $6 per month.
Stream Over 360k+ Movies And Shows Through Enjoy
Depending on which services you have connected, you can stream over 360,000 movies and shows through Enjoy, and every show will have at least automatic language filters available! We also have a growing library of thousands of fully tagged shows allowing you to filter all categories of content (i.e. violence, sexual content, etc.).
If for some reason the movie you want is not in the database, you can always create the filters yourself using Tag mode**. Or you can reach out to us to request the movie get prioritized for filtering by the Enjoy tagging teams.
Movie Aggregator With Advanced Features
Enjoy is also a movie aggregator showing you all the places where a particular show is available to stream. Plus, there are more features like playback speed control, robust subtitle translations, and much more. Our content filtering features include language and graphic* content filtering for movies, shows, and even YouTube videos.
* Violence and nudity are only skipped in fully-tagged shows.
** Available on all platforms except Roku

bluejetty:00186505:ios.description:
Watch the British Council’s most popular English language videos in LearnEnglish Videos.
Improve your listening, reading and understanding of general and business English – any time, anywhere. LearnEnglish Videos has lots of special features that make learning English fun. 
The videos are downloadable any time, so you can access the content offline. Then when you have finished with an episode, you can delete it to make space on your phone.
 LearnEnglish Videos – key features
* New videos are added every week, so you never run out of things to watch. We have videos on a range of topics, from language learning tips to travel, so there is something for everyone.
* Downloadable episodes mean you can watch offline. But don’t worry, when you have done with an episode you can delete it, so it doesn’t use up space on your phone.
* The interactive audio scripts make it easy for you to repeat phrases or new vocabulary if they are hard to hear. Plus, pitch control means you can slow down the video speed if the speaker is a bit difficult to understand.
* Three styles of player – portrait 1 (video and script), portrait 2 (script only) and landscape (video only) – make it easy for you to manage your learning experience.
* Enjoy simple exercises for every episode of content, with a progress screen so you can track your progress.
* Share what you’re watching and listening to through Facebook, Twitter and email with integrated social media sharing. Celebrate your progress with your friends.
Feedback
All feedback is welcome. If you are experiencing any problems with the app, please email us at learnenglish.mobile@britishcouncil.org with a short description of the issue and as much info about your phone and operating system as you can give us. bluejetty:00044405:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00044405:ios.description:
Rescue colourful cats to fill your boat in a new digital adaptation of the beloved board game.
Citizens of Squall’s End! Lookouts have spotted the sails of the evil Lord Vesh on the horizon! We must save the Isle of Cats before he arrives!
The Isle of Cats is a competitive board game race to save a colourful collection of cats, scoring points based on how well you settle them into your personal rescue boat.
Each cat comes on a unique tile and belongs to a family of cats of its color. You must find an arrangement to fit them in your boat, while keeping families together and managing your resources along the way. Befriend mystical Oshax, read ancient lessons, and collect treasures to propel your boat to victory!
Rescues
Once you’ve mastered the basics, level up your game with rotating Rescues! Every few days, a new Rescue will add twists on rules and objectives to add some catnip to your single-player PVE games. See how you measure up against the competition on seasonal leaderboards!
Challenges
Ten tricky challenges – each with two levels of difficulty – provide a puzzly twist to classic gameplay. What if boats are full of treasure? What if your cats are roaming freely, with no placement rules? What if they keep to themselves, and don’t like other cats? Challenges give you new ways to play and explore!
Achievements
15 achievements measure your progress on the Isle. From your first days as Skipper to your rise to Master Mariner, achievements show you how your game improves!

Welcome to the official NBA G League app, your trusted companion for the official minor league of the NBA. Whether you're a seasoned basketball fan, or just discovering the NBA G League, our app is designed to keep you informed and on the latest for the G League Ignite and all other NBA affiliate teams.
Key Features:
Live Game Streaming and Statistics: Never miss a moment of action with free live game streaming, right in the app. Stay updated with real-time game statistics, and turn on notifications to effortlessly follow player and team performance.
Up-to-Date G League News: Stay informed with the latest G League updates in the news and on social. From player trades to standout moments, we keep you in the loop without overwhelming you.

Personalized Experience: Customize your app experience by logging in with your NBA ID. Follow your favorite G League teams and players to receive tailored updates and notifications. Keep track of what matters most.
Discover Emerging Talent: The G League is where future basketball stars emerge. Explore the excitement of watching up-and-coming talents striving for greatness.

Регистрация в приложении "MobiГап" производится только с номера "Вавилон-Мобайл", которое после установки автоматически синхронизируется со списком контактов Вашего телефона и определяет, у кого из Ваших контактов уже установлен "MobiГап".

обмениваться бесплатными сообщениями внутри приложения;
∙ совершать голосовые/видео звонки по Таджикистану, а так же звонить из любой точки мира в Таджикистан по выгодным ценам;
∙ обмениваться медиафайлами со своими родными и близкими;
∙ совершать конференц-сообщения между группами людей (чат).
Приложение доступно на 3 языках:
таджикский, русский и английский, с возможностью добавлять/ редактировать свои персональные данные (имя, фото, статус сообщения).
* Тарификация исходящих голосовых звонков будет производиться согласно тарифного плана абонента компании «Вавилон-Мобайл».
* Так же может взиматься дополнительная плата за соединение с Интернетом, в зависимости от вашего Оператора.

— What You Can Do with Glossika Legacy —
bluejetty:00160883:ios.description:
Glossika Legacy is built around audio: thousands of sentences recorded by native speakers in 65 languages, with practice that fits your day, whether you're at your desk, on your commute, or offline.
— What You Can Do with Glossika Legacy —
① Hear Real Native Speakers
Every sentence is recorded by a native speaker. Pick up grammar and vocabulary naturally through sentences carefully chosen to build on what you already know.
② Train Your Ear and Your Tongue
Type, listen, recall, and record yourself. Each exercise connects what you hear to what you read and say, turning familiar sentences into ones you can actually use.
③ Review at the Right Time
Sentences come back just before you're likely to forget them, so your review time goes where it matters most. Follow your recommended review list, or go through sentences in order at your own pace.
④ Learn Hands-Free on the Go
Driving, commuting, or working out? Turn on Listening-only Mode, press play, and keep up your daily reps without touching your phone.
⑤ Keep Practicing Offline
Download new and review sessions before a flight or a ride underground, and keep practicing without internet.
— Recommended If You —
・Learn through comprehensible input
・Learn best by ear
・Want to practice while you drive, commute, or work out
・Like building a language one sentence at a time
・Need to keep practicing without internet

bluejetty:00159941:ios.summary:
In Jamazing, music plays your way! Lead a virtual band, craft remixes, and turn songs interactive. Embrace your inner DJ and control the beat!
Jamazing: Craft Music Your Way
Dive into Jamazing for a seamless music-making experience that's
bluejetty:00159941:ios.description:
In Jamazing, music plays your way! Lead a virtual band, craft remixes, and turn songs interactive. Embrace your inner DJ and control the beat!
Jamazing: Craft Music Your Way
Dive into Jamazing for a seamless music-making experience that's as simple as tapping and sliding your fingers across your screen. Whether you're venturing into music creation for the first time or seeking a new way to experiment with sound, Jamazing welcomes everyone to an enjoyable journey.
Your Personal Sound Playground
With Jamazing, you get to play conductor to your pocket band. Choose moods like 'mystic' or 'energetic' to set the tone, then mix and match to see your guitarist, drummer, and keyboardist come together to bring your vision to life. It's all about fun, creativity, and discovering where your mood takes the music.
Endless Musical Exploration
Your journey in Jamazing knows no bounds. By blending different moods and musicians, you unlock fresh sounds and effects, making every creation a unique auditory adventure. It's your very own musical sandbox, inviting you to play, experiment, and craft without limits, ensuring an easy and enjoyable exploration for all.
Create the Soundtrack to Your Life
Jamazing empowers you to be the DJ of your own life, offering the tools to craft the perfect mood for any situation. Whether you're setting the scene for a calm evening or looking to energize your surroundings, you have the power to shape your moments with music.
Connect Through Your Creations
Sharing in Jamazing is about more than just putting your music out there; it's about connecting with a community that values creativity and musical exploration. With a diverse range of music and creators, Jamazing is not just an app—it's a platform for expressing yourself, discovering new sounds, and collaborating with others on your musical journey.
Embark on Your Musical Adventure
If you're curious about discovering your musical potential, Jamazing is the perfect place to start. Easy, fun, and filled with possibilities, it invites you to dive in and see where your creativity and moods can take you. With support and resources at every step, download now and let your musical adventure unfold.
Premium Experience
Unlock all jams, moods, and effects with the Jamazing Premium Subscription. Choose from various subscription options tailored to your enjoyment.
Payment Details
- Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase.
- The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
Subscription Management
- You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Apple ID Account Settings after purchase.
- For more information, please visit the link https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription to that publication.
Terms of Use: https://jamazing.band/termsofuse
Privacy Policy: https://jamazing.band/privacypolicy

bluejetty:00123330:ios.description:
YONO SBI is the official mobile banking app from State Bank of India (SBI) for secure money transfers, UPI payments, online banking, bill payment, savings accounts, credit cards, loans, and investments. YONO SBI is the only companion you need to navigate the modern financial landscape.
Have a question or need assistance for YONO SBI App? For instant support and quick resolution raise the issue on our dedicated site https://crh.sbi.bank.in or call 1800-1111-01.
What’s New in YONO?
· A minimalist, high-speed UI/UX for effortless navigation and one-tap access to your most-used features.
· Complete e-KYC or update the personal details feature for instant support without visiting a branch.
· Monitor your financial health and use our new simulator to see how your actions impact your credit score.
· Receive offers, investment tips, and spend analysis tailored specifically to your lifestyle and financial goals.
Instant Banking and Onboarding
· Open a Savings Account Instantly: Use Video KYC for paperless account opening with immediate activation.
· Instant Account Funding: Fund your new account the moment it’s active and start transacting right away.
· YONO Cash: Experience cardless ATM withdrawals at over 20,000+ SBI ATMs across India.
Seamless Payments and Transfer
· Enhanced UPI Experience: Lightning-fast UPI payments. Scan any QR, pay via phone number, or manage your UPI Lite for small-value transactions without a PIN.
· UPI for Everyone: Make fast, secure money transfers with SBI UPI. No SBI account required.
· Smart Bill Payments: Effortlessly pay electricity, water, gas, and broadband bills. Set up Autopay & reminders to avoid late fees.
· Global remittances: Securely send money across borders at competitive forex rates with real-time tracking.
Investments and Loans
· Mutual Fund Hub: Manage your portfolio, start a new SIP, or explore top-rated funds directly from the app.
· Instant Loans: Apply for pre-approved Personal Loans, Car Loans, or the new Insta Home Top-Up Loan with zero paperwork.
· Smart Deposits: Open Fixed Deposits (FD) or Recurring Deposits (RD) with a single tap and view your accrued interest in real-time.
· NPS & PPF Management: Secure your retirement by managing your National Pension System (NPS) and Public Provident Fund (PPF) accounts seamlessly.
Shopping, Travel, and Lifestyle
· YONO Marketplace: Exclusive deals from India’s top brands in electronics, fashion, & home decor.
· Travel Companion: Book flights, hotels, with integrated rewards.
· Loyalty Points: Earn & redeem SBI Rewardz points across a massive catalogue of products and gift vouchers.
Security and Control
· Digital Lock/Unlock: Instantly lock or unlock your debit card, manage international usage, and set transaction limits for safety.
· Advanced Biometrics: Log in securely using FaceID or TouchID.
· 24/7 Support: Access YONO customer care directly from the app or raise complaints and track them in real-time.
More Ways to Bank
• Passbook & Statements: Access your account passbook & download transaction statements whenever you need them.
• Quick Pay: Transfer funds up to prescribed limits to beneficiaries without adding them first, making urgent payments faster and simpler.
• Service on the Go: Request cheque books, update personal details, track service requests, and access important banking services directly from the app.
• Personalised Insights: Gain a clearer understanding of your spending habits with smart analytics and recommendations designed to help you manage money better.
YONO SBI isn't just an app - it's financial freedom. From first accounts to mutual funds and deposits, one personalised journey for every Indian.
Key Technical Details
· Optimised for iOS 17.0 and above
· Available in English, Hindi & 11 more languages.
· Your financial data is protected by industry-leading end-to-end encryption.
Download the all-new YONO SBI today and discover why "You Only Need One."

• Endless Puzzle Mode: After conquering levels, challenge yourself with endless puzzles to keep the unscrewing fun going
• Enjoy new daily challenges with special rewards for completing jam-packed levels

bluejetty:00081793:ios.description:
Welcome to Pet Shop Fever: a frenzy animal hotel where every second matters!
Your mission is clear: keeping these pets happy and healthy while ensuring your customers leave with smiles on their faces. The clock is ticking, are you ready to join us?
Discover Pet Shop Fever's unique features:
- Challenge yourself in a dynamic and fast-paced time management experience
- Advance through 220 levels between the Suburbs, the City, the Metropolis and the Capital
- Offer a variety of services, including bathing, grooming and veterinary care at specialized stations
- Improve your Pet Hotel with upgrades to bathtubs, furniture and grooming stations
- Unlock new captivating characters and add them to your team
- Increase your efficiency with Power-Ups and ensure the success of your Pet Shop
- Earn achievements and rewards as you progress through the levels 
- Fun and regular updates to keep the gameplay fresh and challenging
Pet Shop Fever requires excellent time management skills to care for the pets. Master the art of prioritization, speed, and agility in this fast-paced experience where every second counts!
Care for pets with baths, grooming, and essential veterinary attention. Your goal is to ensure the health and happiness of a variety of pets, including dogs, cats, birds, rabbits, and more!
Pet Shop Fever is not just a Pet Hotel Game; it's a race against the clock! Manage your time efficiently to handle the increasing flow of adorable customers. Stay quick and efficient to prevent pets from becoming impatient and escaping!
Explore diverse worlds as you expand your Pet Shop empire, from tranquil suburbs to bustling cities and metropolises, with more to come!
Earn and strategically use points to expand your Pet Shop and unlock new characters for your staff. Embark on daily quests to earn more points and unlock rewards including coins, gems and surprise gifts!
Enhance efficiency with Power-ups to improve your Animal Store, including:
- Speed Boost: Accelerate tasks and activities within your Pet Shop, serving more customers in less time.
- Coin Boost: Increase in-game currency earned from customer transactions, enabling faster progress and upgrades.
- Time Extension Boost: Add extra time to time-limited tasks or events, ensuring ample opportunities to complete them successfully.
Experience a fast-paced blend of strategy, speed, and joy in caring for adorable pets In Pet Shop Fever! 
This is an entirely free offline game. Optional in-game purchases are available for extra features and additional packages.

bluejetty:00099056:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00099056:ios.description:
BRAINSSS
The walking dead are on the move, and it’s your job to take them out in this zombie tower defense game that is chock full of collectible weapons and strategy. With each new zombie wave you’ll have a chance to merge weapons and move them around to find the best combos thanks to the simulator aspect of this zombie shooter game. Along the way, collect all sorts of exciting weapons, towers, equipment, and more to help you blast these zombies off the face of the earth.
THE BEST DEFENSE IS OFFENSE
This simulator strategy game will really get your gears turning! Each level will involve waves of zombies trying to attack your tower – your goal is to defend your tower and wipe these creatures out. Carefully pick your weapons, merge them to form powerful versions, and try moving them around with each new round to see how that affects the outcome.
Fantastic features:
- Top strategy – Usually simulators are more mundane, like hotels, but who says they can’t be about the zombie apocalypse? Face your foes in abandoned lots and strategically funnel them towards all of your carefully placed weapons, while also making sure to maintain a good defense of your home base! This zombie shooter also allows you to change up the weapon placement in between rounds, adding an extra layer of fun as you try different methods and see which will ensure your survival.
- Endless waves – What good is a simulator if you can’t actually test your great ideas! Thanks to the wave upon wave of walking dead, you’ll never run out of targets to practice on. Like all good zombie survival games you’ll have to make sure that you don’t end up as one the bad guys too, so make sure to shore up your tower defense.
- Collectible fun – weapons, clothing, equipment, towers, you name it – you can collect it, level it up, and use it to fight back in this zombie apocalypse shooter! Use your gold and coin wisely to level up during rounds, and make sure you check out your inventory afterwards to see what all you got and how you can best use it in this survival game.
THE ZOMBIE APOCALYPSE IS NOW
Grab your weapons, man the towers, and strike before they can bite! Combine survival games, strategy games, and tower defense games into one, add a hefty dose of zombies, and you’ve got Zombie Fortress! Collect weapons and try out various strategies as you fight off waves of the undead, and along the way enjoy building out your character and their tower. With great graphics and lots of customization, you won’t want to miss trying your hand at this game!

Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

Zen Radio helps you cater to your well-being with a broad spectrum of relaxing sounds. If you're looking for meditation music, a path to calmness or want to get a more positive outlook on life, it's all just a tap away. Find your favorite channels, press play and enjoy the music! 
Features: 
- Over 35 different stations of relaxation music streaming 24/7 
- CarPlay support: listen to your favorite music all in a way that allows you to stay focused on the road.
- Stream exclusive music, hand-picked by dedicated channel curators with decades of experience
- Use the style filters to find your favorite music styles and save your favorites for easy access 
- Share tracks and channels you've discovered with friends 
- Stream music from the open app or in the background 
- Control audio and view track titles from the lock screen 
- Use the Sleep Timer to fall asleep to music without draining your battery or data plan

Shamanic Music
Tibetan Singing Bowls
Reiki
Zen

Nature

Put the measurements you take right on the photos you share.
SizeSnap helps contractors, cabinetmakers, interior designers, and installers turn site photos and PDF pages into clear measurement records. Add measured dimensions, show installation details, and share JPGs or PDFs that clients and crews can follow.
MARK DIMENSIONS WHERE THEY BELONG
Take a photo or import images and PDFs. Draw dimension lines, enter your measurements, and add arrows or text to explain each location. Use shapes and freehand drawing to highlight details. Keep the numbers beside the objects they describe instead of matching separate notes to photos later.
CONTROL THE SMALL DETAILS
Add dimensions with slide markup, then fine-tune placement with the magnifier, horizontal and vertical snapping, endpoint snapping, guides, and grids. Use the virtual cursor for small targets and layers to select and arrange annotations. Adjust colors, line widths, fonts, and labels for readable results.
SHOW CABINETRY AND INSTALLATION DETAILS
Use chain dimensions for cabinet sections and baseline dimensions for positions measured from a shared reference point. Add detail magnifiers, arrows, and notes to explain joints, access openings, or installation requirements. Keep the overall dimensions and close-up details in one visual record.
WORK IN YOUR UNITS
Convert between millimeters, centimeters, meters, inches, and feet. Choose metric, imperial, or combined results to suit your job. Keep measurements readable for the people who need them.
KEEP EACH JOB TOGETHER
Organize projects by folders, documents, and pages. Move photos between records, regroup your work, and recover recently deleted items from Trash. Sync projects and markups between your own iPhone and iPad with iCloud. Use edit history to review and restore earlier annotation versions.
SHARE RESULTS IN THE RIGHT FORMAT
• Export annotated JPGs for clients, colleagues, and installers
• Bring multiple photo records together in a PDF
• Batch import and export files, or preserve project structure in ZIP archives
• Combine photos from one document into a single long image
• Share editable SizeSnap project files for compatible workflows and later changes
ADD CONTEXT BEYOND THE PHOTO
Record audio or video annotations of up to 30 seconds for details that need an explanation. Share playable media in compatible SizeSnap project files. JPG and PDF exports contain static markers, not playable recordings.
SizeSnap records and presents measurements you enter. It does not automatically measure physical objects from a photo.

bluejetty:00027097:ios.summary: Volleyball Rotations is the visual rotation planner for volleyball coaches and players. Build your system, teach it to your team, and now take live stats right on the court. A subscription or one-time purchase is required to build and manag
bluejetty:00027097:ios.description:
Volleyball Rotations is the visual rotation planner for volleyball coaches and players. Build your system, teach it to your team, and now take live stats right on the court. A subscription or one-time purchase is required to build and manage rotations, with a free trial available. Player Access offers read-only viewing of a coach's shared rotations.
BUILD YOUR ROTATIONS
• Create up to 6 rotations from proven templates: 4-2, 5-1, 6-2, 6-3, 6-6, or fully custom
• Customize every formation: serve receive, attack, serve/stack, and defense
• Drag players exactly where you want them on the court
• Choose who serves each rotation, including bench servers, with libero and serving rules kept legal automatically
RUN YOUR ROSTER
• Roster with names, jersey numbers, positions, and colors
• On-court lineup editor: tap a player to change their name, position, or color
• Auto-fill later rotations from the current one, or shift the whole lineup with one tap
• Real line-up sheet, laid out like the official paper one, ready for the scorer's table
• Clean black and white printouts of all rotations with your notes
TAKE STATS LIVE
• Tap a player to log kills, tips, blocks, digs, passes, aces, assists, and errors
• Live scoreboard updates automatically as you record points
• The court follows the rally, switching formations as the serve changes hands
• Hitting and serving percentages for every player: Kill%, kill efficiency, Ace%
• Group sets into matches, review any saved session, and resume right where you left off
• Every set ends with a plain-English game summary ready to share with the team
SHARE WITH YOUR TEAM
• Your unique Rotations Key shares your whole setup by QR code, text, or email
• Players follow along in read-only Player Access Mode
• Import another coach's rotations in seconds
• Cloud backup and sync: sign in with your email and your rotations follow you to any device
MAKE IT YOURS
• Theme picker with live preview, including a fully custom court color theme
• Pin your favorite actions to the top bar
• Score tracker and automatic substitution counter
Terms of Use: https://volleyballrotations.app/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://volleyballrotations.app/privacy/

bluejetty:00016988:ios.name: PreSonus QMix®-UC
bluejetty:00016988:ios.summary: PreSonus® QMix-UC monitor mix app turns your mobile device into a powerful personal monitoring controller for StudioLive® Series III digital mixers. Whether you’re a busy front-of-house engineer looking for a better way to manage monitors,
bluejetty:00016988:ios.description:
PreSonus® QMix-UC monitor mix app turns your mobile device into a powerful personal monitoring controller for StudioLive® Series III digital mixers. Whether you’re a busy front-of-house engineer looking for a better way to manage monitors, or a musician who’s ready to take control of their own stage mix, QMix-UC makes remotely controlling aux mixes easy, flexible, and intuitive. Just connect your device to the same wireless network as your StudioLive Series III mixer, and you’re in control of your mix.
Features:
Provides wireless control over any StudioLive Series III mixer
Remote-control aux mix send levels and panning
Create up to 4 channel groups
Wheel of Me controls the relative level of all customized “Me” channels with one simple control
Compatible Series III hardware includes:
StudioLive 64S
StudioLive 32S
StudioLive 32SX
StudioLive 32SC
StudioLive 32
StudioLive 24
StudioLive 16
StudioLive 32R
StudioLive 24R
StudioLive 16R
Note: StudioLive 16.0.2USB, and StudioLive AI- and RM-series mixers should still continue to work as usual in this app, but are no longer officially supported. No further work is planned for the AI mixer series in this app.
System Requirements
Supported:
- Compatible with iPhone or iPod Touch running iOS 11.4 or later
Control of supported mixers requires that the mobile device running be connected to the same wireless network as a StudioLive Series III mixer.
StudioLive Classic mixers (16.0.2 FireWire, 16.4.2, 24.4.2) require QMix and are not compatible with QMix-UC

bluejetty:00126751:ios.description:
Nightcam is a perfect manual camera app for shooting the gorgeous day and night photos on any iPhone. Nightcam not only presents a good algorithm for night photography but also provides one of the best user experiences. We basically try to think about all the demands a user wants while trying to catch the best scenes of travel plans or any other good memories. 
DOWNLOADED BY OVER 1M+ USERS
************************************
"Everyone I do like this camera it really does a good job even on auto all night" by Darlene .Smith
"This app gives off the perfect amount of long exposure to get a nicely lit photo, even on my iPhone XR the photos look as if they were short on an 11 or more. I love how natural the colours stay too." by fjsjvnevokavjslve
"I like this app! I can finally have night mode in my phone for a minimal size app, not space consuming.. Please continue doing upgrades" by CHRYS0808
"Unbelievably great!! You can say goodbye to all the noise in the night shots." niloofar.k
************************************
TWO MODES, LIMITLESS POSSIBILITIES
Nightcam offers two distinct approaches to photography. Its Automatic Mode instantly analyzes the scene, setting the optimal parameters for exceptional day and night shots—perfect for capturing fleeting moments. On the other hand, Manual Mode unlocks advanced controls, enabling you to refine exposure duration, ISO, and white balance. Combined with powerful tools like focus peaking, histograms, grids, and a stability visualizer, you have all you need to frame professional-grade compositions.
NEW VIDEO AND TIME LAPSE
Nightcam now goes beyond still photography with entirely new Video and Time Lapse experiences. Record video in Standard, Night, and Moon modes with manual controls, HDR, low-light processing, audio monitoring, and torch support. Create Time Lapse videos with adjustable speeds, Long Exposure, and Light Trails.
SPECIALIZED NIGHT MODES FOR EVERY SCENE
This latest update introduces dedicated night modes, each crafted for specific low-light conditions:
Northern Lights Mode: Capture breathtaking auroras with clarity and depth.
Moon Mode: Highlight lunar details and subtle lunar glow.
Night Auto: Let the app handle the settings for stress-free night shooting.
Night HDR: Enhance contrast, detail, and depth in challenging low-light scenarios.
Night RAW: Preserve every detail in uncompressed form for ultimate editing flexibility.
Stars Mode: Turn starry skies into dazzling constellations of light.
Long Exposure (up to 30s): Create dramatic light trails and capture scenes impossible to see with the naked eye.
ADAPTIVE TOOLS FOR PERFECT COMPOSITIONS
Nightcam integrates intuitive features to ensure every shot meets your vision:
Focus Peaking & Focus Loupe: Fine-tune manual focus effortlessly.
Adaptive Exposure: Seamlessly balance brightness and detail.
Grid & Level Tool: Achieve perfect symmetry and alignment.
Tripod Mode: Stabilize your device for sharp, blur-free images.
Night AI Enhancer: Improve clarity in dim conditions, even post-capture.
POWERFUL COMPUTATIONAL PHOTOGRAPHY
Under the hood, Nightcam employs advanced algorithms and countless experiments to enhance low-light performance. 
ADDITIONAL FEATURES
AI-based low-light image enhancement
High-quality image capture options
Self-timer, torch, geotagging for situational convenience
Real-time histogram and preview analysis
RAW mode with advanced controls
Intelligent post-processing for true-to-life colors and contrast
With Nightcam, every scene—from a bustling city at dusk to a serene, starry sky—becomes a masterpiece waiting to be captured.
Nightcam Pro Subscription
Access all features of Nightcam with Nightcam Pro. Subscriptions are billed monthly or annually at the rate selected depending on the subscription plan.

- Privacy policy: https://www.rayinformatics.com/privacy

bluejetty:00168356:ios.name: The Movement: Erin Stutland
bluejetty:00168356:ios.summary: Bestselling author, fitness expert, award-winning TV host and proud mama Erin Stutland brings her signature blend of movement, mantras, and music to life inside The Movement through uplifting workouts, energizing audio soundtracks, and grou
bluejetty:00168356:ios.description:
Bestselling author, fitness expert, award-winning TV host and proud mama Erin Stutland brings her signature blend of movement, mantras, and music to life inside The Movement through uplifting workouts, energizing audio soundtracks, and grounding meditations designed to help you make BIG changes in your body, mind, and life from a place of power and love. 
At home or on the go, get access to The Movement’s daily movement + meditations and be prepared to find working out fun again, feel more at ease in your body and mind, tone and tighten your body, transform unhelpful beliefs and negative thoughts, experience more gratitude and less stress, and gain more confidence and energy.
INSIDE THE MOVEMENT
With her positive approach to self care + accountability and her non-judgmental attitude, Erin will show you that you don’t need a lot of space or a lot of time to get the results you want. Dive in today to find:  
Workouts: For every mood + every level. All workouts incorporate mindfulness and/or mantras, and are broken down by:
>> ELEVATE: Slow, controlled workouts to help tone and sculpt
>> ENERGIZE: Cardio-based workouts to raise your vibration and your heart rate
>> EASE: Stretching workouts to relax your body and mind into the moment. 
Ranging from 5, 10, 15, 30 and 40 minutes, workouts vary in style but always promise to transform negative, stuck energy into power and strength.
Meditations: Tune into your breath to become more present, release stress from the day, and improve your sleep with a library of meditations to choose from for any time of day.
Soul Strolls: Erin’s signature energizing soundtracks that combine music + mantras + motivation to transform a walk, run, bike ride, or weight lifting workout into a fun jam session. (Also great for commutes, dancing with the kids, or doing the dishes!)
Weekly M + M’s: No need to think about what to do each day, Erin provides you with a daily movement + meditation schedule, so you can effortlessly vary lengths and styles of workouts every day. 
Erin’s Lazy Kitchen, Coaching for Success, and The Movement Community: Erin supports you with healthy meal planning, tips and tools to help you achieve success, and a private community guaranteed to inspire and uplift you on your journey.
The Movement membership gives you an ever-growing library of practical tools at your fingertips to design the life and body you want…and find unparalleled joy in the process.
▷ Already a Member? Sign-In to access your subscription.
▷ New? Try it for free! Subscribe in the app to get instant access.
The Movement offers an auto-renewing subscription that will allow you unlimited access to content on all your devices. Payment is charged to your Account at confirmation of purchase.
Pricing varies by location and is confirmed prior to purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. Cancel anytime in Account Settings.
For more information see our:
-Terms of Service: https://erinstutland.com/terms-conditions/
-Privacy Policy: https://erinstutland.com/privacy-policy/
The Movement includes Apple Watch
- You can track your workouts and meet your fitness goals.
- Monitor Stats during Workouts: View heart rate/calories burned on your watch & video player.
- HEALTH App: Apple Watch integrates with Apple's Health app (Healthkit) to track workouts, duration, calories burned, heart rate, and active energy. You choose the data you want stored, and you can change it anytime in the Health app.
- FITNESS App: Apple Watch integrates with Apple's Fitness App, and workouts contribute to your daily goals. View stats, share your activity, and get those Activity Rings!
- Use your Watch as a Remote: Play, stop, & rewind videos without interrupting workouts.
- Install using iPhone: Install app on iPhone, open Watch app, select "Show on Apple Watch".

bluejetty:00023355:ios.description:
Nonograms appeared at the end of the 20th century and became popular all over the world. They are also known as Japanese crosswords, Japanese puzzles, Japanese drawings, PathPix, Griddlers, Paint by Numbers, Picross, hanjie etc. 
Japanese crossword is a very popular puzzle game. 
In the Nonograms, unlike conventional crosswords and arrowwords, a picture instead of words is conceal by means of numbers.
Please have a look at these black-n-white Nonograms. They are divided into several groups by resolution depending on the crossword width and height.
If you like Philippine puzzles, you will definitely like Nonograms too.
All Nonograms have their own single solution.
The grid is formed by horizontal and vertical lines. Numbers on the top and on the left show the sequence order of blocks of filled-in squares horizontally and vertically correspondingly. The blocks are unbroken, and two nearby blocks must have at least one empty (unfilled) cell in between.
The blocks follow one another exactly in the order shown by the corresponding numbers.
Nonograms are solved in the following way:
– First, you need to determine which cells are to be filled;
– Second, you need to determine which cells cannot be filled: these are marked with crosses.
This process is repeated until the crossword is solved.
App features:
– More than a thousand of free Japanese crosswords of various width and height sizes (10x10, 15x15, 20x20, 25x25, 30x30 etc);
– Zoom mode allows you to solve even large Japanese crosswords;
– Portrait and landscape orientation support;
– Undo option (up to 100 actions can be undone);
– Light and dark color scheme support;
– Font size is automatically changed depending on the size of the crossword and your device screen orientation and size.
If you think of yourself as a genuine enthusiast of Nonograms you absolutely have to give JCross a try! This original Crossword Painter is without any doubt a remarkable representative of its genre. Just think about it: why download several different apps when you can have one with tons of various Picrosses already in it and a lot more on their way. It really doesn’t matter whether you want to rack your brains by doing a sophisticated Nonogram or you need a trivial Paint by Numbers to kill time – JCross has all of them!
Put it all together with some nice intuitive interface tempered in the best testing rooms and JCross is what you get. My God, can this app be more awesome? Just download it already while it’s still free!
Please visit our web site to find detailed instructions on solving Nonograms: http://popapp.org/Apps/Details?id=3#tutorial
To view leaderboards, you need log in Game Center. To do this go to the settings of your device. To automatically save solved puzzles to the cloud and share them across your devices you need an iCloud account and enabled iCloud Drive option in your iCloud settings

listings.name: JCross Nonogram
listings.description:
More than 100,000 nonograms, from quick 10×10 puzzles to giant 100×100 ones. Play at your own pace, with no timers and no limits: every puzzle is a hidden picture you reveal cell by cell.

Nonograms (also known as Picross, Griddlers, Hanjie, Japanese crosswords or Paint by Numbers) are logic puzzles where a picture is hidden instead of words. Every puzzle in JCross has exactly one solution, and you can reach it with pure logic, no guessing.

HOW TO PLAY
The numbers on the left and at the top give the lengths of the blocks of filled cells in each row and column. Blocks are separated by at least one empty cell and appear in the same order as the numbers. Fill the cells you are sure about, mark the ones that must stay empty with a cross, and the picture will appear step by step.

FEATURES
• More than 100,000 black-and-white nonograms grouped by size: from a two-minute warm-up to large canvases for several evenings.
• Hints: stuck? The game shows your mistakes or the next cells that follow by logic.
• Pinch to zoom and pan, so even 100×100 puzzles are comfortable to solve.
• Undo (up to 100 moves).
• Automatic crosses and clue marks: less routine, more logic.
• More than 20 color themes, light and dark.
• Portrait and landscape, iPhone and iPad.
• Share a solved puzzle as a picture, a link or a QR code.
• Game Center leaderboards and achievements.
• Your progress is saved to the cloud and synced across your devices.

Detailed instructions and solving techniques: https://popapp.org/Apps/Details/3#tutorial

Sign in to Game Center in your device settings for leaderboards and achievements. To save your progress to the cloud and sync it across devices, sign in to Game Center and turn on iCloud Drive.

bluejetty:00174991:ios.description:
Run your business better with Houzz Pro. The all-in-one AI platform for builders, remodelers and designers. It’s the only software and app with AI trained on our industry, so every part of your business becomes faster, more efficient and more profitable.
Trusted by over 3 million home professionals, Houzz Pro brings together client experience, marketing, planning, project management and financial workflows in a single system. With AI embedded throughout, you can automate routine work and spend more time delivering exceptional projects and growing your business, whether you're on the jobsite or in the showroom.
PLANNING – DESIGN & VISUALIZATION TOOLS
- 3D Floor Plans: Generate immersive, client-winning 3D models with Houzz AI. No outsourcing, no specialized software, and no more waiting on costly third-party renders.
- Photo Realistic Renders: Showcase your designs in a new light by generating photorealistic stills from any angle.
- Automated Takeoffs: AI scans plans to measure spaces and count key components automatically, speeding bid prep and accuracy.
- One-Click Sourcing: Houzz Pro's AI-powered Clipper is your sourcing superpower. Capture all product info—images, specs, and install guides—with a single click or URL copy-and-paste.
FINANCIAL SUITE – ESTIMATES, INVOICES & PAYMENTS
- Branded and AI-Powered Estimates & Proposals: Create detailed estimates and proposals instantly from voice or typed prompts; includes labor, materials, and pricing based on local data.
- Invoices & Payment Requests: Send invoices instantly and collect payments online.
PROJECT & CLIENT MANAGEMENT
- AI-Powered Scheduling: Turn any estimate into a project schedule in seconds with fully framed phases and task lists. Track jobs, tasks, schedules, and timelines in one place.
- AI Notetaking: Record calls and in-person meetings and Houzz AI will transcribe, summarize, and suggest next steps for you—no extra hardware or subscription required.
- Client Management (CRM): Manage leads, clients, and follow-ups with reminders and replies.
- Client Messaging: Communicate quickly, keep conversations organized, and stay responsive on the go.
- Documents: Create, store, and share professional project documents anytime, anywhere.
SCHEDULING & WORKFLOWS
- Task Schedules & Gantt Charts: Plan every phase with clarity and control. Use our built-in AI to create detailed project Schedules in almost half the time.
- Assign To-Dos: Keep projects moving by delegating action items to your team, subs, and clients.
TOOLS TAILORED TO YOUR TRADE — Houzz Pro is perfect for: Custom & Commercial Builders, Remodelers, Interior Designers, Contractors, Design-Build Firms and Specialty 
Contractors.
New to Houzz Pro? Download this app to start your free 30-day trial. Already a member? Take your workflow to-go with one download. For the full Houzz Pro experience, log in on desktop or laptop to access advanced AI-driven tools for your team and clients.

bluejetty:00022641:ios.description:
Never wonder who's calling again. Call ID identifies every incoming call and blocks unwanted numbers before they disturb your day.
With a database of 14,000+ known spam numbers stored directly on your iPhone, Call ID works instantly - no internet connection required to block unwanted calls.
LIVE CALLER ID
- Instantly identify who's calling, even unknown numbers.
- See if a number is spam, scam, telemarketer or robocall.
- View business information instead of just a location.
- Live Caller ID and "Who Reported Me" features built in.
- Works directly in your native iPhone phone app.
BLOCK UNWANTED CALLS
- Block robocalls, auto-dialers, telemarketers and scam callers.
- 14,000+ spam numbers stored locally on your iPhone.
- Add any number to your personal blacklist instantly.
- Block SMS and unwanted messages automatically.
- Choose how to handle each blocked call: ignore, reject or send to voicemail.

- Search any number to see if it has been reported as spam.
- View call details and community reports on suspicious numbers.
- Identify unknown callers before you call them back.
- Business caller ID lookup with full business details.
SPAM PROTECTION
- Automatic protection against the latest spam campaigns.
- User-reported spam alerts keep the database current.
- Real-time call screening powered by a constantly updated database.
- Protect yourself from phone scams, fraud and phishing calls.
Simply enjoy your life without unwanted interruptions. Install Call ID, enable it in iPhone Settings, and never be surprised by a spam call again.

bluejetty:00177909:ios.description:
If you are a fan of racing games and car games, then Rush Hour is the ultimate mobile game for you. With its exhilarating gameplay and thrilling features, it is guaranteed to keep you entertained for hours on end!
Drive extreme!
One of the main highlights of Rush Hour is its extreme driving experience in heavy car traffic. Prepare to push yourself beyond your limits by overtaking other cars on the highway at the last moment. The game features a realistic rush-hour racing simulation that lets you experience the adrenaline rush of high-speed driving like never before.
Get away from the police chase!
In Rush Hour, you will also have the opportunity to engage in intense police chases. Become a race master as you outsmart the law enforcement and evade capture. The excitement of police pursuit adds an extra layer of thrill to the game, making each race an unforgettable experience.
Ride on different highways!
With a wide range of city locations to explore, Rush Hour offers endless possibilities for real racing enthusiasts. From busy downtown streets to scenic countryside roads, each location presents unique challenges and opportunities. Immerse yourself in the exciting environments and feel the rush of street racing in different settings.
Gather a car park!
Furthermore, Rush Hour boasts an impressive collection of cars for you to choose from. Whether you prefer sleek sports cars or powerful muscle cars, there is a vehicle to suit every racer's preference. Upgrade and customize your car to enhance its performance and make it stand out from the competition.
In conclusion, Rush Hour is a must-play mobile car game for anyone seeking an adrenaline-pumping racing experience. With its extreme driving, police chase in rush hour, realistic racing in city ways, multitude of locations, and vast selection of cars, it offers everything a true racer desires. So, buckle up and get ready to unleash your inner rebel racer in this action-packed racing game.

bluejetty:00014945:ios.description:
The Players Academy
Train with the best players in the world — anytime, anywhere.
Join the team and learn directly from elite lacrosse pros like Grant Ament, Rob Pannell, Tom Schreiber, TD Ierlan, Blaze Riorden, JT Giles-Harris, Mac O'Keefe, Ally Mastroianni, and Dempsey Arsenault. Whether you're a youth player, a high school standout, or chasing a college offer, The Players Academy App brings world-class training to you.
WHAT YOU GET
2 New Training Videos Every Week
Each week, The Players Academy releases two new on-field training videos, led by different pros. These drills are designed to improve your skills, footwork, shooting, decision-making, and overall lacrosse IQ.
Lacrosse-Specific Strength Training
Train like Rob Pannell with a 4-week strength program crafted by Xelleration Sports Training — one of the top lacrosse performance groups in the country. Choose from bodyweight or weight room formats to match your setup.
Personal Feedback from the Pros
Upload your own game or training clips and receive custom coaching from Players Academy pros. Whether it’s Rob, Grant, Blaze, Mac, Tom, JT, Ally, or Dempsey, they’ll review your video and provide detailed feedback.
Unlock Rewards as You Train
Earn points by watching videos, training consistently, and submitting film. Redeem those points for exclusive Warrior and New Balance rewards in the app.
BUILT FOR PLAYER DEVELOPMENT
With structured weekly content, strength programming, and personalized coaching, The Players Academy is your year-round training partner—on and off the field.
Subscription Options:
Silver Membership – $49.99/month
Full content access + 4 video reviews/month
Bronze Membership – $29.99/month
Full content access + 1 video review/month

Payment will be charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation. Subscriptions auto-renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the billing period. You can manage your subscription anytime in Account Settings. Renewal charges will occur within 24 hours prior to each new billing cycle.
For more information, see our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy: https://theplayers.academy/terms-of-service/

bluejetty:00160294:ios.summary:

A Vast, Living Open World
Exp
bluejetty:00160294:ios.description:
The world has become a wasteland due to a sudden zombie virus outbreak.
You will start as a fragile survivor in this world, overcoming various threats around you and uncovering the secret of the zombie virus.
A Vast, Living Open World
Explore every corner of the seamless open world offered by DARKEST DAYS.
The apocalyptic world, realistically rendered, delivers an immersive experience.
Your journey begins in the desolate town of Sand Creek, where death fills the air.
From desert villages to snow-covered islands and charming resort cities, explore the diverse themed open world, uncover the origins of the zombie virus, and write your own story.
A Variety of Vehicles for Survival in the Open World
Explore the vast open world of DARKEST DAYS using a range of vehicles.
From everyday family cars once used before the apocalypse to powerful trucks and specialized vehicles like police cars and ambulances, you can utilize modes of transportation to navigate the wasteland.
Vehicles can also be used to plow through hordes of zombies. Collect different vehicles and upgrade them with apocalypse-ready modifications to enhance their survival potential.
Surviving the Endless Zombie Threat
In DARKEST DAYS, a post-apocalyptic world ravaged by a massive zombie outbreak, you'll face terrifying undead creatures that constantly threaten your survival.
These zombies exhibit aggressive behavior and unpredictable movement, sometimes using different attack patterns to hunt you down.
To survive, you must use every means available. Take them out one by one with precise shooting or unleash devastating firepower with explosives to wipe out entire hordes.
Build Your Own Sanctuary With Residents
In a world full of dangers, you can construct your own shelter to survive.
Recruit various survivors who have endured the apocalypse to form a community with you.
Build facilities for survival with their help to create a safer haven.
Recruited residents can enhance your shelter's production efficiency or become reliable companions in combat and exploration.
Diverse and Immersive Multiplayer Experiences
Beyond the tense single-player mode, DARKEST DAYS offers dense and engaging multiplayer modes.
Team up with other players to survive endless waves of zombies, or take on terrifying giant mutant zombies to earn rewards.
However, cooperation isn’t the only path to survival. Venture into competitive combat zones to compete against others for rare resources while experiencing thrilling battles.
When it comes to survival, there is no single right answer.

bluejetty:00023930:ios.summary: مدام عفاف من ألعاب الألغاز والذكاء العربية ثنائية الأبعاد المُميّزة التي عادةً ما تتحول إلى إدمان مُنقطع النّظير للاعبيها نظرًا لكم المراحل الكبير الذي يقتل أي ملل، ناهيك عن العديد من الشخصيات المرحة والمسليّة التي لكل منها طابعه الخاص وشخص
bluejetty:00023930:ios.description:
مدام عفاف من ألعاب الألغاز والذكاء العربية ثنائية الأبعاد المُميّزة التي عادةً ما تتحول إلى إدمان مُنقطع النّظير للاعبيها نظرًا لكم المراحل الكبير الذي يقتل أي ملل، ناهيك عن العديد من الشخصيات المرحة والمسليّة التي لكل منها طابعه الخاص وشخصيّته بما يتناسب مع مُختلف الأعمار، والأذواق، والشخصيات
ميزات لعبة مادام عفاف: 
-
 نظام اللعب الكلاسيكي ونظام لعب النّجوم 
- إمكانيّة تخطّي المستوى الحالي حال صعوبته 
- مئات الألغاز والأحاجي لتدريب عقلك وزيادة معدلات ذكاءك 
- تلميحات في المراحل والمغامرات الصّعبة للتسهيل على اللاعب 
- تنتهج اللّعبة منهج "السّهل المُمتنع" حيث تدمج بين الألغاز الصّعبة وسهولة اللعب 
- في كل مرحلة ومغامرة تمارين جديدة للعقل غاية في المتعة 
- تتوفّر اللعبة على الأجهزة المحمولة واللوحية 
- اللعبة مجانيّة بالكامل، فلا حدود للمرح من أي مكان وفي أي وقت 
طريقة اللعب: 
تم وضع شخصيات لعبة مدام عفاف للألغاز والأحاجي في عدّة أماكن وغرف مُختلفة داخل بيئة اللعبة بحيث لا يُمكن نقل أي منها إلى مكان أخر. باستخدام مهاراتك الذهنيّة الفذّة سيتوجب عليك تحريك القطع وتجاوز أي حواجز أو مكعبات قد تعرقل مسيرك نحو النّهاية حتى تتمكّن من تكوين مسار يسمح لك بتحريك الكرة وجمع كل أوراق العمل الخاصة بك وصولًا إلى مدام عفاف.
ستعمل هذه اللعبة على تدريب الذاكرة البصرية والذكاء والسرعة الذهنية وتساعدك على حل الألغاز بسهولة أكبر. دع عقلك يتعلم ويطور مهارات حل المشكلات مع هذه اللعبة. حمل وابدأ في حل الألغاز الآن !!
تستهدف اللّعبة تدريب عدّة محاور مهمّة ألا وهي الذّاكرة البصريّة، والذّكاء المنطقي، وسرعة البديهة، وتحسين قدرتك بشكل عام في حل الألغاز والبازل. ستكتسب العديد من مهارات حل المشكلات مع لعبة مدام عفاف. حمّل اللعبة الآن في أسرع وقت وابدأ المغامرة!!
تقيمك يساعدنا على تطوير اللعبة على الدّوام، فمن فضلك قيّمنا في أقرب فرصة مُمكنة حتى نتمكن من تطوير اللعبة أكثر فأكثر بما يتناسب مع ذوقك الرفيع.

bluejetty:00031916:ios.description:
CrossCountry is the No.1 app for event riders.
Thousands of equestrians, from novices to Olympians, use CrossCountry app to visualise and plan their course and ride to time. Leave the start box with confidence and perform better when you prepare with CrossCountry app.
EXPLORE CROSS COUNTRY COURSES
- View over 18,000 quality course maps from around the world
- See photos and videos of jumps
- Get interactive course maps for events you're competing in
- Look up past courses and be more prepared
RECORD YOUR OWN COURSE MAPS
- Map & measure your course walk with GPS
- Add in jumps with photos, videos, text, striding and voice comments
- Automatically calculate minute markers
- Use for cross country, steeplechase, TREC and in training
- Review before you ride
RIDE TO TIME
- See minute markers and jump times
- Count up and count down minute markers
- Learn to ride at a smooth, safe pace
- Practice at home
OFFLINE MAPS
- Download maps to use offline anywhere
- Record courses with no internet or mobile (cell) phone connection
- Edit downloaded maps and add your own photos and comments
LEARN FROM THE BEST
- Download virtual guided course walks with expert commentary
- Get unique insights on different cross country courses
SHARE AND PUBLISH COURSES
- Share your course privately or to social media
- Publish on CrossCountry app
EASY TO USE
- Excellent design makes this app a pleasure to use
COURSE DESIGN
- Do more with your courses in the CrossCountry Toolkit
- In CrossCountry Toolkit you can design courses, print maps and edit the track. Find out more at www.crosscountryapp.com/toolkit (Yearly Subscription Required)
Terms of Use
https://www.crosscountryapp.com/files/Equimaps%20Terms%20and%20Conditions%20of%20use%2025%20November%202020.pdf

bluejetty:00077887:ios.name: Offroad Simulator Car Driving
bluejetty:00077887:ios.summary:
Welcome to Offroad Simulator Car Driving!
Prepare yourself for the ultimate offroad experience where you'll tackle extreme terrains, face unexpected challenges, and take on exciting open-world missions. In Offroad Simulator Car Driving, you
bluejetty:00077887:ios.description:
Welcome to Offroad Simulator Car Driving!
Prepare yourself for the ultimate offroad experience where you'll tackle extreme terrains, face unexpected challenges, and take on exciting open-world missions. In Offroad Simulator Car Driving, you don’t just drive; you become a part of an action-packed adventure that keeps evolving. Your jeep is your lifeline as you navigate through rugged paths, dangerous bridges, and unpredictable environments, all while completing daring rescue missions.
Your journey kicks off when your jeep's tire breaks down while crossing a dangerous bridge. But don’t worry, help is on the way! When the situation gets too tough, a helicopter swoops in to lift your jeep and safely drops it at your garage. But your story doesn’t end there. You’re now tasked with repairing your vehicle and preparing it for more high-stakes missions that lie ahead. These aren’t just ordinary driving tasks — each mission is set in an open-world environment where you’ll need to use your navigation and problem-solving skills to succeed.
As you explore the vast offroad world, you’ll encounter various missions — from rescuing stranded vehicles to collecting crucial supplies across difficult terrains. The world is full of hidden challenges, and every decision you make will determine your success. The dynamic open-world gameplay offers endless opportunities to explore, and the more you play, the more new environments and tasks unlock.
But driving through rugged paths isn’t the only challenge. Your jeep needs constant attention. After each mission, visit the garage for repairs and upgrades. Enhance your jeep with new tires, stronger engines, and specialized parts to improve its performance and get ready for even tougher challenges ahead.
The game’s immersive driving mechanics, realistic physics, and open-world structure make Garage Rush: Offroad Track a thrilling, never-ending adventure. From navigating treacherous ravines to taking on rescue operations, every level offers something new. Only the best drivers will complete every mission and master the open-world terrain.

bluejetty:00021955:ios.summary:
ABC Animal Games for Kids: Learn with Educational Flashcards, Interactive Puzzles, and Fun Animal Sounds! Build Vocabulary & Skills with Your Child's First Animal Encyclopedia.
Toddlers and kids will love learning about animals with ABC A
bluejetty:00021955:ios.description:
ABC Animal Games for Kids: Learn with Educational Flashcards, Interactive Puzzles, and Fun Animal Sounds! Build Vocabulary & Skills with Your Child's First Animal Encyclopedia.
Toddlers and kids will love learning about animals with ABC Animal Games for Kids! Watch your child's vocabulary grow, their curiosity bloom, and their love for animals flourish with this engaging, educational app. Packed with colorful flashcards, animal puzzles, matching games, and other fun activities, this top animal learning game transforms learning into a playful adventure. Designed for babies, toddlers, and preschoolers, our interactive games and learning activities create the perfect foundation for early childhood development.
DISCOVER AMAZING ANIMALS •
# [PET ANIMALS] - Babies and toddlers will love exploring colorful pictures and hearing fun animal sounds of cats, dogs, and other furry friends with adorable baby animal games.
# [FARM ANIMALS] - Explore the world of farm animals with exciting farm games for kids, realistic animal noises, and interactive activities.
# [FOREST ANIMALS/WILD ANIMALS] - Venture into the forest and meet majestic bears, sly foxes, and wise owls in engaging animal games for preschoolers and toddlers.
# [SEA ANIMALS] - Dive deep into the ocean to learn about playful dolphins, colorful fish, and giant whales with exciting animal puzzles and interactive sea animal games.
# [BIRDS] - Soar through the skies with eagles, parrots, and other fascinating feathered creatures in fun animal games designed for girls and boys.
# [INSECTS/BUGS] - Get up close (but not too close!) with busy bees, beautiful butterflies, and other tiny wonders in these interactive bug games for kids.
PLAY & LEARN WITH FUN EDUCATIONAL GAMES •
# Flashcards with Animal Sounds: Help toddlers learn animal sounds and associate them with pictures.
# Matching Games for Hand-Eye Coordination: Toddlers can practice matching skills and develop fine motor skills with engaging matching games for kids, matching animals to their shadows or homes.
# Animal Puzzle Games for Problem-Solving: Piece together adorable animal puzzles, enhancing fine motor skills and problem-solving abilities with these fun puzzle games for toddlers.
# Balloon Pop: Tap on balloons to reveal animal pictures and hear their sounds, promoting hand-eye coordination and attention in this exciting toddler animal game.
# Memory Match: Flip cards to find matching pairs of animals, boosting memory and concentration in this classic memory game for kids.
# Quiz Games to Test Knowledge: Preschoolers can expand their vocabulary, learn animal names and sounds, and test their knowledge with quizzes designed for their age group.
# Spelling Games for Early Literacy: Spell out the names of animals, helping children develop early literacy skills with these engaging spelling games for kids.
WHY CHOOSE ABC ANIMAL GAMES FOR KIDS?
- Designed for Toddlers: Easy-to-use interface and age-appropriate content.
- Educational & Entertaining: Combines learning with fun to keep toddlers engaged.
- Offline Play: Enjoy learning anywhere, anytime, even without an internet connection.
- Safe & Ad-Free: A worry-free environment for your child's screen time.
- Trusted by Parents: A top choice for early childhood education.
Subscription options are available, including a complimentary 7-day trial to experience our full learning experience. Cancel anytime through your iTunes settings. For support or inquiries, contact us at iosdev.sumon@gmail.com.

bluejetty:00100141:ios.summary: Get ready to embark on an exciting color adventure like never before in Candy Sort: Cat Color Puzzle! This sort puzzle game is designed to calm your mind and sharpen your logic. It’s the perfect casual escape, completely free to play and av
bluejetty:00100141:ios.description:
Get ready to embark on an exciting color adventure like never before in Candy Sort: Cat Color Puzzle! This sort puzzle game is designed to calm your mind and sharpen your logic. It’s the perfect casual escape, completely free to play and available offline, so you can unwind wherever you are. Prepare to conquer a world of colorful challenges!
FEATURES:
- Challenging Sorting Gameplay: Dive into a world of vibrant color candy blocks and engage in addictive sorting puzzles. Pick up the color cubes, send them onto the conveyor, and fill the slots smartly.
- Unique Conveyor Belt Mechanic: Master the flow! You must plan to sort the color candy blocks perfectly with limited slots.
- Exciting Power-Ups and Boosters: Instantly remove any chosen crate to free up the space with fill booster. You can also shift extra cubes to a temporary holding zone, then strategically send them back at the perfect moment with a storage box. These useful tools can help you overcome obstacles in a flash.
- Engaging Levels & Visuals: Explore hundreds of captivating levels, each with its own unique puzzle to solve. The satisfying cube sort, magic, and relaxing, colorful environments will keep you hooked.
- Free & Easy to Play: It’s completely FREE to download, and the simple tap-to-play controls are easy. It’s the perfect happy candy sort for everyone.
HOW TO PLAY:
- Tap to pick up a color candy cube and send it onto the moving sorting conveyor.
- Watch as the blocks automatically travel to their matching crates. Your goal is a perfect sorting cube operation!
- Clear the space by filling up the crates based on color and shape. A full crate is a victory!
- The conveyor has limited slots! This is the core strategic challenge. You must plan your moves carefully to avoid gridlock. Plan your match, colored squares, and other shape moves wisely.
WHY PLAY CANDY SORT?
- Brain Training: Sorting sharpens observation, solving puzzles boosts logic and intelligence which boosts your strategic thinking. 
- Stress Relief: Relax completely with this timer-free color cube puzzle. Enjoy the calm, satisfying flow of sorting without any pressure. 
- All-Age Fun: Simple tap controls are easy for everyone to play; kids and adults alike will love the simple joy of a successful candy sort.
Download Candy Sort: Cat Color Puzzle for FREE today and start your joyful sorting adventure!

bluejetty:00128581:ios.description:
Boost your brainpower and soothe your soul with Word Shop, the ultimate word puzzle experience for spelling and word game enthusiasts! Dive into a beautifully crafted world where connecting letters isn't just a mental workout—it's a peaceful retreat.
INNOVATIVE WORDPLAY MODES
Experience your favorite word mechanics alongside entirely new, exclusive features that challenge and sharpen your mind:
Exclusive "Magical Word" Challenge: Look closely at the letter wheel—one special letter is glowing with gold! To pass these unique levels, every single answer you find must include this golden Magical Word letter. It’s a brilliant twist that adds strategy and a deeper level of brain training.
Seamless "Word Link" Layout: Say goodbye to the messy overlaps of traditional crossword grids. Word Shop features a clean, non-crossing answer board. Connect letters with absolute clarity and enjoy the pure satisfaction of a clutter-free puzzle.
Hidden Word Finder: Think outside the box! Challenge yourself to swipe letters and discover extra hidden words to claim bonus rewards.
REWIND & UNWIND WITH COZY SHOPS
As you master the word puzzles, embark on a comforting journey to unlock and restore a variety of charming, boutique shops. Each location features stunning, hand-crafted, healing art designed to help you relax:
The Coffee Shop: Brew cozy vibes with the aroma of fresh coffee, decadent desserts, and warm cookies.
The Florist: Arrange vibrant flowers, lush greenery, and elegant floral escapes.
The Bookstore: Discover a sanctuary of knowledge with shelves piled high with books on every subject.
And so many more hidden shops waiting for you to explore as you progress!
BEYOND THE WORD WHEEL
Want to sharpen your language skills even further? Take a break from the main journey and test your wit with our specialized daily mini-games:
Grammar Quiz: Polish your sentence structures and master syntax.
Spelling Quiz: Perfect your vocabulary and ensure your spelling is flawless.
WHY YOU WILL LOVE WORD SHOP:
Simple & Intuitive: Just swipe to connect letters and link words. Easy to learn, delightful to master!
Magical Word Mode: Flex your brain cells with our unique golden-letter mechanic.
Clean Word Link Grid: A refreshingly modern, non-crossing puzzle presentation.
Cozy Collection Activities: Participate in the Daily Puzzle, Treasure Hunt, Undersea Party, and more!
Exquisite Visual Design: Relaxing, healing shop-themed backgrounds that turn every level into visual therapy.
Real-Time Leaderboards: Share the joy and compete friendly with friends and players worldwide.
Play Anywhere, Anytime: Fully supported offline play. No Wi-Fi or internet connection required!
Are you ready to escape into a world of words, warmth, and beautiful shops?
Download Word Shop now and start your relaxing brain-training adventure today!
Terms of Service: http://www.histudiogames.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: http://www.histudiogames.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00187985:ios.summary:

Bill Watch keeps your income and expense bills in one place, reminds you payi
bluejetty:00187985:ios.description:
You need an app to organize your bills, keep them in good order, track their payment status and make sure they are paid on time.
Bill Watch is the best choice.
Bill Watch keeps your income and expense bills in one place, reminds you paying bills, its mission is to help you become late fee free and you don’t need to always worry about that if you have bills to be paid nearly, helps to simplify and stress release your life.
You add your bills which need to be paid or got into this app, Bill Watch will keep your bills by Calendar or List view, remind you paying them on time, and generate reports to show where you money comes and goes.
Key Features:
⁃ Track both income and expense bills.
⁃ Track bills amount, status, payment amount, account, category and payer/payee etc.
⁃ Create repeating bills with or without an end date.
⁃ Custom in advance remind days and time.
⁃ Set bills as auto pay or not.
⁃ Add full or partially payments for a bill.
⁃ Calendar or List view to check bills.
⁃ Track bills history for each account.
⁃ Search bills with or without a date range.
⁃ Bills reports including bills trend, bills by category, bills by payee/payer and bills by payment amount.
⁃ Export bills data by email in format of CSV, HTML or PDF.
⁃ Print bills data by AirPrint.
⁃ Supports multiple currencies.
⁃ Passcode protection.
⁃ Supports Touch ID as password.
⁃ Custom Categories.
⁃ Custom month start day.
⁃ Dropbox and iCloud backup and restore.
⁃ Adds 3D Touch function.
⁃ Supports Apple Watch.
⁃ Supports universal version (available on both iPhone and iPad). 
If you have any question, please email to linklinksapp@tom.com.

Welcome to the world of Top Fuel Hotrod: Drag Boat Racing! 
It's the newest, most realistic Speed Drag Boat Racing Game ever made- all available on your iPhone device. Customize every aspect of your builds down to the piston... with a detailed engine simulation to boot!
Build your engine the way you want to! TOP FUEL HOTROD features 100's of different part types resulting in unlimited combinations of ways to make your boat faster!
Drive your boat the way you want to! Weather, wind direction, and chop will affect how straight your hull flies. 
Race against opponents across the USA in over 20+ unique locations! Compete for prizes and trophies to claim the title of "World Champion"
TOP FUEL HOTROD will feature over 16 different boat types spanning over 4 different racing classes (River racer, Eliminator, Pro Modified, Top Fuel Hydro)
Play with your friends online in the all NEW multiplayer mode! 
Engine Customization feature:
- Pick every part in your engine to boost your performance
- Be careful, the more parts in your system, the more likely it is to break
- Test your build using the DYNO, which will give you your power band and HP ratio
- Share your builds with friends! Part of the fun is discovering the best loadouts for your races
Note: If you choose to join as a Gold or Platinum Top Fuel Hotrod member, you are agreeing to an auto-renewing subscription plan that will automatically be charged every month through your account.
