bluejetty:00015030:ios.summary:
Developed by Harvard Law School alumni, BarMax is the top-rated bar exam review course in the App Store, with the highest overall pass rates. 
BarMax is free to download, giving you access to our MPRE course featuring audio lectures, black
bluejetty:00015030:ios.description:
Developed by Harvard Law School alumni, BarMax is the top-rated bar exam review course in the App Store, with the highest overall pass rates. 
BarMax is free to download, giving you access to our MPRE course featuring audio lectures, black-letter law outlines, flashcards and real MPRE questions from previous exams. 
The first section of Civil Procedure (i.e. “Subject Matter Jurisdiction”) is also free, regardless of your course. This section includes an audio lecture by the legendary Arthur Miller, flashcards, and real MBE questions from previous bar exams. 
Unlike many of our competitors, BarMax proudly shares our bar exam pass rates:
First-Time ABA-Accredited:
79% for CA (average is 68%)
82% for NY (average is 70%)
Overall:
53% for CA (average is 46%)
75% for NY (average is 61%)
UNPARALLELED PREP AT AN UNBEATABLE PRICE
You’ll get immediate, and instance access to our comprehensive California or UBE course for just $2495. Supplements, like our bank of 1750+ real MBE questions, start at just $399.99. BarMax offers the most competitive packages for bar exam review, allowing all students to gain immediate access to high-quality bar exam review without the need for bar loans. 
NOW AVAILABLE ONLINE
BarMax is now also available online, so you can access all of your materials from your computer in addition to in-app. 
STUDY REAL MBE QUESTIONS AND PERFORMANCE TESTS
Build test-taking confidence by studying with over 1,750 real MBE questions, plus real essays and real performance tests licensed directly from the NCBE (not made-up questions, like those used in other bar review courses). 
STUDY ANYTIME, ANYWHERE
With on-demand audio lectures by notable Harvard Law School-educated professors, BarMax helps you learn on-the-go (no Internet required) and at your pace, so you can ditch the classroom, and make bar prep fit your schedule.
DETAILED ANALYTICS
Analytics that automatically track your progress and show you where to spend precious time.
PERSONALIZED WRITING REVISIONS
Line by line, our former bar exam graders will critique your essays and performance tests so you know exactly where you stand, and where to focus your study time.
*** 
Barbri’s co-founder and former President recommends BarMax.
“After leaving Barbri after 20 years, I thought I would start another bar review course. And then I discovered BarMax . . . The materials are first class. The lecturers are first class. The content is geared to the bar examination . . . I highly recommend BarMax." -Stan Chess
“I took the Cal Bar four times before I passed. I served as a representative for a widely popular study course. I studied for the Cal Bar using this well-known course without success. I was turned onto BarMax through a friend who used the same program and failed the Cal Bar three times. After using BarMax for the first time, my friend passed, as did I. I couldn’t recommend BarMax any higher. It’s affordable, convenient, and effective. I wouldn’t be a lawyer today without BarMax.” 
- Shannon Ripple, Humphreys College of Law
“The cost savings are great, but in my opinion, the real advantage is that the BarMax course itself is simply better than the competition.” 
- Susan Brown, University of Toronto

From the makers of Quran.com comes Quran for iOS, a beautiful, and ad-free mushaf app. 
It’s now easier to read the Quran on the go, memorize it and listen to your favorite reciters.
This is just the beginning for Quran for iOS. We’ll be updating the app regularly insha'Allah and would love to hear your feedback and feature requests. You can reach us at ios@quran.com
As the Hadeeth (prophetic statement) in At-Tirmithi states: “Whoever reads a letter from the Book of Allah, he will have a reward, and this reward will be multiplied by ten. I am not saying that 'Alif, Laam, Meem' (a combination of letters frequently mentioned in the Holy Quran) is a letter, rather I am saying that ‘Alif’ is a letter, ‘Laam’ is a letter and ‘Meem’ is a letter.” [At-Tirmithi] We hope this app will help you increase your recitation of the Quran and increase your blessings in this world and the hereafter. 
من صناع Quran.com يأتي تطبيق القرآن للأجهزة المحمولة، تطبيق للمصحف ذو صفحات جميلة خالي تماما من الاعلانات.
لقد أصبح من السهل قراءة القرآن بالشارع، وحفظه، والاستماع إلى قارئك المفضل.
هذا هو مجرد بداية لتطبيق القرآن. سنعمل على تحديث التطبيق بشكل منتظم إن شاء الله، ونحب أن نسمع رأيك ومتطلبتك. يمكنك الوصول إلينا عن طريق البريد الإلكتروني ios@quran.com

bluejetty:00073798:ios.description:
Free the internet from data collection with Mullvad VPN – a service that helps keep your online activity, identity, and location private. Only €5/month. 
GET STARTED
1. Install the app.
2. Create an account.
3. Add time to your account via in-app purchases, vouchers or on our website.
To make sure to block third-party cookies and other tracking technologies – use Mullvad VPN together with Mullvad Browser (free of charge).
ANONYMOUS ACCOUNTS – NO ACTIVITY LOGS
* Creating an account requires no personal info - not even an email address.
* We keep no activity logs.
* We offer the possibility to pay anonymously with cash or cryptocurrency.
* Our app uses WireGuard, a superior VPN protocol that connects fast and doesn’t drain your battery.
HOW DOES MULLVAD VPN WORK?
With Mullvad VPN, your traffic travels through an encrypted tunnel to one of our VPN servers and then onward to the website you are visiting. In this way, websites will only see our server’s identity instead of yours. Same goes for your ISP (internet service provider); they’ll see that you’re connected to Mullvad, but not your activity. It also means that all the third-party actors with technology integrated into the various websites you visit can’t sniff out your IP address and use it to track you from one site to another. Using a trustworthy VPN is a great first step to reclaim your privacy online. In combination with Mullvad Browser you make sure to block third-party cookies and other tracking technologies.
FREE THE INTERNET FROM MASS SURVEILLANCE AND DATA COLLECTION

bluejetty:00186588:ios.description:
HelloChinese is the best Mandarin Chinese learning app for beginners!
Featured on the App Store in New Apps We Love and Notable Education Apps!
Designed in a fun and highly effective manner, HelloChinese helps you rapidly learn Mandarin Chinese from scratch to a conversational level. With HelloChinese, learners can "learn the Chinese language, explore Chinese culture" – you will not only learn Mandarin Chinese but also enjoy the process of delving into the culture intertwined with the language.
Features:
◉ Game-based Chinese learning: You will never get bored.
◉ 1000+ graded stories: read engaging stories at your level!
◉ Immersive lessons help you to have real-life, practical conversations quickly.
◉ Over 2,000 videos - all featuring authentic Chinese speakers! 
◉ Innovative self-adaptive learning games that incorporate Chinese cultural education.
◉ Speech recognition corrects your pronunciation and makes speaking Chinese a breeze.
◉ Handwriting specially designed to learn Chinese characters at a faster rate.
◉ Systematic courses based on HSK levels.
◉ A well-designed Pinyin (pronunciation) course for newbies.
◉ Bite-sized curriculum to fortify your Chinese listening, speaking, reading, and writing skills.
◉ Simplified and traditional Chinese(Mandarin) are both supported.
◉ Offline accessibility: Once a course is downloaded, no internet connection is required.
◉ Study progress tracking across multiple devices.
With these tools at your disposal, nothing can stop you from mastering Chinese. Start on your path to fluency today!
HelloChinese Premium offers:
One-month subscription for $11.99
Three-month subscription for $25.99
Twelve-month subscription for $69.99
The above prices are for U.S. customers. Pricing in other countries may vary, and charges may be converted to your local currency depending on your country of residence.
Once purchased, subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off in your iTunes Account settings at least 24 hours before the end of the payment period.
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/HelloChineseApp/
Privacy Policy: https://www.hellochinese.cc/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://www.hellochinese.cc/terms.html

bluejetty:00063072:ios.description:
What is Buy Me a Coffee?
Buy Me a Coffee is a fast and beautiful way to accept support and offer extras to your audience. 
Instead of asking your fans to donate or 'become your patron', you can simply ask them to buy you a coffee. It's friendly, easy, and effective. 
You can sell extras, accept one time donations, offer memberships, send & receive direct messages and build a direct relationship with your fans without stitching together a bunch of apps like Patreon, Mailchimp, and a donate button — Your fans are going to love it! 
Buy Me a Coffee, used by over 300,000 creators, offers a simple, meaningful way to fund your creative work.
What can you do with your Buy Me a Coffee App?
Our app is designed to help creators and supporters at Buy Me a Coffee manage and stay updated on the latest activities on their accounts.
With this app, creators can -
 1. Create and customize your Buy Me a Coffee account.
 2. Sent and receive direct messages from your supporters/members.
 3. Create and share new posts with your supporters.
 4. Reply to any supporter/member comments.
 5. Get real-time notifications for one-time donations, memberships, and 'Extra' purchases.
 6. View all support and membership payment history.
 5. Follow fellow creators you love to interact with them.
Supporter can -
1. Stay on top of the latest updates from the creators you support.
2. Discover new creators to follow and support.
3. Sent and receive direct messages from creators you love.
4. Easily consume content shared by your favorite creators.
Useful links -
Signing up at Buy Me a Coffee - https://www.buymeacoffee.com/signup
Buy Me a Coffee's Discord- https://discord.gg/ChHKujS
Who and what we are -https://www.buymeacoffee.com/about
Guides and help - https://www.buymeacoffee.com/library/
Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/buymeacoffee
Twitter - https://twitter.com/buymeacoffee
We would love to hear your thoughts on our app. Your feedback goes a long way in shaping up Buy Me a Coffee.

bluejetty:00141234:ios.description:
This game is a brand new and amazing puzzle game!
Your target is to eliminate all the marble games, but don't let the chain reach the end. Survive four secret scenes to get the best marble shooting and the mysterious treasure in every adventure! This marble games are easy to play, but truly addictive. 
Complete all the levels in challenge mode, and try to get three stars in each level.
Now, practice your game skills in Marble puzzle adventure!
How to play Zumba’s Revenge:
1. Control and shooting to match three or more marble colored balls.
2. Tap on the transmitter can swapping the current ball and the next ball.
3. Boost your score with power-ups and combos.
Features of Zumba’s Revenge: 
+ Icing Blockers NEW! Fire a ball into the frozen ones to remove the ice. They can be destroyed only after the ice is removed. 
+ Many deluxe booster to discover! Create combos to get amazing power-ups. 
+ Many secret level to make the game more addictive.
+ This marble games is a free, action Marble puzzle game play.
+ Boss levels: will you manage to destroy the chain if the path is invisible?

bluejetty:00096155:ios.description:
Mirror Screen: Cast to TV App - Effortlessly mirror your iPhone's screen to any smart TV in high quality with real-time streaming.
Enjoy music, videos, photos, and other media from your iPhone on the big screen with seamless screen mirroring.
How to Use the App:
Ensure your iPhone and TV are connected to the same Wi-Fi network.
Launch the app and select your TV to establish a connection.
Grant permission for your TV to link with your iPhone.
Tap "Start Mirroring" to begin streaming your screen to the TV.
Key Features:
No TV app installation required - Works directly with compatible smart TVs.
Wireless mirroring - Stream apps, games, and media from your iPhone to the TV over Wi-Fi.
Automatic device detection - Finds cast-enabled devices on your network.
Media casting - Share photos, videos, and music from your iPhone/iPad to the TV.
Web video casting - Send online videos directly to your TV.
No extra hardware - Works without cables or additional devices.
Wide compatibility - Supports Samsung TV, LG TV, Roku, Web Video Caster, and most smart TVs in full resolution.
Note: For successful mirroring, ensure both devices are on the same Wi-Fi network. Disable VPNs and proxies for a stable connection.
Disclaimer: This app is not officially affiliated with or endorsed by the TV brands and apps mentioned above.
Contact us: benjaminweze0934@icloud.com

bluejetty:00114435:ios.description:
The world is insane. You don’t have to be. 
10% with Dan Harris brings together meditation and community in one simple place, so practice feels doable and way less lonely.
The idea behind 10% is simple: the mind is trainable. Qualities like focus, calm, and compassion aren’t fixed traits; they’re skills you can learn.
Most meditation apps are libraries of one-way content. 10% is different. It’s about experience and connection with trusted teachers and a community that has your back.
What’s Inside
• Guided Meditations
A library of guided sessions to help with stress, focus, sleep, relationships, self-compassion, and more. Practices vary in length and style and are always led by experienced teachers who keep things practical and grounded.
• Live Stream Events
Join live meditations and Q&As where you can practice alongside others and ask questions. Replays are always available if you can’t make it live.
• Ad-Free Podcast
Listen to the 10% Happier podcast ad-free for thoughtful, practical conversations about how to do life better — all without interruptions. Each episode includes a concise summary of insights, time-stamped highlights, and transcripts, so you can easily revisit what matters most.
• Community Spaces
Join conversations, share reflections, or just read along. A space to feel supported and part of something real.

bluejetty:00070923:ios.description:
Take care of cute babies, make sure they have a good nap, and be a good babysitter!
PLAY WITH 6 BABIES AND 12 CHARACTERS IN THIS DOLLHOUSE
Welcome to My Town Baby world, and download our Daycare game full of fun! Explore a kindergarten and have fun with 6+ cute babies and 12+ characters: from teachers to family members. You choose with whom you want to play!
EXPLORE ALL FUNNY LOCATIONS
Discover more than 6+ locations: nap room, playroom, dining room, and even a playground with swings and a slide. Be a babysitter and dress up the cute babies in the outfit you like. You can interact with almost every item you see! Put babies for a nap, cover them up with their blankets, take them outside, or get them toys they like and play inside the dollhouse! Babies and kids need a delicious meal several times a day. Prepare different types of food in the kitchen, such as cereals or fresh fruits and give them milk too! Fun is everywhere!
MY TOWN DAYCARE GAME HAS AMAZING FEATURES:
• 6 different rooms to create your stories
• 6 cute babies to take care of
• Meet other characters such as: Babysitter, mom, dad, and kids.
• More than 90 new items to move
• Amazing graphic and appealing sound
• Play as a Babysitter, Teacher or be a cute baby!
• Dress up the babies and kids in outfit you like
• No Competition! Just fun!
• Amazing game to improve kids' creativity and imagination!
CREATE YOUR STORIES
Explore and create stories you like! My Town games are specially made to improve kids' creativity and imagination. Kids can decide what will be the next move in the game. Remember when you were a kid and played with toys in your room? How fun was it when you imagined and created different stories every time? This is the same, just a digital game that will help your kid be more creative and entertained. 
Gift your kid's My Town game and be assured that you provide him a game that is all about education, creativity and kids' own imagination. 
RECOMMENDED AGE GROUP
Kids 4-12: My Town games are safe to play even when parents are out of the room. 
ABOUT MY TOWN
The My Town Games studio designs digital dollhouse-like games that promote creativity and open ended play for your children worldwide. Loved by children and parents alike, My Town games introduce environments and experiences for hours of imaginative play. The company has offices in Israel, Spain, Romania and the Philippines. For more information, please visit www.my-town.com
Terms of Use: https://www.my-town.com/EULA
Customer Support contact: support@my-town.com
Get Privacy-related information at: https://www.my-town.com/privacy-policy/.

bluejetty:00014820:ios.description:
Track your miles automatically completely free with TripLog! Whether you’re a gig worker, freelancer, employee, or a manager of a team or company of any size, TripLog saves you time, helps maximize your tax deductions, and makes employee mileage reimbursement easier.
Unlike other mileage trackers, TripLog gives individual users truly unlimited automatic trip detection at no cost. Once you’re set up, our app runs seamlessly in the background and captures every drive for you. Just drive and let TripLog do the work!
► Start Tracking Automatically For Free
• Free unlimited automatic tracking - TripLog starts tracking when you start driving and stops when you stop
• Smart trip classification - Swipe to classify drives as business or personal, or set up auto-classification hours to automatically classify trips depending on when you drive
• Expense tracking included - Track income, fuel, parking, tolls, and other deductible/reimbursable business expenses
• Annual reporting access - All TripLog users get one free 7-day Premium Pass each year to create and download annual mileage reports
• Perfect for individual tax deductions
► Power Up With Premium
• Unlimited reporting - Create detailed, tax-compliant mileage and expense reports in PDF or CSV formats
• Web dashboard access - Review and manage your mileage, expenses, and reports from your computer
• Enhanced expense tracking - Enjoy OCR receipt capture, bank and credit card feeds, and more
• Additional trip auto-classification options - Set custom work schedules, frequent trip rules, and other automatic classifications
• More ways to stay organized - Create custom activities and mileage rates, plan routes, and more
• Software integrations - Connect TripLog with QuickBooks Online, SAP Concur, and other tools
• Great for individual employee reimbursement
► Enterprise & Business Solutions
Have employees who drive for work? TripLog makes it easy to manage mileage, expenses, time, and reimbursements all in one place.
• Manage all of your employees’ mileage and expenses from one centralized dashboard
• Create custom mileage rates, commute deductions, and reimbursement policies
• Set up approval hierarchies to review and approve employee mileage and expense reports
• Support both cents-per-mile and FAVR reimbursement programs
• Keep employees’ personal trip details private
• Connect with ADP, SAP Concur, UKG, QuickBooks, and more
Whether you’re tracking mileage for tax deductions, submitting miles for reimbursement, or managing an entire team of drivers, TripLog keeps your records accurate and makes mileage tracking a breeze.
Download TripLog today and start tracking automatically for free!

bluejetty:00069663:ios.description:
Habit is a goal tracker and streak tracker for building one daily habit at a time. Choose a small action, record each success in three seconds, and see your progress grow.
Use your daily goal tracker for reading, studying or exercise. Keep track of successful days and habit streaks, with reminder notifications to help you take the next step.
■ No. 1 Habit Building App in Japan
"Habit" is the top-ranked habit-building app in Japan across the following criteria:
① Number of total downloads publicly disclosed
② Number of documented successful habit streaks
③ Average rating on the App Store
④ Number of App Store reviews
■ Key Goals Sustained with This App
1. Strength Training, Fitness, and Health Care
・Strength-training exercises (push-ups, planks, crunches, squats, etc., suitable for both home and gym workouts)
・Stretching and flexibility exercises
・Recording body fat percentage, blood pressure, blood sugar levels, etc.
2. Weight Loss and Beauty Health
・Weight loss exercises (core workouts, pelvic exercises, etc.)
・Beauty (skincare, hair care, etc.)
・Cardiovascular exercises (walking, jogging, running, etc.)
・Recording body weight and meals (also suitable for tracking diets)
・Checking body temperature and overall well-being
・Short-term fasting or intermittent fasting
3. Learning
・Studying for qualifications/ certifications
・Reading books
・Improving work-related skills (e.g. programming)
4. Hobbies and Musical Instruments
・Piano
・Guitar
・Illustration or drawing
・Blogging and posting on social media
・Keeping a diary
5. Household and Lifestyle
・Organizing, decluttering, cleaning, doing laundry
・Abstaining from alcohol and smoking
・Practicing meditation and mindfulness
・Maintaining regular routines such as brushing teeth, taking showers
■ Features and Characteristics
1. Support for Setting "Continuable Goals"
Recognizing the fact that motivation to sustain actions inevitably weakens over time, the app encourages setting goals that can be consistently pursued every day. It prevents the problem of setting unattainable goals driven by initial enthusiasm, thus avoiding the failure of plans. Unlike traditional to-do lists or task management tools, the app only allows you to set one goal at a time.
2. Three Seconds to Record
With a simple (some might say overly simple) design, all you need to do is open the app and tap on the pie chart to complete your input of your record. You'll be greeted by cute stick-figure comments that provide encouragement every day.
3. Reminder Notifications at Best Timing
If your goal is to "read a book," for example, you'll receive reminder notifications at convenient times like during your daily commute. This helps prevent any lapses in taking the necessary actions.
4. Celebrate Success at 30 Days

bluejetty:00119387:ios.description:
MultiTimer – Unlock New Productivity and Time Management Opportunities! **NO ADS**
Whether it’s daily tasks, cooking, studying, or workouts, MultiTimer offers customizable timers for any situation. With options like task timers, kitchen timers, Pomodoro timers, and many other features, you'll always be organized and efficient.
**VERSATILE TIMERS FOR ANY SITUATION
Create multiple timers for any purpose.
Choose from:
- Countdown
- Quick Start
- CountUp
- Pomodoro
- Interval Timer
- Stopwatch
- Counter
- Clock
- Buttons
- Container
**FLEXIBLE LAYOUT FOR YOUR NEEDS
Customize timer boards the way you like.
Choose between adaptive and flexible layouts. Copy, delete, and move timers at your discretion. Create multiple boards to place different timers side by side and manage them effortlessly.
**PERSONALIZE YOUR TIME
Give your timers and counters a personal touch with numerous labels, colours, icons, alert styles, custom sounds, and notifications.
**MAXIMUM CONTROL & CUSTOMIZATION
Full control over your timers.
Set timer start delays, add or subtract time from running timers, and choose the "Auto-repeat" option for automatic timer restart.
**SAVE TIME WITH EASE
Track and save the entire history of your timers and counters.
**SHARE TIMERS
Use the web feature to share a link with friends, family, or colleagues to track ongoing or upcoming events or tasks.
**AND MANY OTHER GREAT FEATURES
- Place timers on separate screens (boards) or manage them in fullscreen mode.
- Sync timer data across devices using iCloud.
- Use all available types of widgets.
- Check out Siri integration, shortcuts, and x-callback-URL support.
- Try 3D Touch for quick timer management through the pop-up menu.
- Use MultiTimer on your Apple Watch.
- Export boards and timers to another device.
- Use the built-in tools to run and manage multiple timers at the same time.
MultiTimer is your indispensable assistant, whether in the kitchen, gym, at work, or in the office. Focus on what really matters with quick timer settings, optimize your time management, and achieve your goals faster and more efficiently.
Download MultiTimer and start managing your time today with unlimited boards, timers, and various features (some features are part of the Pro upgrade).

bluejetty:00039228:ios.description:
Somos is a card game that will help you create deep and sincere conversations with the people you love most. With the somos app, you now have access to more decks with specific conversation topics. You can play with your partner, friends, family, or whomever you want. Different colors make up the deck of cards. Each color is associated with different aspects of our lives. These are our colors:

bluejetty:00016823:ios.summary: Ever wanted to play as a doctor, nurse or patient? Bandage hands, use statoscope, check for fever and even help dad to rush mom in to the baby delivery room! From the makers of My Town comes the largest most kids friendly realistic doll hou
bluejetty:00016823:ios.description:
Ever wanted to play as a doctor, nurse or patient? Bandage hands, use statoscope, check for fever and even help dad to rush mom in to the baby delivery room! From the makers of My Town comes the largest most kids friendly realistic doll house game, My Town : Hospital. It’s a hospital like not other, where kids can interact with real checkup rooms such as MRI and X-ray room, a small emergency room and even a recovery room. My town : Hospital has it all.
- My Town : Hospital is connected to all our latest games so you can move characters to and from the game. 
What is My Town all about ? My Town games are open word pretend play games, very similar to a digital dollhouse where kids can pretend play to be a doctor, a nurse and even a patient. My Town : Hospital offers a huge variety of accessories and locations where kids can pretend play.
FEATURING:
- 9 different rooms such as MRI, Xray, New born, recovery room, babies room and a dr. office where you can treat and examine characters.
- Lots of new characters you can move around between other my town games. You want to have a dr. visit home? Now you can!
- hundreds of new accessories, Gifts and new items added with the latest update. - Extremely long play value for kids - Multi touch 
- kids can play together on the same tablet - Free updates and upgrades If you can imagine it you can play it, everything is possible in our hospital.
RECOMMENDED AGE GROUP
Kids 4-12: My Town games are safe to play even when parents are out of the room. 
TELL US WHAT YOU THINK!
You can easily contact with us on Facebook or Twitter at any time to let us know what you would like changed or added. Maybe you’ve come up with a new My Town game all on your own – let us know! We promise to read all messages and reply. We love to hear YOUR ideas, so please connect with us! 
Facebook – https://www.facebook.com/mytowngames
 Twitter – https://twitter.com/mytowngames
ABOUT MY TOWN
The My Town Games studio designs digital dollhouse-like games that promote creativity and open ended play for your children all over the world. Loved by children and parents alike, My Town games introduce environments and experiences for hours of imaginative play. The company has offices in Israel, Spain, Romania and the Philippines. For more information, please visit www.my-town.com

bluejetty:00121083:ios.description:
A palette of beautiful colors needs your help to get organized. This quick color matching puzzle game is easy to learn and difficult to put down. Ready to get Compulsive?
■ FEATURES
□ Addictive color matching puzzle game
□ Multiple Game Modes: Arcade, Strategy, Zen, Challenge
□ Multiplayer: Play friends on the same board
□ Power-ups: Organizer, Cleaner, Duster
□ Leaderboards & Achievements
□ Beautiful bright candy-like colors with a modern theme
□ Awesome animations, music, and sound 
□ Play games in 60 seconds, 30 moves, or unlimited
□ Game Center integration for challenging friends and family
□ Optimized for all iPhone and iPad Retina Displays
■ RULES
□ Drag tiles anywhere on the board as long as the dropped tile joins another of same color
□ Join four or more tiles of the same color to clear them off the board and score points. 
□ A Clean tile clears all tiles of a specific color off the board. 
□ Clear multiple groups of tiles in a single move for bonus points. 
■ POWER-UPS
□ Power-ups include Duster, Cleaner, Organizer, and Visionary to help improve your game!
□ Duster removes a tile off the board and counts towards the combo. Use it to start your next combo and score bigger points. Limit 5 per game.
□ The Cleaner power-up removes an entire color from the board. This is just like the white cleaner tile that appears on the board. Limit is 3 per game.
□ The Organizer power-up gives you 10 seconds to arrange the board however you want without any tiles exploding. This allows you to create really big groups and and even bigger combos for a massive bonus. Limit is 1 per game.
□ Visionary power-up is a one time purchase that provides color tile counts on the board on every game played. Helps you to focus on what color to use to build your next group. Also tells you the best time to use your Organizer power-up!
■ TIPS
□ Create larger groups of tiles for bigger scores.
□ Set up tiles on the game board so when one group clears others will follow.
□ Bonus multiplier is given on the total number of groups you clean up in a single move.
□ Use the white tiles or Cleaner power-up to wipe up a mess or score some quick points. 
□ Use the Duster tile to start off a killer combo.
□ Buy plenty of Organizers from the Store to really run your score up high.
□ Use the Visionary power-up as an indicator to use the Organizer power-up.
□ Play everyday to earn 1,000 extra tiles.
□ Connect the leaderboard to Game Center and Facebook to crush your friend's scores.
■ REVIEWS
□ “Best New Games" — Apple App Store Feature
□ "So minimal, so addictive" — LA Times
□ "Its design is generous, both in aesthetic elegance and in play" — Kill Screen
□ “Compulsive is a slick puzzler that lives up to its name” — GameZebo
■ CONTACT
□ Problem? In the app please tap MORE, ABOUT, and SEND FEEDBACK to talk directly to our team.
□ Like us at https://www.facebook.com/CompulsiveGame
□ Follow us at https://twitter.com/tmsoft
□ Visit us at https://www.tmsoft.com/compulsive/

bluejetty:00186632:ios.name: Galaxy Map
bluejetty:00186632:ios.summary: The galaxy map is an interactive map of the Milky Way galaxy, Andromeda and their satellite galaxies. Explore the Orion Arm's nebulae and supernovae from the comfort of your spaceship. Fly through the atmosphere of Mars and many other plane
bluejetty:00186632:ios.description:
The galaxy map is an interactive map of the Milky Way galaxy, Andromeda and their satellite galaxies. Explore the Orion Arm's nebulae and supernovae from the comfort of your spaceship. Fly through the atmosphere of Mars and many other planets and you can even land on them.
Discover the galaxy in a stunning three dimensional map based on NASA's artistic impression of the Milky Way galactic structure. Photos are taken by NASA spacecraft and ground based telescopes like Hubble Space Telescope, Chandra X-Ray, Herschel Space Observatory and the Spitzer Space Telescope. 
This interactive 3D map is excellent for teachers to use for instruction, and it is a great astronomy resource for students to explore the Milky Way galaxy and space as they learn more about the universe we live in. Available in over 100 languages!
You can also 
From the outskirts of the galaxy, in the Norma-Outer spiral arm to the galactic center's supermassive black hole Sagittarius A*, discover a galaxy full of amazing facts. Notable structures included: the Pillars of Creation, Helix Nebula, the Engraved Hourglass Nebula, the Pleiades, the Orion Arm (where the solar system and the Earth are located) with its Orion belt.
Check out neighboring dwarf galaxies such as Sagittarius and the Canis Major Overdensity, stellar streams as well as internal galactic components such as a variety of nebulae, star clusters or supernovae.
Explore space and get a little closer to our wonderful universe with this awesome astronomy app! 
The Galaxy Map requires internet access to retrieve information from the wiki.

bluejetty:00187883:ios.description:
Use Conference Tracker to automate the attendance tracking of conferences, seminars, workshops, and training sessions. 
Conference Tracker will convert your Apple device into a portable conference attendance tracking device. The attendance data is transmitted to the Conference Tracker server on the Amazon Cloud. Once there, simply log in to your Conference Tracker account with a web browser to view or print the attendance reports. 
Conference Tracker can calculate the Continuing Education Units (CEU) or Professional Development Credits each attendee earned for attending the conference sessions. You can design your own attendance certificate, print it out or deliver it electronically.
Other features: Ability to design and print conference badges, a communication center, and much more...

bluejetty:00187401:ios.description:
Die NZZ-E-Paper-App ist exklusiv für «NZZ Digital Plus»- und «NZZ Print & Digital»-Abonnenten und -Abonnentinnen. «NZZ Digital»-Lesern empfehlen wir unsere News-App «NZZ Nachrichten». 
Geniessen Sie Ihre abonnierten Formate aus dem Hause NZZ in einer App. Folgende NZZ-Titel sind als E-Paper verfügbar: 
- «Neue Zürcher Zeitung» (Schweizer und internationale Ausgabe) 
- «NZZ am Sonntag» 
- «NZZ Folio» 
- «NZZ Geschichte» 
- Inklusive aller Beilagen der jeweiligen Printausgabe 
Nutzen Sie alle Vorteile der NZZ-E-Paper-App: 
- Alle Titel täglich ab 4.00 Uhr auf all Ihren Geräten verfügbar 
- Die letzten 30 Ausgaben Ihrer abonnierten Titel digital, jederzeit und überall verfügbar 
- Bis zu 50 Ausgaben speichern und auch offline lesen 
Die wichtigsten App-Funktionen auf einen Blick: 
- Seitenübersicht im gewohnten Printlayout 
- Wahlweise Ressortübersicht und kompaktes Textlayout 
- Optimierte Artikelansicht für flexibles Lesen auf allen Geräten 
- Adaptierbare Schriftgrösse für ein komfortables Leseerlebnis 
- Teilen von Artikeln via Weblink oder als ganzseitiges PDF 
- Export von Artikeln als Volltext 
- Stichwort-Suchfunktion innerhalb der gesamten Ausgabe 
Sollten Sie noch Fragen zur NZZ-E-Paper-App haben, kontaktieren Sie uns gerne: 
Direkt aus der Anwendung heraus (Einstellungen oben rechts): 
- FAQ 
- Kontaktformular 
oder über einen der folgenden Kanäle: 
E-Mail: service@nzz.ch 
Telefon: +41 (0)44 258 10 00 
Twitter: @NZZ_Service 
Öffnungszeiten NZZ Service: 
Mo–Fr 7.30–17.00 Uhr 
Sa 7.30–11.30 Uhr 
So 8.30–11.30 Uhr

Step 4: Add actors. Create them yourself or pick ones from our library. 
Step 5: Write dialogues, record voice overs, give your actors emotions and actions, add audio effects.

bluejetty:00024556:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00024556:ios.description:
Simply compress and shrink videos to save storage. Download now for free!
Is your iPhone/iPad storage almost full — or do you want to reduce a video’s file size to send it faster via messengers like WhatsApp, iMessage, Telegram, Signal, Facebook Messenger, Snapchat, etc., or upload it to social media like Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, and more? This app solves the problem.
You can also use this app when your cloud storage (iCloud, Google Photos, Dropbox, OneDrive, Google Drive, etc.) is running out of space. Compress videos before uploading to fit many more — with little to no noticeable loss of quality.
Everything happens on your device (on-device processing): no cloud, no server upload. Works offline, without an account or registration.
How it works:
1) Choose a video (or select multiple videos)
2) Pick a preset resolution and set the compression strength with the bitrate slider
3) Preview the result: compare the compressed video with the original before you save
4) Save the compressed video to your iOS Photos/Videos library
Great for:
- Saving iPhone storage and freeing up space on iOS and iPadOS
- Sending videos faster in chats (WhatsApp, iMessage, Telegram, Signal, Messenger, Snapchat, etc.)
- Uploading to social apps when your video is too large (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, etc.)
- Backing up more videos to cloud storage (iCloud, Google Photos, Dropbox, OneDrive, Google Drive, etc.)
- Keeping quality high while shrinking the video file size
Overview:
- Compress and shrink a single video or multiple videos to save storage on your iPhone/iPad
- Choose presets for video compression (resolution) and adjust compression strength with a bitrate slider
- Before/after preview to check the visual quality of the compressed video
- Shows available device storage and the estimated new file size (before and after compression)
- Simple & intuitive
- Optional: delete the original video after compression (it may still appear in the “Recently Deleted” album — delete it there as well to free up storage)
- No watermark on compressed videos
- Keeps important metadata, including date/time and location (GPS), after compression
- Compatible with iPhone and iPad
- Works with 4K videos recorded on iPhone/iPad
Presets available for video compression:
- Full HD 1080p (1920×1080 pixels)
- HD 720p (1280×720 pixels)
- HD 540p (960×540 pixels)
- 480p (640×480 pixels)
- 360p (480×360 pixels)
In addition, you can set the bitrate with a slider. The app shows the estimated new file size and provides a before/after video preview so you can check the image quality.
Download now for free and save storage on your device!
PLEASE NOTE:
The app was made to compress original videos that had been recorded with the original camera app of your iPhone/iPad and may not always be able to compress videos from other sources or videos that had previously been edited, although it was successfully tested with drone videos, GoPro action cam videos, DSLR camera videos etc. in MOV, HEVC (H.265), MP4, H.264 in different fps (frames per second). Please also don't select too many videos at once. Please always try to compress a short video from the same source and see if it works before you make a purchase within the app.
Standard Apple Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00070416:ios.summary:

3DMark Solar Bay Extreme is a ray-traced gaming benchmark, designed to test the graphics performance of high-end iPhones and
bluejetty:00070416:ios.description:
Test and compare the performance of the latest iPhones and iPads with this free and easy-to-use benchmarking app.
3DMark Solar Bay Extreme is a ray-traced gaming benchmark, designed to test the graphics performance of high-end iPhones and iPads.
3DMark Steel Nomad Light is our heaviest non-raytracing benchmark for iOS. Steel Nomad Light lets you compare the performance of the latest iPhones and iPads in heavy gaming workloads.
Run 3DMark Solar Bay to compare the latest iOS devices that support gaming with real-time ray tracing. Ray tracing is a new technology in games that is used to produce far more realistic lighting. It has three sections with increasingly higher ray tracing workloads, helping you understand how enabling ray tracing will affect your device’s gaming performance. 
3DMark Wild Life is a cross-platform benchmarking app for comparing the performance of the latest smartphones and tablets. 
Use 3DMark Wild Life Extreme to test and compare the latest iPhones and iPads as well as Apple Mac computers with the M1 chip. Or run the original Wild Life benchmark to test older iPhone and iPad models. 
3DMark Steel Nomad Light, Solar Bay, Wild Life, and Wild Life Extreme offer two ways to test your device: a quick benchmark that tests instant performance and a longer stress test that shows how your device performs under longer periods of heavy load.
3DMark benchmarks measure GPU performance by rendering a demanding game-like scene in real-time. The faster the scene runs, the higher your benchmark score.
With its charts, lists and rankings, 3DMark gives you unique insights into the performance of your device.
- Measure the GPU performance of your iPhone and iPad.
- Compare your score with others from the same model. 
- See how your device compares with the latest models. 
- See how performance changes with each iOS update. 
- Search, filter and sort the in-app rankings to compare popular devices.
3DMark is a free app. There are no ads or in-app purchases. Download it today and join millions of people who choose 3DMark for accurate and impartial benchmark results.
This app is for non-commercial use only.
- Business users, contact UL.BenchmarkSales@ul.com for licensing.
- Members of the press, please contact UL.BenchmarkPress@ul.com.

Run 3DMark Solar Bay to compare the latest iOS devices that support gaming with real-time ray tracing. Ray tracing is a new technology in games that is used to produce far more realistic lighting. It has three sections with increasingly higher ray tracing workloads, helping you understand how enabling ray tracing will affect your device’s gaming performance.  

3DMark Wild Life is a cross-platform benchmarking app for comparing the performance of the latest smartphones and tablets. 

Use 3DMark Wild Life Extreme to test and compare the latest iPhones and iPads as well as Apple Mac computers with the M1 chip. Or run the original Wild Life benchmark to test older iPhone and iPad models. 

3DMark Steel Nomad Light, Solar Bay, Wild Life, and Wild Life Extreme offer two ways to test your device: a quick benchmark that tests instant performance and a longer stress test that shows how your device performs under longer periods of heavy load.

3DMark benchmarks measure GPU performance by rendering a demanding game-like scene in real-time. The faster the scene runs, the higher your benchmark score.

With its charts, lists and rankings, 3DMark gives you unique insights into the performance of your device.

- Measure the GPU performance of your iPhone and iPad.
- Compare your score with others from the same model. 
- See how your device compares with the latest models. 
- See how performance changes with each iOS update. 
- Search, filter and sort the in-app rankings to compare popular devices.

3DMark is a free app. There are no ads or in-app purchases. Download it today and join millions of people who choose 3DMark for accurate and impartial benchmark results.

This app is for non-commercial use only.

- Members of the press, please contact UL.BenchmarkPress@ul.com.

Step into the magical world of Tizi Friends Avatar Girl Games, a fun and creative universe designed especially for kids! This playful avatar life game lets little explorers create, play, and imagine in a vibrant mini world full of surprises. From grand mansions to cozy balconies, every corner is filled with exciting stories waiting to unfold.
In this delightful dollhouse world, kids can decorate rooms, design dream homes, and enjoy endless pretend play. Whether it's hosting fun sleepovers, exploring new spaces, or creating unique characters, this game encourages creativity and storytelling in a safe and engaging environment.
This family-friendly adventure brings everyday life to play in a fun way. Cook delicious meals in the kitchen, explore colorful bathrooms, relax in stylish bedrooms, and discover interactive spaces across the house. Every scene is designed to spark imagination and keep kids entertained for hours.
With Tizi Friends Avatar Girl Games, children can customize their avatars, dress them in adorable outfits, and create their own stories. The game combines creativity, exploration, and fun activities, making it perfect for kids who love design, storytelling, and imaginative play.
This is more than just a game—it’s a creative world where kids can express themselves freely. From decorating homes to building fun stories, every moment is filled with joy and learning. Even toddlers can enjoy its simple controls and engaging gameplay.
Explore a lively mini world full of exciting activities—host a tea party, play with interactive objects, or create your own fun adventures. Every character becomes a friend, making each experience more enjoyable and meaningful.
Designed with kids in mind, this game offers a safe, colorful, and engaging environment filled with creativity and fun. Whether your child loves decorating, storytelling, or exploring new ideas, they will find endless entertainment in this magical avatar world.

Market Street for U Grocery Deals & Delivery 
Shop, save & simplify your meal planning with Market Street for U’s all-in-one grocery app. Find everything you need, from fresh produce to pet food and pharmacy prescriptions.  Choose convenie
bluejetty:00100640:ios.description:
Market Street for U Grocery Deals & Delivery 
Shop, save & simplify your meal planning with Market Street for U’s all-in-one grocery app. Find everything you need, from fresh produce to pet food and pharmacy prescriptions.  Choose convenience that fits your schedule: grocery delivery or DriveUp & Go™ grocery pickup service.  
CONVENIENT GROCERY DELIVERY OR PICKUP 
Get grocery delivery or choose DriveUp & Go™ for easy curbside grocery pickup. Use Schedule & Save to automate your household essentials and save more on every order. Flash™ 30-minute delivery available in select markets for additional convenience. 
SEND GROCERIES AS A GIFT 
Shop, add a personalized message & send fresh groceries, flowers, chocolates or everyday essentials to anyone — delivered to their door or ready for store pickup. Select "Make this order a gift" at checkout, with no extra gifting fees. It is the perfect way to care for loved ones, celebrate special occasions, send a thoughtful thank-you gift or help out a friend with a fully stocked fridge. 
MEET YOUR AI SHOPPING ASSISTANT 
Take the guesswork out of meals with Ask AI. Use everyday language to ask for recipe ideas, find items based on dietary needs or compare products. Whether you're asking "What can I make with chicken and rice?" or looking for "gluten-free snacks," our assistant helps you build your grocery list fast. 
MEAL PLANNING & RECIPES 
Get inspired with thousands of shoppable recipes designed to fit every budget and preference. Import your favorite recipes into the app to convert ingredients into a digital shopping list. Plan your weekly menu & add all necessary items to your grocery shopping list with a single tap. 
SHOP EASIER & FASTER 
Quickly add items to your cart based on frequent purchases, recommendations & past orders. View and reorder from your order history at any time. Save your favorite household items, scan barcodes at home to add products to your digital cart instantly and build repeatable shopping lists. 
LOYALTY, DEALS & COUPONS 
Maximize your budget by clipping digital coupons, tracking your reward points and watching your savings stack up automatically at checkout. Find hundreds of weekly grocery coupons, digital offers and exclusive sales. Earn, track and redeem Market Street for U for U™ rewards automatically as you shop. Try FreshPass® for unlimited free grocery delivery on eligible orders, exclusive perks and subscriber-only savings. 
SECURE SNAP/EBT & WIC PAYMENT OPTIONS 
Use your SNAP/EBT benefits to easily pay for online grocery delivery and DriveUp & Go™ grocery pickup orders on eligible items, subject to state availability. WIC benefits are also accepted in store at participating Market Street for U locations only. 
YOUR NEIGHBORHOOD PHARMACY & HEALTH APP 
Order eligible prescriptions in the app and pick them up curbside through DriveUp & Go™ at 1,700+ participating pharmacy locations nationwide. Transfer your prescriptions to save more on your next grocery order, refill scripts for your family or pets, schedule vaccine appointments, access health tests and manage your wellness goals with Sincerely Health. Choose to bundle your Rx with your grocery pickup in one easy trip or go pharmacy-only. 
BUILD HEALTHY HABITS 
Monitor your nutrition, steps, sleep and activity. Earn rewards as you eat better, move more and stay active through the Sincerely Health wellness hub. Take advantage of custom health insights, track your daily wellness metrics, unlock premium rewards for making positive health choices and set achievable goals that support your complete physical well-being. 
Download the Market Street for U app and sign in or create your account to start shopping, saving and simplifying your week.

Take the guesswork out of meals with Ask AI. Use everyday language to ask for recipe ideas, find items based on dietary needs or compare products. Whether you're asking "What can I make with chicken and rice?" or looking for "gluten-free snacks," our assistant helps you build your grocery list fast. 

MEAL PLANNING & RECIPES 

Get inspired with thousands of shoppable recipes designed to fit every budget and preference. Import your favorite recipes into the app to convert ingredients into a digital shopping list. Plan your weekly menu & add all necessary items to your grocery shopping list with a single tap. 

SHOP EASIER & FASTER 

Quickly add items to your cart based on frequent purchases, recommendations & past orders. View and reorder from your order history at any time. Save your favorite household items, scan barcodes at home to add products to your digital cart instantly and build repeatable shopping lists. 

LOYALTY, DEALS & COUPONS 

Maximize your budget by clipping digital coupons, tracking your reward points and watching your savings stack up automatically at checkout. SECURE SNAP/EBT & WIC PAYMENT OPTIONS

bluejetty:00080463:ios.summary: Discover the ultimate platform for buying and selling all types of livestock. Whether you’re looking for cattle, horses, pigs, goats, hay, straw, or even livestock trailers & equipment like chutes, panels, bunks, LivestockMarket makes conne
bluejetty:00080463:ios.description:
Discover the ultimate platform for buying and selling all types of livestock. Whether you’re looking for cattle, horses, pigs, goats, hay, straw, or even livestock trailers & equipment like chutes, panels, bunks, LivestockMarket makes connecting with buyers and sellers in the livestock industry fast, easy, and secure.
EXPLORE THOUSANDS OF LIVESTOCK LISTINGS WITH PERSONALIZED SEARCH
Browse a wide inventory of listings for livestock, including bulls, bred cows, heifers, cow-calf pairs, feeders, and stockers, as well as cows, pigs, sheep, and even alpacas and showstock. Find the perfect animals to meet your farming & livestock breeding needs.
Once you’ve narrowed your search, view detailed photos and videos of your desired livestock or equipment and appropriate specifications. Contact sellers directly to secure the best deal and explore transport options available through LivestockMarkets’ trusted partner in heavy haul and livestock transportation, FR8Star.
The LivestockMarket app features advanced search tools that allow you to filter listings by class, breed, location, price range, weight, sex, fertility, and other specifications. Save time with personalized search filters to find exactly what you need.
EASILY TRACK LIVESTOCK & EQUIPMENT YOU ARE INTERESTED IN BUYING
Create a private Watch List to save your favorite listings or post a “Want-to-Buy” ad to let sellers know what you’re searching for. Stay updated with new listings and personalized alerts via email while browsing category pages that are updated daily with fresh inventory.
CONSIGN YOUR INVENTORY FAST
Whether you’re a big livestock producer or an independent farmer, LivestockMarket connects you with thousands of qualified buyers actively searching for livestock and related equipment.
Consign your livestock, horses and other inventory with LivestockMarket to reach a global audience. Click the “My Inventory” button in your LivestockMarket app and get transferred to the Sandhills Inventory Management app—your trusted and cost-effective way to track and manage inventory. Add listings, set prices, upload photos and videos, edit descriptions, and update your listings on the go—right from your iOS device.
CHOOSE THE LIVESTOCKMARKET APP FOR ALL YOUR LIVESTOCK NEEDS 
Whether you're upgrading your herd or selling equipment, LivestockMarket connects you with a vast inventory of livestock and tools, along with a large buyer audience.
As part of Sandhills Global, LivestockMarket links you to a network of trusted equipment marketplaces that includes TractorHouse, Machinery Trader, Truck Paper, AuctionTime, EquineMarket, and others catering to agriculture industries. Access listings from top breeders and sellers online.
GET THE LIVESTOCKMARKET APP NOW 
Thousands of dealers and farmers trust LivestockMarket to manage their operations. Download the app today to find your next livestock purchase or sell with ease!

bluejetty:00062118:ios.description:
Verse of the Day - Daily Bible is a comprehensive, faith-based app that provides you with daily Bible verses, prayers, devotionals, and Bible stories to help you enrich your spiritual journey. With an extensive verse archive and quick search function, you'll have access to an ocean of God's wisdom. Plus, our audio features let you listen to daily verses and prayers on the go.
In today's Verse of the Day - Daily Bible: Immerse yourself in the timeless wisdom of the scriptures with our free app. Experience a fresh touch of grace, guidance, and spiritual nourishment every day. "Verse of the Day - Daily Bible" is more than just an app; it's your daily companion on a journey of faith, hope, and love.
Features:
Daily Bible Verses: Begin each day with a carefully selected scripture. These verses are chosen to inspire, challenge, and uplift your spirit, ensuring you remain anchored in faith.
Daily Prayers: Engage in profound moments of reflection with prayers that resonate with the day's verse. Let these prayers be your heartfelt conversation with the divine.
Daily Context: Delve deeper into the scriptures. Understand each verse's historical, cultural, and theological context, enriching your biblical knowledge.
Prayer Plans: Spiritual growth requires intentionality. Our prayer plans guide you through thematic reflections, helping you grow in specific areas of your faith journey.
Bible Reading Plans: Whether you're a new believer or a seasoned scholar, our reading plans cater to everyone. Explore the Bible, from Genesis to Revelation, with structured guidance.
Bible Stories: Relive the epic narratives of the Bible. From David's bravery to Esther's courage, these stories are retold engagingly, ensuring they remain memorable.
Quick Search: A powerful search feature ensures you're never far from any verse or story. Whether preparing for a study group or seeking personal insight, find what you need in seconds.
Audio Bible: Embrace the scriptures audibly. Listen to the daily verses, making it convenient when reading isn't feasible.
Vast Archive: Life can be hectic, but with our expansive archive, you won't miss out. Access previous verses, devotions, and prayers anytime you wish.
Why Choose Our App?
The Bible is a treasure trove of wisdom, guidance, and divine revelation. "Verse of the Day - Daily Bible" bridges the gap between ancient scriptures and modern life, making the Bible's teachings relevant and accessible. Our mission is to inspire a deeper relationship with God through the scriptures.
We're passionate about creating a platform that fosters spiritual growth. Every feature is crafted with love, dedication, and deep respect for the Word of God. We invite you to join our community of believers, finding daily strength and inspiration in the pages of the Bible.

bluejetty:00131542:ios.summary:
Studio-quality recording, editing, and live streaming, right from your phone.
Riverside turns your phone into a portable studio for conversations and talking head videos. Record crisp video and audio anywhere, polish it on the spot, go liv
bluejetty:00131542:ios.description:
Studio-quality recording, editing, and live streaming, right from your phone.
Riverside turns your phone into a portable studio for conversations and talking head videos. Record crisp video and audio anywhere, polish it on the spot, go live to your audience, and turn the best bits into posts, without a laptop or a production team. Whether you're creating a podcast, a YouTube channel, a personal brand, or content for your business, this is where it gets made.
RECORD ANYWHERE, IN STUDIO QUALITY
Record solo, bring on a remote guest, or go audio-only. Riverside captures every track locally, so your quality stays sharp even when your connection doesn't. A built-in stabilizer keeps your shot steady, and your footage uploads in the background as you record, so it's ready to edit and clip the moment you stop.
CLIPS FOR SOCIAL, MADE FOR YOU
Knowing what to post is hard. Making it is harder. Riverside's AI does both. It finds your most engaging moments, then cuts them, frames them, and adds the captions. You get the best clips from every recording, ready to publish with a tap.
EDIT WITH A PROMPT
Describe your edit, and Riverside's AI agent makes it. No timeline. No pinching and dragging clips around on a small screen. Tell it which parts to cut and keep, ask it to clean up audio and remove filler words, or add captions and branding. It's the fastest route from raw recording to ready to post, and when you want more control, your project is waiting for you in the Riverside desktop editor.
TURN ONE RECORDING INTO A CONTENT ENGINE WITH AI
Riverside's AI agent takes a single recording and makes the rest for you: social clips, a thumbnail, captions, a blog post, full show notes. Just ask.
LIVE STREAM TO EVERYWHERE AT ONCE
Go live and multistream to YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, Twitch, TikTok, and custom RTMP destinations at the same time — one session, every audience.
PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF
Started a recording or an edit on your computer? Open it on your phone, watch it back, and leave comments waiting for you when you're back at your desk. Already a Riverside desktop user? The app carries your work with you, so your studio isn't stuck at one location.
A SECOND CAMERA IN YOUR POCKET
Recording on desktop? Add your phone as a second angle and capture an extra video track for your edit.
BUILT FOR CREATORS OF EVERY KIND
Podcasters, YouTubers, personal brands, and marketing teams — anyone who wants studio-quality content without the studio.
WHY RIVERSIDE
True local recording for quality independent of your connection
One recording = instantly generated clips, thumbnails, posts, and more.
AI editing and audio cleanup
Full production suite across mobile and desktop
Download Riverside and take your studio anywhere.
Terms & Conditions: https://riverside.com/terms-conditions
Privacy: https://riverside.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00079909:ios.description:
EXPERIENCE MINDFULNESS ANYTIME, ANYWHERE WITH JON KABAT-ZINN 
Discover the official mindfulness and meditation app by Jon Kabat-Zinn, the pioneer of mindfulness. Whether you’re a beginner or deepening your practice, this app offers structured guidance to help you cultivate mindfulness in daily life.
WHY DOWNLOAD THIS APP?
* Jon’s Official Mindfulness App – Direct access to Jon Kabat-Zinn’s wisdom and decades of experience in mindfulness, as the pioneer of mindfulness.
* 4 Free Guided Meditations – Start with Jon’s renowned 45-minute Body Scan meditation plus three additional mindfulness sessions.
* Live Meditation Sessions – Participate in eight exclusive live meditation events and Q&As in 2025, with on-demand replays time-stamped with participant questions for seamless navigation.
* MBSR-Based Practices – Meditations inspired by Mindfulness-Based Stress Reduction (MBSR), developed by Jon Kabat-Zinn.
* Mindfulness Video Library – Access Jon Kabat-Zinn’s workshop on Mindfulness in Medicine and Health Care by Jon Kabat-Zinn, with new content planned for the future.
* Reduce Stress & Improve Sleep – Enhance your well-being with meditations designed to promote relaxation, sleep better, and develop emotional balance.
* Practice Anytime, Anywhere – Meditate at home, work, or on the go with a simple, intuitive, and user-friendly app.
KEY FEATURES
* Live Meditations with Jon – Join real-time mindfulness practices with Jon Kabat-Zinn.
* On-Demand Replays – Easily revisit past sessions with time-stamped participant questions for better accessibility—simply tap a question to jump directly to that part of the video and follow Jon’s guidance as it unfolds.
MEDITATION LIBRARY
* MBSR Core Practices – Meditations designed for stress relief, relaxation, and emotional resilience
* Mindfulness for Daily Life – Practical techniques to integrate mindfulness into your routine.
* Healing & Deepening Your Practice – Explore breath awareness, body scans, and loving-kindness meditations.
* Customizable Experience – Choose from short, medium, or long meditations based on your schedule.
STRUCTURED MEDITATION SERIES
COPING WITH STRESS (MBSR-BASED PRACTICES) - Developed at the University of Massachusetts Medical Center, USA
* Body Scan – Enhance relaxation and body awareness. 
* Mindful Yoga – Connect movement with mindfulness.
* Sitting Meditation – Cultivate focus and resilience.
They can be used together with Jon's book : Full Catastrophe Living: Using the Wisdom of Your Body and Mind to Face Stress, Pain and Illness.
MINDFULNESS IN DAILY LIFE
* Short, Medium, and Long Sitting Meditations
* Lying Down Meditation Practice
* Breath Awareness – Develop presence in the moment.
HEALING & PERSONAL GROWTH
* Body Scan for Healing
* Choiceless Awareness – Expand your mindfulness practice.
* Loving-Kindness Meditation – Cultivate compassion and connection.
BENEFITS OF MINDFULNESS WITH JON KABAT-ZINN

bluejetty:00123814:ios.description:
Enjoy Cryptograms, a free puzzle game from Razzle Puzzles where the goal is to decode famous quotes! If you like interesting quotes and word puzzles, you will love Cryptograms!
About Cryptograms:
A cryptogram is an encoded statement that requires a degree of strategy to decode. The cryptograms found in this puzzle game use a 1-to-1 substitution cipher. For example all of the letter N’s in a cryptogram might stand for the letter B in the decoded statement. Aside from letters nothing else in the statement has been changed, e.g. spacing and punctuation. In the case of this puzzle game all statements are quotes from relatively famous to very famous individuals. Using your knowledge of the English language and grammar, see if you can decode the quote!
Cryptograms based on quotes are also commonly called cryptoquotes. The cryptoquotes found in this puzzle game are a mix of modern and historical quotes.
Track your best and average solve times over history with our stats tracker.
You can play Cryptograms by Razzle Puzzles on your phone and tablet. Enjoy online or in offline mode!
For support please contact us at support@razzlepuzzles.com or visit RazzlePuzzles.com

bluejetty:00040291:ios.description:
Learn a new language like Korean or English with Hilokal—your AI language tutor paired with the opportunity to practice with an active community of 1.5 million real language learners worldwide.
Whether you’re advancing your career, planning your next adventure, or diving into K-pop and international cinema, Hilokal combines the power of AI tutoring with authentic human interaction to make language learning practical, educational, and fun.
▶ AI-Powered Language Tutoring ◀
[Goguma: Your Advanced AI Tutor]
• Practice speaking, writing, and listening in 26 languages, including English and Korean, with our low-latency, GPT-4o powered AI tutor that provides real-time text and audio conversations.
[Real-Time Language Mastery]
• Receive immediate corrections on grammar, pronunciation, and vocabulary, ensuring you sound like a local and grasp nuanced expressions.
▶ Learning Tools ◀
[Interactive Transcripts with Insights]
• Record your learning sessions to get text and audio transcripts; analyze your pronunciation with heat maps and leverage AI insights for targeted improvement.
[Word Tracking & Analysis]
• Monitor every word you speak, analyze pronunciation accuracy, and review your speaking speed.
[Performance Leaderboards]
• Compare your language progress with others on a weekly leaderboard to motivate and enhance your learning experience.
▶ Community-Driven Language Practice ◀
[Language Exchange]
• Connect with over 1.5 million users learners worldwide, practicing and refining your language skills through real conversations.
[Interactive Language Games & Themed Chats]
• Engage in fun games and themed chats about popular topics like K-pop, travel, or international cinema, enhancing your language skills in a context you love.
[Community-Led Sessions]
• Participate in sessions led by experienced speakers and tailored to all skill levels—from beginners to advanced learners.
[Instant Audio Chat Rooms]
• Jump into audio chat rooms at any time, perfect for spontaneous practice sessions with native speakers and fellow language enthusiasts.
▶ Subscription Options ◀
[Access Full Features with Subscription] 
• Start with a 7-day free trial and continue your language learning journey with our Premium Plus subscription for full access to AI features and community interactions.
[Exclusive Subscriber Benefits] 
• Enjoy advanced learning materials, detailed analytics, and personalized feedback to accelerate your path to language proficiency.
Hilokal isn’t just an app—it’s your gateway to global fluency. Embrace a new language with tools designed for young adults seeking career growth, cultural immersion, and personal connections. Join Hilokal today and start speaking like a native!
For more information and support, visit https://www.hilokal.com/.
To see Terms of Service: https://www.hilokal.com/en/app/terms.html

bluejetty:00045074:ios.description:
Introducing the Liberty Home Guard Mobile App – the all-in-one platform designed to streamline
the home warranty experience for both homeowners and service technicians.
Whether you're a homeowner managing your warranty coverage or a technician handling
service requests, the Liberty Home Guard app puts everything you need right at your fingertips
with an intuitive and user-friendly interface.
For Homeowners:
Take control of your home warranty and enjoy seamless access to essential tools and
information:
● File and Track Claims: Submit new claims and stay updated on their progress in real
time. View current and past claim details easily.
● Manage Payments: View your payment history, update payment methods, and make
secure payments toward any outstanding balances.
● Schedule Service Appointments: Book service visits based on your availability and
receive confirmations and updates directly through the app.
● Stay Informed: Get timely push notifications about upcoming service appointments,
policy renewals, and important account updates.
● Helpful Resources: Browse a library of informative articles and videos to help you
troubleshoot common household issues and perform preventative maintenance.

● Dashboard Overview: Stay organized with a clear view of upcoming jobs, assigned
work orders, and your daily schedule—all in one place.
● Work Order Management: Easily document job progress, add service details, upload
required information, and finalize work orders directly in the app.
● Payment Center: Track and manage payments for completed jobs, and process
transactions conveniently while on-site.
● Service Requests: View and accept new service requests based on your location and
availability, helping you maximize your productivity.
Whether you're protecting your home or providing expert service, the Liberty Home Guard
Mobile App is your trusted companion—bringing efficiency, organization, and convenience to
every step of the home warranty process.
Download today and experience a smarter way to manage your home warranty journey.

bluejetty:00091171:ios.description:

- Safe & verified connections – Optional profile verification helps ensure genuine meetups with real travelers.
- Future trip planning made easy – Input your next destination and chat with others who overlap dates with you

3. Start meeting fellow solo travelers today!

bluejetty:00149828:ios.name: Bordify - Border Wait Times
bluejetty:00149828:ios.summary: Planning your next border crossing? Bordify shows you real-time wait times for every U.S.-Mexico and U.S.-Canada port of entry, sourced directly from U.S. Customs and Border Protection. Now with a live queue map and wait times in both direc
bluejetty:00149828:ios.description:
Planning your next border crossing? Bordify shows you real-time wait times for every U.S.-Mexico and U.S.-Canada port of entry, sourced directly from U.S. Customs and Border Protection. Now with a live queue map and wait times in both directions on both borders.
Whether you commute daily, travel for business, or cross for shopping and tourism, Bordify helps you choose the right time and the right lane to save hours at the border.
OFFICIAL DATA YOU CAN TRUST
Wait times come directly from CBP and are updated throughout the day for every port of entry. See General, SENTRI, Ready Lane, NEXUS, vehicular, and pedestrian lanes all in one place.
WAIT TIMES IN BOTH DIRECTIONS
Crossing into Mexico? Bordify covers 19 border cities, from Tijuana to Matamoros, with community reports and smart estimates. Heading back into Canada? See wait times in 23 cities with official data from the Canada Border Services Agency (CBSA). On the way back we track the general vehicle line.
NEW: QUEUE MAP
See live how far the line reaches at every crossing in your city, and how many people are in line right now. With smart routes, the phones of Bordify users already in line mark how it moves, anonymously and without opening the app.
NEW: LINE BARELY MOVING ALERT
When the community sees that a line isn't moving, Bordify flags it on the port and can notify you, because the posted wait may be understated.
NEW: SHOW OFF YOUR CROSSING
Share how long you waited and where you joined the line, as an image ready for your stories. You can also share a port's wait times or a community report.
LIVE BORDER CAMERAS

bluejetty:00074398:ios.description:
This app calculates and displays your Birth Chart (also known as Janam Kundali) based on Siderael (Vedic) as well as Tropical Zodiacs. The app uses Swiss Ephemeris. Main features of this app are:
- Birth Chart (Rasi Kundali) in North, South Indian and Western style
- Share chart with AI tools to analyse birth charts.
- Uses Swiss Ephemeris for Planetary Postions
- Search location using iOS Geocoder.
- GPS support for current location and time chart.
- Match Horoscopes (Guna Milap)
- Bhava Chalit Chart.
- Divisional (Varga) charts i.e. Hora, Drekkana,Chaturthmsa, Saptamsa, Navamsa, Trimsamsa and D10,D11,D12,D16,D20,D24,D27,D30,D40,D45,D60 with degrees.
- Planetary positions and several Lagnas with respect to Rashi as well as Nakshatra 
- Planet and House Analysis including Arudha Lagna.
- Ashatakavarga for each house.
- Planetary Strength (Shadabala) as total strength as well as itemised strength. 
- Vimshottari, Ashtottari and Yogini Dasa which includes Mahadasa, Antardasa and Pratyanar.
- Transits from Dasa/Antar/Pratyantar by simply clicking on the period.
- Calculates Solar Return Chart (Varsha Kundali).
- Support for Planet names and Zodiac signs in Sanskrit/Hindi and an option to use glyphs.
- KP Charts, KP House and Planet information for Nakshatra Lord and Sub-Lord and planet signification.
- Jaimini Lagnas and Jaimini Chara Dasa.
- Upgrahas such as Maandi & Gulika
- Ephemeris for years (3599 BCE-3599 CE) 
- Capability to zoom charts.
- Panchangam for the date of birth i.e. Tithi, Var,Karan, Yoga, Nakshatra
- Select Ayanamsa from Lahiri, KP, Raman and Others
- Load and Save horoscopes.
- Configure to set chart style, default location information, mean or true Rahu (Ketu) positions.
- View and Email charts as a PDF attachment.
- Customize chart colors.
- View Planetary Yogas
- View Sarvabhadrochakra
- View Kota Chakra

bluejetty:00089287:ios.description:
Beck Taxi is the leading provider of taxicab services in Toronto, Ontario, Canada.
We are pleased to offer our valued clients the very latest in smartphone booking technology with our free Beck Taxi application.
Key Features of the Beck Taxi application include:
• Book a trip in as few as 2 clicks
• Monitor the progress of your vehicle on a map
• Create a list of favourite addresses and assign a custom name for each
• Review all reservations you have made over the past 30 days
• Provide feedback related to the application and/or service you received
• Call Beck Taxi with the push of a button
To begin using the Beck Taxi application today:
• Download the free app
• Enter your phone number
• Validate your account (via the notification code you receive)
• Login to the app (Set your name and Email for receipts)
• Enter your pickup address
• Enter your destination address (this allows us to provide an estimated fare amount)
• Book your trip 
On booking a reservation, you will immediately receive a confirmation number, along with an update when your vehicle has been assigned. From here you can monitor the progress of your vehicle as it moves towards your pickup location.
The Beck Taxi application retains a history of your previous reservations for expense management and to quickly rebook the same trip with the push of a button. You may also create a list of favourite locations (Home, Work, etc.) to speed the booking process.
Let us know how we can serve you better by providing feedback via the Beck Taxi application or email us at feedback@becktaxi.com. 
We look forward to adding many exciting new features to the Beck Taxi application in the months ahead, and are always interested in what you have to say!

bluejetty:00166713:ios.description:
Welcome to Merge Fruit 3D: Sweet Merge! In this easy-to-play game, your goal is to combine two identical fruits to create bigger, more exciting ones. But be careful - space is limited, and every move matters. Think ahead, plan your matches, keep the box from filling up too quickly and get watermelons!
How to Play:
- Drag and drop matching fruits to combine them into larger ones.
- Plan your moves carefully—every new fruit takes up more space in the box.
- Avoid overflowing the box by planning your moves and drops carefully.
- Watch your fruits grow and evolve into more exciting and vibrant varieties and get watermelon!
Why You’ll Love Merge Fruit 3D: Sweet Merge:
- Stunning 3D Graphics: Vibrant colors, realistic textures, and smooth animations make every match satisfying.
- Relaxing Gameplay: Calming sound effects and seamless transitions create a soothing experience.
- Brain-Teasing Fun: Easy to play but hard to master, challenge yourself to create more watermelons and achieve higher scores.
Merge Fruit 3D: Sweet Merge is the perfect blend of relaxing gameplay and brain-teasing strategy. Whether you have a few minutes or want to dive in for hours of fun, this game will keep you entertained. Test your skills, beat the challenges, and see how big you can go!
Are you ready for the fruity challenge? Download Merge Fruit 3D: Sweet Merge today and start growing your fruit empire!

bluejetty:00033750:ios.description:
Epic Stickman: Unleash Your Inner Legend in the Shadow Realm 
Epic Stickman: Idle RPG War is a thrilling idle RPG adventure where darkness reigns and your stickman hero fights even while you’re offline. In this AFK auto-battle game, your legend never sleeps — only grows stronger. The realm of shadows is calling. Are you ready to answer?
◈ Idle RPG Action That Never Stops
Battle through hordes of monsters and earn epic rewards — even when you're away. Enjoy seamless auto-battle mechanics that let your Stickman progress on his own.
◈ Class-Based RPG System
Choose your path: become a fearless warrior, a shadowy rogue, a mystical mage, or a summoner of forgotten beasts. Each class offers unique idle skills, combat strategies, and upgrade paths.
◈ Epic Upgrades & Gears
Collect powerful weapons, legendary armor, and rare loot. Upgrade your stickman hero and unlock devastating skills for AFK dominance.
◈ Explore the Shadow Realm
Dive into a dark fantasy world filled with secrets, bosses, and treasures. Survive wave after wave of enemies in this action-packed roleplaying adventure.
◈ Customize and Evolve
Personalize your hero’s look, fighting style, and gear. Build your dream stickman champion and take down every foe in your way. Whether you're into idle RPGs, AFK clickers, stickman games, or auto-fight adventures, this game delivers it all. It’s time to claim your place among the legends.
Join Epic Stickman community at: https://discord.com/invite/bJxa4amcda 
Download Epic Stickman: Idle RPG War now and begin your shadow-fueled journey to greatness!
